Complete moles occurred in one per 276 births, most often in women under 29 and primigravidae. Vaginal bleeding was the main symptom, and most women presented in the first half of pregnancy. Suction evacuation was the most common treatment. Persistent mole developed in 9.5% and choriocarcinoma in 0.4%, highlighting the need for careful follow-up.

pmid-21187499.summary_ja: 31歳男性が腹痛で受診し、巨大な肝転移と前縦隔腫瘤が見つかった症例です。肝病変は絨毛癌と診断され、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法6サイクルで肝転移は完全奏効しました。残存縦隔腫瘍は完全切除され、成熟奇形腫と胎児性横紋筋肉腫が認められました。治療後6年以上再発はありません。
pmid-21187499.summary_en: A 31-year-old man presented with abdominal pain and was found to have diffuse, huge hepatic metastases and an anterior mediastinal mass. The liver lesions were diagnosed as choriocarcinoma based on histology and elevated hCG beta-subunit and AFP. After six cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy, the liver metastases achieved complete response, and the mediastinal tumor was completely resected. Histology showed mature teratoma with embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma, a somatic-type malignancy. The patient remained free of recurrence for over six years.

pmid-21187715.summary_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマで左高位精巣摘除術と25Gyの術後放射線療法を受けた21歳男性の症例です。完全寛解にもかかわらず血清hCG-βがわずかに陽性で推移しましたが、尿中hCG-βコア断片は正常範囲で、血清値は偽陽性と判断されました。無治療で経過観察され、術後3年以上再発はありません。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別に尿中測定が有用と述べられています。
pmid-21187715.summary_en: A 21-year-old man with stage I seminoma underwent left high orchiectomy and adjuvant radiotherapy of 25 Gy. Serum hCG-beta remained slightly positive (0.3-0.5 ng/mL) despite complete clinical remission. Urinary hCG-beta core fragment was within normal limits, indicating that the serum result was false positive. No further treatment was given, and the patient has remained free of recurrence for over three years. The case highlights urinary hCG-beta core fragment measurement as a useful tool for differential diagnosis of low-level serum hCG-beta positivity in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-21189838.summary_ja: 18年前に左精巣摘除術を受けた停留精巣の既往がある54歳男性が、骨盤痛で救急受診した症例です。画像所見から腹腔内の精巣腫瘍と診断されました。停留精巣では精巣がんのリスクが一般人口の約40倍とされ、先進国では成人例は稀ながら依然として起こりうると述べられています。
pmid-21189838.summary_en: A 54-year-old man with cryptorchidism and a left orchiectomy 18 years earlier presented to the emergency department with pelvic pain. Investigation revealed an intra-abdominal testicular mass. The authors note that testicular cancer risk in undescended testes is about 40 times higher than in the general population, and that adult cases are now rare in developed countries because of early orchidopexy and orchiectomy. The report, with a literature review, emphasizes that intra-abdominal testicular tumors can still occur in adults despite these preventive practices.

pmid-21191538.summary_ja: 超音波内視鏡ガイド下穿刺吸引(EUS-FNA)により後腹膜の孤立性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を診断した症例です。原発性のほか、消失性精巣がんからの転移の可能性もあり、適切な治療で高い治癒が期待できるため正確な診断が重要と述べられています。原因不明の後腹膜腫瘤では胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に含め、免疫表現型染色が必要な場合があると指摘しています。
pmid-21191538.summary_en: A patient with an isolated extragonadal germ cell tumor in the retroperitoneum was diagnosed by endoscopic ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration. The authors note that such tumors may be primary or metastatic from a burned-out testicular cancer, and that accurate diagnosis is critical because appropriate therapy can be highly curative. They emphasize including germ cell tumors in the differential diagnosis of unexplained retroperitoneal masses, and note that immunophenotypic staining may be required to confirm the diagnosis.

pmid-21209765.summary_ja: 本研究は、北ベンガルの医科大学で10年間に診断された20歳以下の女児卵巣腫瘍を後方視的に検討したものである。151例中34例(22.6%)が悪性で、そのうち66%は胚細胞由来であり、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が最多であった。多くはIA期で化学療法と放射線療法により回復した。
pmid-21209765.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 10 years of ovarian tumors in girls up to age 20 at a North Bengal medical college. Of 151 cases, 34 (22.6%) were malignant, and 66% of malignant cases were of germ cell origin, with dysgerminoma the most common. Most dysgerminomas were stage IA and recovered after chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Patients from remote hilly areas and of low socioeconomic status had lower rates of early detection.

pmid-21214154.summary_ja: 新生児期に仙尾部の良性奇形腫を切除した。その4週間後、右眼に眼内腫瘍が出現して増大したため、16週時に眼球摘出が行われた。病理学的に良性の嚢胞性眼内奇形腫と診断された。仙尾部奇形腫と眼内奇形腫が併存した稀な症例であり、臨床病理学的な特徴を報告している。
pmid-21214154.summary_en: A benign sacrococcygeal teratoma was resected from an infant at birth. Four weeks later, intraocular tumors were identified in the right eye, which enlarged and required enucleation at 16 weeks. Histopathology showed a benign cystic intraocular teratoma. The authors describe this unusual co-occurrence of sacrococcygeal and ocular teratomas and report its clinicopathologic features.

pmid-21226308.summary_ja: 25歳男性が2か月前からの血痰と片側の女性化乳房で受診した。胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で多発肺結節・腫瘤を認め、精査で左精巣に石灰化病変が見つかった。高位精巣摘除術により精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン（BEP）による化学療法が開始された。若年男性の多発肺病変では精巣胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別診断に挙げるべきと強調している。
pmid-21226308.summary_en: A 25-year-old man presented with two months of bloody sputum and unilateral gynecomastia. Chest CT showed multiple pulmonary nodules and masses, and a small calcified lesion was found in the left testis. High orchiectomy revealed a testicular mixed germ cell tumor, and BEP chemotherapy was started. The authors emphasize that testicular germ cell tumor should be considered in young men with multiple pulmonary nodules.

pmid-21319517.summary_ja: 44歳女性の大網原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。大網肥厚とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値(27,612 ng/ml)を認め、手術と4コースのBEP療法を施行し、7か月間無病であった。女性の原発性大網卵黄嚢腫瘍としては4例目であり、文献的な考察を加えている。
pmid-21319517.summary_en: A 44-year-old woman presented with abdominal distension, a thickened omentum on CT, and markedly elevated alpha-fetoprotein (27,612 ng/ml). Surgery revealed a large omental mass with a small implant on the left ovary, and histology confirmed yolk sac tumour. She received hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and omentectomy, followed by four cycles of BEP chemotherapy, and remained disease-free for seven months. The authors review primary omental yolk sac tumour, noting this is only the fourth such case reported in women.

pmid-21319519.summary_ja: 27歳女性の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例である。妊孕性温存手術とBEP療法6クールで臨床的完全寛解に至ったが、約2年後に腹壁に紡錘形細胞肉腫として再発し、腹腔内播種の進行で死亡した。化学療法中・後に間葉様成分が肉腫様に変化し、化学療法抵抗性の再発を来した可能性を論じている。
pmid-21319519.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman with ovarian yolk sac tumour underwent fertility-sparing surgery and six cycles of BEP chemotherapy, achieving clinical complete remission. About two years later the tumour recurred as an unclassified spindle cell sarcoma of the abdominal wall, and she died from progressive intraperitoneal disease. The authors propose that the mesenchyme-like component of yolk sac tumour may undergo sarcomatous change during or after chemotherapy, producing a chemoresistant, metastasising recurrence.

pmid-21319525.summary_ja: 24歳女性の傍膀胱窩に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。挙筋を経て坐骨直腸窩へ進展していたが、開腹により完全切除し、術後2年のフォローアップまで良好な経過である。後腹膜奇形腫はまれで早期診断が難しく、予後は組織型に依存すると論じている。
pmid-21319525.summary_en: A 24-year-old woman presented with pelvic pain and a mass extending through the levator ani into the ischiorectal fossa. Laparotomy completely excised a cystic tumour from the left paravesical fossa, which was a mature cystic teratoma, and she had a good outcome at two-year follow-up. The authors review primary retroperitoneal teratomas, which are rare, hard to diagnose early, and whose prognosis depends on histology. They note this is only the second reported paravesical dermoid with ischiorectal extension.

pmid-21319527.summary_ja: 47歳と57歳の女性における、卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍と上皮性腫瘍の混合性原発腫瘍2症例の報告である。いずれも20cm・21cmの大きな奇形腫に、カルチノイドと悪性粘液性腫瘍が合併していた。胚細胞成分と上皮成分に共通する発がん機序の可能性を論じ、文献的レビューを加えている。
pmid-21319527.summary_en: The authors report two women, aged 47 and 57, with primary ovarian tumours combining germ cell and epithelial components. Each had a large teratoma (20 and 21 cm) together with carcinoid and malignant mucinous neoplasm. The paper proposes a possible common oncogenic mechanism for the mixed germ cell and epithelial components, and includes a literature review of such mixed ovarian tumours.

pmid-21351701.summary_ja: 36歳男性の原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。左鎖骨下静脈血栓症を伴う前縦隔腫瘤で、生検でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性の乳頭状・管状癌と判明した。シスプラチン併用化学療法4コースでAFPは低下した。予後は化学療法前後での完全切除が最も重要と述べている。
pmid-21351701.summary_en: A 36-year-old man presented with left subclavian vein thrombosis and a large anterior mediastinal mass invading the vein. Biopsy showed a papillary and tubular carcinoma that was alpha-fetoprotein positive, and serum AFP was elevated, supporting primary mediastinal yolk sac tumour. He received four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, with falling AFP levels. The authors note that complete excision before or after chemotherapy is the most important prognostic factor.

pmid-21355460.summary_ja: 2000〜2004年に保存的治療を受けた若年女性60例の卵巣腫瘍のコホート研究である。胚細胞腫瘍が26例(43.3%)で最多であった。6例で7回の正期産があり、9例に再発を認めた。病期I・低グレードの上皮性、境界悪性、性索腫瘍には妊孕性温存手術を推奨している。未熟奇形腫の死亡例も含まれる。
pmid-21355460.summary_en: This cohort reviews 60 young women with ovarian tumours treated conservatively between 2000 and 2004. Germ cell tumours were the largest group (26 patients, 43%). Seven term pregnancies occurred in six patients, and nine recurrences were reported. Two patients with advanced disease who refused radical surgery died. The authors recommend fertility-sparing surgery for stage I, low-grade epithelial, borderline and sex-cord tumours.

pmid-21358100.summary_ja: 脳および内臓に多発転移を伴う、侵襲性の絨毛癌の症例報告である。初期治療中に毎週のように新たな脳病変が画像上出現したが、緊急開頭術と補助療法の後、EMA-CO療法により長期の完全寛解が得られた。脳転移は予後不良因子であり、その画像所見と補助療法を考察している。
pmid-21358100.summary_en: The authors describe an unusual, aggressive choriocarcinoma with multiple brain and visceral metastases. New cerebral lesions appeared almost weekly on imaging during initial treatment, yet the patient achieved long-term complete remission after emergency craniotomy and EMA-CO chemotherapy. The paper discusses the radiological presentation of choriocarcinoma brain metastases, which carry a poor prognosis, and the adjuvant radiotherapy and chemotherapy strategies used.

pmid-21368870.summary_ja: 精子形成停止を伴う不妊男性の精巣でmiR-383の発現が低下していることを示した研究である。精巣胎児性癌細胞株NT2では、miR-383の過剰発現により増殖抑制、G1期停止、アポトーシスが誘導された。miR-383はIRF1を標的とし、CDK4の分解を介してpRbのリン酸化を抑制する。男性不妊と精巣胚細胞腫瘍を結びつける可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21368870.summary_en: This study examines microRNA-383 (miR-383), which is reduced in testes of infertile men with maturation arrest. In NT2 testicular embryonal carcinoma cells, miR-383 overexpression suppressed proliferation, caused G1 arrest, and induced apoptosis. miR-383 targets IRF1, affecting its mRNA stability and the levels of downstream cyclin D1 and p21. It also reduces CDK4 through proteasome-dependent degradation, which inhibits pRb phosphorylation. The authors suggest miR-383 is a negative regulator of proliferation and may link male infertility with testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-21369398.summary_ja: 両側停留精巣を伴う同時性両側セミノーマの症例報告である。救急で腹部鈍的外傷として受診し、術前には診断されなかった。術後に正しく診断され、化学療法を施行された。あわせて同時性両側胚細胞腫瘍の症例シリーズを検討し、臨床像と治療をまとめている。停留精巣を伴う場合は診断が難しい点に注意が必要である。
pmid-21369398.summary_en: This report describes a patient with synchronous bilateral testicular seminoma and bilateral cryptorchidism who presented to the emergency department with blunt abdominal injury and was not diagnosed preoperatively. After a correct diagnosis was made postoperatively, he was treated with chemotherapy. The authors also reviewed a larger series of synchronous bilateral germ cell tumors to summarize their presentation and management. The case highlights that bilateral testicular tumors in patients with cryptorchidism can be diagnostically challenging.

pmid-21381532.summary_ja: 急速に増大する嚢胞性病変を契機に出生前に診断された仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は血行動態の異常や出血を合併しうるため、妊娠中を通じた慎重な経過観察が必要とされる。超音波検査と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を連続的に行い、腫瘍の増大、胎児臓器への影響、胎児の状態を評価することが推奨されている。分娩や出生後の精査の計画に役立つとされる。
pmid-21381532.summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed prenatally because of a rapidly growing cystic lesion. The authors note that these tumors can cause hemodynamic and hemorrhagic complications, so affected fetuses need careful surveillance throughout pregnancy. They recommend serial ultrasound and MR imaging to track tumor growth, its effects on fetal organs, and fetal wellbeing. Such monitoring allows delivery and postnatal workup to be optimized.

pmid-21381594.summary_ja: 多発胆石を伴う巨大卵巣腫瘤を有する30歳女性の症例報告である。妊孕性温存手術として卵巣腫瘤の切除と胆嚢摘出術を行い、続いて化学療法を施行した。その後、妊娠経過は順調で健康な児を出産した。若年女性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍では、妊孕性温存手術と術後化学療法により妊娠・出産が可能であることを示唆する。ただし単一症例であり一般化には限界がある。
pmid-21381594.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with a large ovarian mass and multiple gallstones. She underwent fertility-sparing excision of the ovarian mass and cholecystectomy, followed by chemotherapy for ovarian dysgerminoma. She later had an uneventful pregnancy and delivered a healthy baby. The report suggests that fertility-sparing surgery combined with adjuvant chemotherapy can allow successful pregnancy outcomes in young women with ovarian germ cell tumors. As a single case report, its generalizability is limited.

pmid-21381621.summary_ja: 縦隔の巨大腫瘤により上大静脈症候群と気管圧迫を来した19歳男性の症例報告である。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で18×24cmの縦隔腫瘤を認め、完全切除された。病理組織学的所見では生存腫瘍を含まない線維化した腫瘤であった。縦隔の悪性胚細胞腫瘍は若年男性に多く、手術に放射線療法や化学療法を組み合わせる治療が一般的であることを概説している。
pmid-21381621.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old man with a large mediastinal mass causing superior vena cava syndrome and tracheal compression. Computed tomography revealed an 18 x 24 cm mediastinal mass, which was completely resected. Histopathology showed a fibrotic mass without viable tumor, and the postoperative course was unremarkable. The authors review that malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors typically affect young males, and that surgery followed by radiation therapy and multimodal chemotherapy has been the usual treatment approach.

pmid-21388073.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の患者に、突然の自然発生性重症腫瘍崩壊症候群と重度の低血糖が出現した症例報告である。固形腫瘍で腫瘍崩壊症候群が自然発生することは極めて稀とされる。高尿酸血症、高リン血症、高カリウム血症、低カルシウム血症、尿毒症などの代謝異常を伴っていた。このような稀だが重篤な代謝合併症に注意が必要であることを強調している。
pmid-21388073.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metastatic germ cell tumor who developed abrupt, spontaneous severe tumor lysis syndrome together with severe hypoglycemia. Tumor lysis syndrome usually follows treatment in bulky, treatment-sensitive hematologic malignancies, and its spontaneous occurrence in solid tumors is very rare. The associated metabolic abnormalities included hyperuricemia, hyperphosphatemia, hyperkalemia, hypocalcemia, and uremia. Severe hypoglycemia is also rarely associated with solid malignancies. The authors emphasize that clinicians should be aware of these uncommon but serious metabolic complications.

pmid-21446374.summary_ja: 40歳女性の右副腎領域に生じた奇形腫の症例報告である。超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、石灰化と脂肪成分を含む混合エコーの腫瘤と、右腎門部のリンパ節腫大が確認された。手術では偽被膜に覆われた腫瘍が見つかり、十二指腸の一部が癒着していた。副腎奇形腫は稀な後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍であり、画像所見と術中所見が報告されている。
pmid-21446374.summary_en: This case report describes a teratoma arising in the right adrenal region of a 40-year-old woman who presented with vague complaints. Ultrasonography and computed tomography revealed a mixed echogenic mass with calcification and fat, and a right renal hilar lymph node mass. Intraoperatively, the tumor was found encapsulated in a pseudocapsule with a portion of duodenum adhered. The authors note that adrenal teratoma is a rare retroperitoneal germ cell tumor, with few cases reported. The report highlights the imaging features and surgical findings of this uncommon extragonadal presentation.

pmid-21472272.summary_ja: 生薬紫根由来の化合物β-ヒドロキシイソバレリルシコニンの、絨毛癌細胞株BeWoに対する抗腫瘍効果を検討したin vitro研究である。MTT法で増殖抑制が示され、細胞周期はG0/G1期に偏位した。アネキシンV染色とミトコンドリア膜電位の低下からアポトーシスの誘導が確認された。絨毛癌の治療薬候補となる可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-21472272.summary_en: This study examines the anti-neoplastic effects of β-hydroxyisovalerylshikonin, a compound from the herb Lithospermum radix, on the human choriocarcinoma cell line BeWo. The compound inhibited cell growth in an MTT assay, shifted cell cycle distribution toward G0/G1, and induced apoptosis as shown by Annexin V staining and mitochondrial membrane potential loss. Altered expression of genes related to growth, malignant phenotype and apoptosis was also observed. The authors suggest the compound may be a potential therapeutic agent for choriocarcinoma. This is an in vitro study.

pmid-21495249.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JeG-3からメトトレキサート(MTX)耐性亜株を間欠的および持続的誘導法で作製し、ジヒドロ葉酸還元酵素(DHFR)のmRNA量を検討した研究である。DHFR発現とβ-hCG分泌は一定の濃度範囲でMTX量と相関したが、高濃度では急減した。DHFR転写産物量は耐性の程度と一貫して対応せず、化学療法耐性予測のバイオマーカーとしての有用性は限られると結論づけている。
pmid-21495249.summary_en: This study evaluates whether dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR) mRNA levels can predict methotrexate resistance in choriocarcinoma. Two series of MTX-resistant JeG-3 sublines were generated by intermittent and continuous induction. DHFR transcript levels and β-hCG secretion were measured across increasing MTX concentrations. Both correlated with MTX dose only within a certain range, then declined sharply at higher concentrations, and DHFR fold changes did not consistently track resistance. The authors conclude DHFR transcript level has limited utility as a biomarker for predicting MTX-based chemoresistance.

pmid-21510560.summary_ja: 生後1歳の女児に発生した巨大な良性胃奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍は22×10×8cm、重量は2.25kgで、胃奇形腫としては最大級とされる。外科的に切除され、病理組織学的に皮膚、軟骨、線維脂肪組織、血管、高円柱上皮を有する腺組織など三胚葉由来の成分が確認された。胃奇形腫は稀で、男児に多いとされる。術後経過は順調であった。
pmid-21510560.summary_en: This case report describes a massive benign gastric teratoma in a one-year-old female infant. The tumor measured 22 × 10 × 8 cm and weighed 2.25 kg, reportedly one of the largest gastric teratomas. It was removed surgically. Histopathology showed all three germ layer-derived elements, including skin, cartilage, fibrofatty tissue, blood vessels and glandular tissue with tall columnar epithelium. The postoperative course was uneventful. The authors note that gastric teratoma is rare and most often seen in male infants.

pmid-21605528.summary_ja: 大型の嚢胞性肛門直腸奇形腫を有する若年女性に対し、腹腔鏡下腹傍尾骨切除を併用して治療に成功した症例報告である。仙尾部奇形腫は成人では稀で、報告発生率は8万7000人に1人とされる。腫瘍の大きさと骨盤内の位置によって、経腹、後方、併用のいずれのアプローチを選ぶかが決まるとしている。大型骨盤内奇形腫に対する併用手術の一例を示している。
pmid-21605528.summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with a large cystic anorectal teratoma successfully treated by combined laparoscopic abdomino-paracoccygeal resection. The authors note that sacrococcygeal teratoma rarely presents in adulthood, with a reported incidence of about 1 in 87,000, and that adult anorectal teratoma is a rare variant. They discuss that tumor size and pelvic location determine whether a transabdominal, posterior or combined approach is used. The case illustrates a combined surgical strategy for large pelvic teratomas. The report describes management rather than long-term outcome data.

pmid-22043263.summary_ja: 16歳男性の精巣内に発生した類表皮嚢胞の症例を報告している。精巣の類表皮嚢胞は極めてまれで、組織発生には議論がある。一部の著者は本病変を嚢胞性単胚葉性奇形腫とみなしている。臨床所見と形態学的特徴を示し、若年者の精巣腫瘤の鑑別診断において参考となる。
pmid-22043263.summary_en: This report describes an intratesticular epidermoid cyst in a 16-year-old boy who presented with a nodular testicular lesion. Epidermoid cysts of the testis are extremely rare, and their histogenesis remains controversial. Some authors regard this lesion as a cystic monodermal teratoma rather than a simple cyst. The paper provides the clinical and morphological features of the lesion. It is relevant to the differential diagnosis of testicular masses in young patients.

pmid-22043506.summary_ja: 右卵巣の奇形腫を同時に有していた女性の虫垂成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。虫垂からの奇形腫発生は極めてまれで、既報は1例のみであった。虫垂腫瘤の鑑別診断に含めるべきと結論づけ、臨床的・病理学的特徴を詳述している。女性で同時に二つの奇形腫が生じた初めての報告である。
pmid-22043506.summary_en: This case report describes a mature cystic teratoma of the appendix in a woman who also had a simultaneous teratoma of the right ovary. Teratomas rarely arise from the appendix, and only one prior case of mature appendiceal teratoma had been reported. The authors conclude that this entity should be included in the differential diagnosis of appendiceal masses. They discuss the clinical and pathologic features of appendiceal masses in detail. This is the first reported case of two simultaneous teratomas in a female.

pmid-22439057.summary_ja: 異所性妊娠が疑われた患者で妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の有病率を検討した研究である。手術を受けた79例中18例で病理学的にGTDが確認され、異所性妊娠の約18%に相当した。メトトレキサート治療不応例では、β-hCG値が高値であった。出生1,000件あたり約1.56例のGTDが報告された。
pmid-22439057.summary_en: This study examined the prevalence of gestational trophoblastic disease among patients with suspected ectopic pregnancy. Pathology confirmed GTD in 18 of 79 operated patients, about 18% of ectopic pregnancies. Among patients whose methotrexate treatment failed, GTD was confirmed and beta-hCG levels were above 10 mIU/mL. The authors report 1.56 GTD cases per 1,000 deliveries. Pregnancy testing was used when beta-hCG quantification was unavailable.

pmid-22470691.summary_ja: 乳児の胃小弯に生じた奇形腫の症例報告である。胃奇形腫は世界で100例未満しか報告されていない。小児の腹部臓器由来の性腺外奇形腫は非常にまれである。画像と病理所見の対比を重視している。奇形腫は小児の胚細胞腫瘍で最も多い組織型である。
pmid-22470691.summary_en: This report describes a teratoma of the lesser curvature of the stomach in an infant. Gastric teratoma is extremely rare, with fewer than 100 cases reported worldwide. Extragonadal teratoma arising from abdominal viscera is very unusual in children. The authors emphasize radiologic-pathologic correlation in diagnosis. The report notes that teratoma is the most common histology among pediatric germ cell neoplasms, which can arise in gonadal or extragonadal sites.

pmid-22750920.summary_ja: 副腎皮質ステロイドに抵抗性の温式抗体性自己免疫性溶血性貧血を呈した45歳女性の症例報告である。腹腔鏡下脾摘と右卵巣摘出後にのみ貧血が改善した。付属器腫瘤は病理組織学により嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫が温式抗体溶血の希少な原因であることを強調している。
pmid-22750920.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old woman with warm-antibody autoimmune hemolytic anemia refractory to corticosteroids. Anemia improved only after laparoscopic splenectomy and right oophorectomy. Histopathology of the adnexal mass showed a cystic teratoma. The authors review prior cases in which hemolysis was controlled by surgical removal of the teratoma, together with splenectomy. The paper highlights ovarian cystic teratoma as a rare cause of warm antibody hemolysis.

pmid-22753160.summary_ja: 48歳男性喫煙者の症例報告。呼吸困難、女性化乳房、多発肺結節を呈した。精巣超音波検査は正常であったが、血清β-hCGが著明に高値で、肺生検により原発性肺絨毛癌と診断された。性腺原発を認めなくても肺に絨毛癌が生じうること、精巣が正常でもhCG高値では性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきことを示す。
pmid-22753160.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old male smoker with respiratory distress, gynaecomastia, and multiple pulmonary nodules. Testicular ultrasound was normal, but serum β-hCG was markedly elevated, and lung biopsy supported a diagnosis of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma. The report highlights that choriocarcinoma can arise in the lung without a gonadal primary, and that marked hCG elevation with a normal testis should prompt consideration of extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-22778367.summary_ja: 36歳男性の進行性後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。肝転移がないにもかかわらず劇症肝不全を発症した、これまで報告のない病態である。化学療法後に肝機能と肝性脳症は改善し、早期治療が根治につながった可能性が示唆された。化学療法後に自然細菌性心内膜炎を発症し大動脈弁置換術を要したが、44か月後には日常生活に復帰している。
pmid-22778367.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with advanced retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor who developed fulminant hepatic failure without liver metastases, a previously unreported presentation. Liver function and encephalopathy improved after chemotherapy, suggesting prompt treatment may have been curative. He later developed spontaneous bacterial endocarditis requiring aortic valve replacement, a rare complication of curative chemotherapy. At 44 months after chemotherapy he had recovered his performance status and returned to work.

pmid-22842324.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌が婦人科的症状ではなく血胸として発症した症例報告。絨毛癌は血行性に早期転移しやすく、肺が最多の転移部位である。胸膜転移による胸水は稀で、通常は胸膜下結節から波及する。妊娠歴のある患者の原因不明の血胸では妊娠性絨毛癌を考慮すべきであることを示す。
pmid-22842324.summary_en: This case report describes gestational choriocarcinoma presenting as hemothorax rather than with typical gynecologic symptoms. Choriocarcinoma spreads early via hematogenous routes, most often to the lung, and pleural effusion from it is uncommon, usually arising from a subpleural nodule. The authors describe a patient whose initial presentation was medical rather than gynecologic, highlighting the importance of considering choriocarcinoma in unexplained hemothorax with a history of pregnancy.

pmid-22933911.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍40例（セミノーマ18例、非セミノーマ22例）を対象に、CDKN2AとRB1のヘテロ接合性の消失(LOH)をPCRベースの多型解析で検討した分子生物学的研究。両遺伝子のLOHは非セミノーマにのみ認められ、CDKN2Aは卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を、RB1は胎児性癌成分を含む症例に見られた。非セミノーマにおけるLOHの高頻度は、その浸潤性の高い性質と関連する可能性がある。
pmid-22933911.summary_en: This molecular study analyzed loss of heterozygosity (LOH) of CDKN2A (p16INK4a) and RB1 in 40 testicular germ cell tumors, including 18 seminomas and 22 nonseminomas, using PCR-based polymorphism methods. LOH of both genes was found only in nonseminomas, with CDKN2A changes in tumors containing yolk sac tumor components and RB1 changes in those with embryonal carcinoma. The authors suggest that the higher LOH frequency in nonseminomas may relate to their more invasive behavior.

pmid-22953260.summary_ja: 生後1か月半の男児に発生した未熟胃奇形腫の症例報告。上腹部から骨盤に及ぶ大きな腹部腫瘤を呈し、超音波検査とCTで充実性・嚢胞性の腫瘤と石灰化が確認された。胃壁の漿膜筋層を含めて完全切除され、病理組織学的にgrade 3の未熟奇形腫と診断された。胃奇形腫、特に乳児の未熟型は極めて稀である。
pmid-22953260.summary_en: This case report describes a 1.5-month-old male infant with a large abdominal mass extending from the epigastrium to the pelvis, diagnosed as an immature gastric teratoma after complete surgical excision. Ultrasound showed a solid and cystic mass, and CT revealed calcifications. Histopathology confirmed a grade 3 immature teratoma. The authors note the rarity of gastric teratomas, particularly the immature subtype in infants.

pmid-22966298.summary_ja: 48歳男性の精巣成熟奇形腫に悪性転化を伴い、印環細胞型腺癌を生じた症例報告。CTと骨シンチグラフィで後腹膜リンパ節腫大と多発骨転移が認められた。右精巣摘除術ののちシスプラチンを含む化学療法を受けたが病勢は進行し、15か月後に死亡した。精巣奇形腫の原発性悪性転化で印環細胞への分化を示す症例としては初めての報告である。
pmid-22966298.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old man with an enlarged right scrotum, diagnosed with malignant transformation of a testicular mature teratoma into signet ring cell-type adenocarcinoma. Imaging showed retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy and bone metastases. After right orchiectomy, the patient received cisplatin-based chemotherapy, but disease progressed and he died 15 months later. The authors report this as the first case of primary malignant transformation of testicular teratoma with signet ring cell differentiation.

pmid-23120736.summary_ja: 呼吸窮迫を呈した先天性鼻咽頭奇形腫の症例報告。頭頸部奇形腫は稀で、通常は新生児期に発症し、局在により悪性となることが多い。インドでこれまでに報告された先天性鼻咽頭奇形腫は2例のみであり、本報告は3例目である。奇形腫のまれな発生部位に関する簡潔な報告である。
pmid-23120736.summary_en: This case report describes a congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma presenting with respiratory distress. The authors note that head and neck teratomas are rare, usually present in the neonatal period, and are often malignant because of their location. Only two prior congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma cases had been reported in India, and this is the third. The paper is a brief report of a rare teratoma location.

pmid-23133226.summary_ja: 55歳男性が右鼠径ヘルニア手術の数日後に右鼠径部の無痛性腫瘤を生じた症例報告。腫瘤は診断と治療に困難をもたらした。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例として報告されている。最近のヘルニア手術と腫瘤発生の時間的関連が診断上の課題となった点に焦点を当てている。
pmid-23133226.summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old man with a painless mass in the right inguinal region, appearing a few days after hernioplasty for a right direct inguinal hernia. The mass caused diagnostic and treatment difficulties. The title identifies the tumor as an extragonadal germ cell tumor. The brief report focuses on the diagnostic challenge posed by the mass's temporal association with recent hernia surgery.

pmid-23168900.summary_ja: 51歳女性が咳嗽、胸痛、呼吸困難で受診。画像で左胸水を伴う巨大な縦隔の液体貯留性腫瘤を認めた。開胸術で心膜・胸膜・肺に癒着した20cmの前縦隔腫瘤が見つかり、病理学的に多様な組織を含む成熟奇形腫と診断された。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は多くが良性で、縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍の60〜70%を占めるが、破裂は稀ながら生命を脅かす。外科的切除により良好な経過をたどった。
pmid-23168900.summary_en: A 51-year-old woman presented with cough, chest pain and dyspnea. Imaging showed a large fluid-filled mediastinal mass with a left pleural effusion. Thoracotomy revealed a 20 cm anterior mediastinal mass adherent to the pericardium, pleura and lung, and pathology confirmed a mature teratoma with multiple tissue types. The authors note that mature cystic teratomas are mostly benign, account for 60-70% of mediastinal germ cell tumors, and that rupture is rare but life-threatening. Surgical resection gave an excellent outcome.

pmid-24198622.summary_ja: 精巣がんは化学療法の進歩により治癒率が15%から85%に向上した胚細胞腫瘍の代表例である。病期Iのセミノーマと非セミノーマに対する監視療法、放射線療法、カルボプラチン、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、補助化学療法の選択を概説する。病期II・IIIは腫瘤径と腫瘍マーカーに基づき治療が決定される。化学療法後の残存腫瘤はPETで活動性癌と壊死を鑑別する。晩期再発と白金抵抗性病態が今後の課題である。
pmid-24198622.summary_en: This review covers the management of testicular cancer, a model curable germ-cell malignancy whose cure rate rose from 15% to 85% with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. It describes treatment choices for stage I seminoma and nonseminoma, including surveillance, radiotherapy, carboplatin, and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, with adjuvant chemotherapy. Management of stage II and III disease is tailored by volume and tumor marker status. PET helps distinguish residual viable cancer from necrosis after chemotherapy. Late relapse and platinum-refractory disease remain challenges.

pmid-24281181.summary_ja: 絨毛癌では腫瘍抑制遺伝子の抑制などのエピジェネティックな異常が発症に関与すると考えられている。本総説はヒストン脱アセチル化酵素(HDAC)阻害薬による治療的アプローチを取り上げる。絨毛癌細胞株を用いた前臨床研究では、HDAC阻害薬が細胞増殖を抑え、細胞周期停止とアポトーシスを誘導し、悪性形質に関連する遺伝子発現を変化させることが示されている。臨床応用に向けた前臨床データを中心に検討する。
pmid-24281181.summary_en: This review examines epigenetic alterations in choriocarcinoma, where repression of tumor suppressor genes and promotion of tumorigenesis are thought to contribute to disease. It focuses on histone deacetylase inhibitors (HDACIs) as a therapeutic approach. Preclinical studies in choriocarcinoma cell lines show that HDACIs inhibit cell growth, induce cell cycle arrest and apoptosis, and alter expression of genes linked to the malignant phenotype. The authors discuss biologic and therapeutic effects of HDACIs, emphasizing preclinical evidence.

pmid-26190492.summary_ja: 22歳女性が4か月間の腹痛と腹部膨満感で受診した。CTでは脂肪、石灰化、嚢胞性および充実性成分を含む巨大な不均一肝腫瘤が認められた。右肝切除と大網切除が施行された。病理では外胚葉、中胚葉、内胚葉成分と未熟組織の巣を伴う27 cmの腫瘍が認められ、未熟奇形腫に合致した。著者らは、これが報告されている中で最大の肝奇形腫であり、成人の肝未熟奇形腫としては2例目であるとしている。8か月間のフォローアップではCTとαフェトプロテインは正常で、患者は生存している。
pmid-26190492.summary_en: A 22-year-old woman presented with four months of abdominal pain and abdominal fullness. CT revealed a huge heterogeneous liver mass containing fat, calcification, and cystic and solid components. Right hepatectomy with omentectomy was performed. Pathology showed a 27 cm tumor with ectodermal, mesodermal and endodermal components and foci of immature tissue, consistent with immature teratoma. The authors state this is the largest liver teratoma reported and only the second adult case of immature liver teratoma. Eight months of follow-up showed normal CT and alpha-fetoprotein, and the patient is alive.

pmid-27307875.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の成人患者で、呼吸困難の悪化中に肺間質気腫が生じた症例報告。CTで絨毛癌の肺転移の周囲に間質気腫を認めた。バロトラウマは新生児に多いが、高い気道内圧や持続陽圧換気を受ける成人にも生じ、胸膜下ブレブから致死的な気胸まで様々である。肺転移に伴う画像所見として注目される。
pmid-27307875.summary_en: A case report describing barotrauma in an adult with metastatic choriocarcinoma. The patient, with worsening respiratory distress, developed pulmonary interstitial emphysema seen around choriocarcinoma metastases on computed tomography. The authors note barotrauma is typically a complication in neonates but also occurs in adults under mechanical ventilation with high peak pressures or continuous positive airway pressure. Complications range from subpleural blebs to life-threatening pneumothorax. The case highlights an imaging finding linked to pulmonary metastatic disease.

pmid-27582837.summary_ja: 19歳初産婦が妊娠25週で完全胞状奇胎と生存胎児の併存を示した症例報告。重症子癇前症のため胎児肺成熟促進後に帝王切開で妊娠を終結し、生存女児と奇胎組織が娩出された。産後に肺・腎転移を伴う子宮絨毛癌を発症し、化学療法に反応した。まれな双胎様妊娠の文献的考察と、母体合併症および栄養膜疾患に対する周産期の密接な監視の重要性を強調する。
pmid-27582837.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old primigravida at 25 weeks with a complete hydatidiform mole coexisting with a live fetus. Severe preeclampsia led to caesarean delivery after dexamethasone for fetal lung maturity. A live female infant and a separate mole mass were delivered. Postpartum, the patient developed uterine choriocarcinoma with lung and kidney metastases, which responded to chemotherapy. The authors review this rare twin-type gestation and emphasize close prenatal and postnatal surveillance for maternal complications and trophoblastic disease.

pmid-30532811.summary_ja: 縦隔前部の胚細胞腫瘍を有する14歳男児の症例報告。心室中隔の腫瘤を含む心臓転移により、多数の心室期外収縮と心室連発を認めた。化学療法4コース後、縦隔・肺・腎の腫瘍は縮小し、心臓転移は消失した。不整脈も完全に消失した。胚細胞腫瘍の心臓転移に伴う心室性不整脈に対し、化学療法が有効な治療となりうることを示した。
pmid-30532811.summary_en: A 14-year-old boy with a germ cell tumor of the anterior mediastinum had multiple metastases, including a mass in the interventricular septum, causing frequent ventricular arrhythmias on Holter monitoring. After four cycles of chemotherapy, CT showed regression of mediastinal, lung and renal tumors and disappearance of cardiac, hepatic and pancreatic lesions. Holter monitoring then showed complete resolution of premature ventricular complexes and ventricular runs. The report highlights chemotherapy as an effective treatment for arrhythmias caused by cardiac metastasis of germ cell tumor.

pmid-21124297.summary_ja: HDAC1は良性奇形腫を特徴づける新規マーカーとして提案された。増殖促進作用を持つヒストン脱アセチル化酵素(HDAC)は化学療法の標的として期待されているが、HDAC1の喪失が奇形腫の悪性化を促進することが判明した。そのため、HDAC阻害薬を抗がん剤として用いる際には慎重さが求められると論じている。
pmid-21124297.summary_en: This short EMBO J report identifies HDAC1 as a marker distinguishing benign teratomas. The abstract states that loss of HDAC1 promotes teratoma malignancy. Because histone deacetylases are pursued as cancer chemotherapy targets for their pro-proliferative roles, the findings caution that HDAC inhibitors could inadvertently enhance malignant teratoma behavior. The work links HDAC1 function to teratoma biology and suggests that its status may help separate benign from malignant lesions. The abstract is brief and does not specify the teratoma model used.

pmid-17916181.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマ14例を対象に、Fasリガンド(FasL)とその受容体Fasの発現を正常精巣と比較した。腫瘍ではFasLが増加し、Fasは減少していた。免疫組織化学では多くのセミノーマでFasLの強い陽性像が確認された。血清可溶性FasLは患者群と健常者で差がなく、腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性は示されなかった。
pmid-17916181.summary_en: This study examined Fas ligand (FasL) and its receptor Fas in 14 seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors and normal testis. FasL mRNA and protein were markedly increased in tumors, while Fas was reduced, and most seminomas showed strong FasL immunoreactivity. Infiltrating lymphocytes were Fas-positive. Expression did not correlate with age, TNM stage, or tumor size. Serum soluble FasL did not differ among seminoma patients, non-seminoma patients, and healthy controls, suggesting it is not a useful tumor marker.

pmid-18023547.summary_ja: 縦隔前部腫瘍127例を対象に、CT、MRI、両者併用の診断精度を比較した。全体ではCTがMRIより優れ、胸腺嚢胞のみMRIが優位であった。成熟奇形腫の正診率は、CT 58%、MRI 38%、併用78%であった。CTを第一選択とし、成熟奇形腫ではCT後にMRIを追加する方法が示された。
pmid-18023547.summary_en: This study compared the diagnostic accuracy of CT, MRI, and combined CT and MRI for 127 pathologically confirmed anterior mediastinal tumors, including 20 mature teratomas and 13 malignant germ cell tumors. CT achieved higher first-choice diagnostic accuracy than MRI overall, except for thymic cysts, where MRI performed better. Diagnostic accuracy for mature teratoma was 58% on CT, 38% on MRI, and 78% on combined imaging. The authors concluded that CT should be the primary modality, with MRI used as a follow-up for mature teratoma.

pmid-18179558.summary_ja: ドイツの9つの人口ベース癌登録のデータを統合し、精巣がんの亜型別発生率を解析した。セミノーマは10万人あたり5.1例、非セミノーマでは悪性奇形腫と胎児性癌が多かった。15～49歳で増加が顕著であり、小児では卵黄嚢腫瘍が大半を占めた。死亡率の低下は西ドイツで早く始まり、白金製剤による化学療法の導入時期の差が一因と考えられた。
pmid-18179558.summary_en: This pooled analysis of nine German population-based cancer registries (1998-2003) estimated subtype-specific incidence of testicular cancer. Seminoma incidence was 5.1 per 100,000, and among non-seminomas, malignant teratoma (1.6) and embryonal carcinoma (1.2) were most common. Incidence rose most among men aged 15-49. In children, yolk sac tumors predominated. Mortality decline began earlier in West Germany, possibly reflecting earlier adoption of platinum-based chemotherapy.

pmid-18304541.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者190例を対象に、精巣摘除術から1か月後、化学療法や放射線療法の前に抗精子抗体を調べた。ゼラチン凝集試験で11例(5.8%)が陽性であった。免疫ビーズ試験では精子表面への結合は一部にとどまった。精巣がん自体が抗精子自己免疫や不妊の原因である可能性は低いと結論された。
pmid-18304541.summary_en: This clinical study evaluated antisperm antibodies in 190 testicular cancer patients one month after orchiectomy and before chemotherapy or radiotherapy. Antisperm antibodies were detected by gelatin agglutination test in 11 patients (5.8%). Further immunobead testing showed sperm-surface binding in only a few of these patients. The authors concluded that testicular cancer itself is unlikely to be a cause of antisperm autoimmunization and infertility.

pmid-18407327.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍に由来する純粋絨毛癌の小腸転移例を報告した。治療中に上部消化管からの大量出血を来した。腸管転移と出血部位は開腹術によってのみ特定できた。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の潜在的な腸管転移を検出する方法を提案し、類似報告と比較して考察している。
pmid-18407327.summary_en: This case report describes metastatic pure choriocarcinoma of the small intestine arising from a testicular mixed germ cell tumor. The patient developed massive upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage during treatment. Intestinal metastases and the bleeding focus could only be identified at laparotomy. The authors propose an approach for detecting subclinical intestinal metastases of testicular germ cell tumors and review similar reports. The case illustrates a rare treatment-failure manifestation of a typically curable malignancy.

pmid-18436290.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清において、下大静脈を人工血管で再建した4例を報告。全例で術後早期の下肢浮腫を予防でき、3例では長期にわたり開存を維持した。1例は再発腫瘍による圧迫で閉塞が生じた。下大静脈切除が必要な場合、人工血管による再建は早期浮腫と慢性静脈不全の予防に有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-18436290.summary_en: This report describes four patients with metastatic germ cell tumor who underwent inferior vena cava (IVC) reconstruction with a prosthetic graft during post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The graft prevented immediate postoperative leg edema in all patients. In three patients, the graft remained patent for a median follow-up of 19 months without chronic venous disorders. The fourth patient developed graft occlusion from compression by recurrent tumor. The authors conclude that prosthetic IVC replacement may prevent early leg edema and later chronic venous insufficiency when IVC resection is required.

pmid-18449552.summary_ja: 下腹部痛と膿性下痢を呈した30歳の非妊娠女性の症例。左卵巣の良性類皮嚢腫が直腸に瘻孔を形成していた。超音波検査とCTで直腸を貫通する10cmの嚢胞性腫瘤を確認し、左付属器切除と低位前方直腸切除を施行。病理学的に良性類皮腫瘍と確定した。類皮嚢腫による瘻孔形成は必ずしも悪性転化を伴わず、自然破裂による内容物の漏出が原因となりうると述べている。
pmid-18449552.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old nonpregnant woman with lower abdominal pain and purulent diarrhea caused by a benign left ovarian dermoid cyst that formed a recto-ovarian fistula. Ultrasonography and CT showed a 10 cm cystic mass penetrating the rectum. She underwent left adnexectomy and low anterior rectal resection, and pathology confirmed a benign dermoid tumor. The authors note that fistula formation by dermoid cysts is not always linked to malignant transformation. They suggest spontaneous rupture with leakage of cyst contents may be a cause.

pmid-18506458.summary_ja: 2001〜2006年に手術を受けた卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の215例を後方視的に検討。CA19-9は39.6%、CA125は23.3%で上昇していた。CA19-9上昇例は腫瘍径が大きい傾向にあった。最も陽性率が高い腫瘍マーカーはCA19-9だが、単独での診断的価値は低いと結論。
pmid-18506458.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated serum tumor markers in 215 patients with ovarian mature cystic teratomas operated on between 2001 and 2006. Elevated CA 19-9 was found in 39.6% of patients and elevated CA 125 in 23.3%. CA 19-9 elevation was associated with larger tumor size, while age and bilaterality were similar between groups. The authors conclude that CA 19-9 has the highest positivity rate among the markers tested in these tumors. However, its diagnostic value is poor when used alone, given the limited specificity in mature cystic teratomas.

pmid-18506643.summary_ja: 分娩後の不正性器出血で受診した24歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍。肺、肝、腎、乳房、膵、副腎、甲状腺への多発転移を認めた。子宮摘出、骨盤リンパ節郭清、EMA-CO療法で転移は消失した。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が横ばいとなったためBEP療法4コースを追加し完全奏効を得た。多発転移例では手術と多剤化学療法の併用が基本と結論。
pmid-18506643.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with a placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) presenting with vaginal bleeding after delivery and multiple metastases to the lungs, liver, kidneys, breast, pancreas, adrenal and thyroid glands. Treatment included hysterectomy, pelvic lymph node dissection, and EMA-CO chemotherapy, which cleared the metastases. Because hCG plateaued, four courses of BEP salvage chemotherapy were given, achieving complete response. The authors conclude that surgery combined with multiagent chemotherapy is the mainstay for PSTT with multiple metastases.

pmid-18509663.summary_ja: 妊娠中に発見された両側卵巣類皮嚢腫の症例を報告し、妊娠第2三半期に手術を施行した。1918年以降の妊娠に伴う類皮嚢腫の報告を文献的に検討した。手術や麻酔のリスクと、未治療の付属器腫瘤のリスクの比較が臨床上の課題とされる。多くの文献は直径6cmを超える場合の手術が妥当としている。開腹術または慎重な腹腔鏡下手術が、第2三半期に行うのが望ましいと結論。
pmid-18509663.summary_en: This case report describes bilateral ovarian dermoid cysts discovered in a pregnant woman and surgically treated in the second trimester. The authors review the literature on the association between dermoid cysts and pregnancy, which has been reported since 1918. They note the clinical dilemma of weighing surgical and anesthetic risks against the risks of an untreated adnexal mass. Most references suggest surgery is more feasible when cysts exceed 6 cm in diameter. The procedure is usually performed by laparotomy or, carefully, laparoscopy, preferably in the second trimester.

pmid-18602201.summary_ja: 新生児の硬口蓋に発生した大型奇形腫の症例報告である。出生前に超音波検査で同定され、母体羊水過多を伴った。出生後に気道閉塞による呼吸窮迫をきたし、生後4時間で気管切開を要した。心奇形も合併していた。生後4週で腫瘤を摘出し、未熟な神経グリア組織を含む典型的な奇形腫の所見が確認された。
pmid-18602201.summary_en: This case report describes a large teratoma arising from the hard palate of a neonate. The mass caused maternal polyhydramnios and was detected prenatally by ultrasonography. Delivery occurred at 35 weeks, and the infant developed respiratory distress from airway obstruction, requiring tracheostomy at 4 hours of age. Major cardiac abnormalities were also present. The palatal mass was removed at 4 weeks, and histology showed typical teratoma components including immature neural glial tissue. Congenital teratoma is a rare malformation.

pmid-18648830.summary_ja: 下腹部痛を主訴とした37歳女性の、大網原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。骨盤CTでは両側卵巣悪性腫瘍と腹膜播種が疑われた。病理学的に卵黄嚢腫瘍と確定し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性であった。手術後にBEP療法を4コース施行し、治療後1年間無病で経過した。文献上4例目の報告であり、腫瘍マーカーの重要性を強調している。
pmid-18648830.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old Korean woman with a primary yolk sac tumor arising in the omentum, presenting with lower abdominal pain. Pelvic CT suggested a bilateral ovarian malignancy with peritoneal seeding, but pathology confirmed a yolk sac tumor with AFP staining. She underwent surgery and four courses of BEP chemotherapy, and remained disease-free for one year. The authors review the literature, noting this as the fourth reported case of primary omental yolk sac tumor, and emphasize the role of tumor markers and frozen-section analysis.

pmid-18657195.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマ51例と非セミノーマ61例を対象とした症例対照研究である。リンパ芽球様細胞株でアルカリコメットアッセイを行い、DNA損傷を評価した。テールDNAは非セミノーマで有意に高く、50パーセンタイルでのオッズ比は約3.3であった。非セミノーマの侵襲的な生物学的挙動の一因となる可能性が示された。
pmid-18657195.summary_en: This case-case study compared endogenous DNA damage between 51 seminoma and 61 non-seminoma patients using lymphoblastoid cell lines and the alkaline comet assay. Tail DNA was significantly associated with non-seminoma versus seminoma, with an odds ratio of about 3.3 at the 50th percentile. Olive tail moment showed a similar but non-significant trend, while tail length and comet distributed moment showed no association. The authors suggest that higher net endogenous DNA damage may partly explain the more aggressive biology and younger onset of non-seminomas.

pmid-18660793.summary_ja: 化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた化学療法抵抗性の転移性胎児性癌21例を対象とした。免疫染色でEGFRタンパクは43%で陽性であった。FISHではEGFR遺伝子増幅は1例(5%)、ポリソミーは71%で認められ、タンパク発現と有意に相関した。抗EGFR療法の標的となる可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-18660793.summary_en: This study examined EGFR protein expression and gene amplification in 21 patients with chemorefractory metastatic embryonal carcinoma of the testis who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy. EGFR protein was detected immunohistochemically in 43 percent of cases. FISH showed amplification in one case and polysomy in 71 percent, and protein expression correlated with polysomy or amplification. The authors suggest that EGFR may be a potential target for anti-EGFR therapy in this aggressive, treatment-resistant group.

pmid-18671454.summary_ja: 30か月の女児が同性思春期早発症と右卵巣腫瘤で受診した症例報告である。β-hCGとエストラジオールが軽度上昇していた。腫瘍は卵巣内に限局し、血管浸潤性の中間型トロホブラスト細胞とフィブリノイド沈着を認めた。術後に腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、24か月のフォローアップ中、無病であった。小児の性腺胚細胞腫瘍として稀に生じうると述べられている。
pmid-18671454.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-month-old girl with isosexual precocious puberty and a 3.5 cm right ovarian mass. Serum beta-hCG and estradiol were mildly elevated. The tumor was confined to the ovary, and histology showed intermediate trophoblastic cells with angioinvasive growth and fibrinoid deposition, consistent with placental site trophoblastic tumor. Immunostains were positive for cytokeratins, HLA-G, and CD146. Serum markers normalized postoperatively, and she remained disease-free at 24 months. The authors suggest such tumors can rarely arise as gonadal germ cell tumors in children.

pmid-18719855.summary_ja: ニーム由来のリモノイドであるニンボリドが、ヒト絨毛癌細胞株BeWoの増殖を用量・時間依存的に抑制し、アポトーシスを誘導することを報告したin vitro研究である。活性酸素種の産生増加やBcl-2/Bax比の低下、カスパーゼ-3の活性化を介して、ミトコンドリア経路によるアポトーシスが関与すると考察している。
pmid-18719855.summary_en: This in vitro study examined the cytotoxic effects of nimbolide, a limonoid from neem (Azadirachta indica), on the human choriocarcinoma BeWo cell line. Nimbolide inhibited proliferation in a dose- and time-dependent manner, reduced PCNA expression, and induced apoptosis with nuclear fragmentation. Increased reactive oxygen species generation was reversed by reduced glutathione. A decreased Bcl-2/Bax ratio, increased Apaf-1 and caspase-3, and PARP cleavage implicated the mitochondrial apoptotic pathway. The authors suggest nimbolide may have potential for cancer prevention and therapy.

pmid-18726607.summary_ja: 27歳女性の絨毛癌脳転移症例で、自然流産後1年に片麻痺で発症した。開頭術とEMA-EP多剤併用化学療法および全脳照射により治療し、治療終了2年後に健常な正期産児を出産した。多剤併用化学療法と選択的局所治療により妊孕性を温存しうることを示し、文献的考察を加えている。
pmid-18726607.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma who presented with hemiplegia from brain metastases one year after spontaneous abortion. She underwent craniotomy and nine courses of EMA-EP chemotherapy combined with whole-brain irradiation. She delivered a healthy term child two years after completing treatment, suggesting that multiagent chemotherapy and selected local therapy can preserve fertility. The authors also review the literature on brain metastases from choriocarcinoma and their poor prognostic implications.

pmid-18760971.summary_ja: 小児の両側精巣奇形腫に対し、精巣温存手術を行い成功した初めての症例報告である。小児精巣腫瘍は良性病変が多く、再発や合併症が少ないため、根治的精巣摘除術に代わって実質と機能を保つ精巣温存手術が有用であると述べている。両側例の報告はまれである。
pmid-18760971.summary_en: This report describes the first reported case of successful bilateral testicular-sparing surgery for benign teratoma in a pediatric patient. Bilateral pediatric testicular tumors are rarely reported. The authors note that pediatric testicular tumors are often non-malignant and rarely recur or cause complications, making testicular-sparing surgery an attractive alternative to radical orchiectomy for preserving testicular parenchyma and function.

pmid-18798762.summary_ja: 不妊症で精巣生検を受けた21例を、後に浸潤性精巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断された症例で再評価した。形態学のみでは35%、免疫組織化学(OCT3/4、PLAP、c-KIT)併用で55%にCISを検出できた。早期診断により4例で再度の精巣摘除を防げた可能性があり、不妊症患者の生検では免疫組織化学を必須とすべきと結論している。
pmid-18798762.summary_en: This study evaluated whether immunohistochemistry improves detection of carcinoma in situ (CIS) in testicular biopsies from 21 infertile men later diagnosed with invasive testicular germ cell tumors. Morphology alone identified CIS or invasive tumor in 35% of cases, while adding OCT3/4, PLAP and c-KIT staining raised detection to 55%, an additional 20%. Correct early diagnosis could have prevented a second gonadectomy in four patients. The authors conclude that immunohistochemistry should be routinely used on infertility testicular biopsies.

pmid-18799329.summary_ja: 1999年に米国で精巣がんと診断された702例のNCI診療パターンデータを用い、治療内容、ガイドライン遵守状況、生存率を検討した。セミノーマの多くは精巣摘除術と放射線療法を受け、化学療法の使用は病期とともに増加した。局在性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)では、精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けたのは25%未満で、約40%は精巣摘除術のみの後に監視を受けた。局在または領域病変の90%以上が生存しており、晩期障害の監視の重要性が示された。
pmid-18799329.summary_en: Using NCI patterns of care data for 702 U.S. men diagnosed with testicular cancer in 1999, this study examined treatment, guideline adherence and survival. Most seminoma patients received orchiectomy with radiation, and chemotherapy use rose with stage in both seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Among localized NSGCT, fewer than 25% underwent orchiectomy with RPLND, while about 40% had surveillance after orchiectomy alone. Over 90% of localized or regional patients were alive by 2004. Chemotherapy use varied widely, and the authors stress monitoring late effects of therapy.

pmid-18804932.summary_ja: 成熟型および未熟型の卵巣奇形腫について、CT、超音波検査、MRIの画像所見を総説した。卵巣奇形腫は卵巣胚細胞腫瘍として最も多く、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、卵巣甲状腺腫などの単一胚葉性奇形腫、未熟奇形腫を含む。超音波検査とMRIで特徴づけられることが多く、CTでは偶発的に発見されることが多い。各亜型の典型的画像所見を示し、若年女性における良性と悪性の鑑別に役立つことを目指している。
pmid-18804932.summary_en: This review compares CT, ultrasound and MR imaging features of mature and immature ovarian teratomas. Ovarian teratomas are the most common ovarian germ cell neoplasms and include mature cystic teratomas, monodermal teratomas such as struma ovarii and carcinoid, and immature teratomas. The authors note that these tumors are usually characterized by ultrasound and MR, while CT often reveals them incidentally. They describe typical imaging findings of each subtype to help radiologists distinguish benign and malignant forms in young women.

pmid-18807056.summary_ja: 良性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例で、骨盤内複雑腫瘤、大量腹水、CA-125の著明な上昇を呈し、卵巣癌との鑑別が問題となった。卵巣腫瘤の摘除後、腹水は速やかに消退し、CA-125も低下した。文献上、卵巣甲状腺腫の約3分の1で腹水を伴うが、CA-125上昇の併存は稀と報告されている。卵巣甲状腺腫は臨床的に悪性腫瘍を模倣しうることを示す。
pmid-18807056.summary_en: The authors report a case of benign struma ovarii in a woman presenting with features of ovarian cancer: a large complex pelvic mass, gross ascites and markedly elevated CA-125. Surgical excision of the ovarian mass led to rapid resolution of the ascites and a fall in CA-125. They review the literature, noting that about one-third of struma ovarii cases have ascites, while the combination with elevated CA-125 is rarely reported. The case shows that struma ovarii can mimic malignancy clinically and should be considered in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-18816804.summary_ja: 2歳女児で、下顎骨のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)産生性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した扁平上皮癌を報告した。頭頸部奇形腫の悪性転化は極めて稀で、本例は知る限り初めての報告である。外科的切除と化学療法を受け、治療終了後2年間無病で経過している。通常の性腺や仙尾部以外の小児胚細胞腫瘍における悪性転化を示す症例である。
pmid-18816804.summary_en: A 2-year-old girl presented with squamous cell carcinoma arising within an alpha-fetoprotein-producing mature cystic teratoma of the mandible. Head and neck teratomas with malignant transformation are very uncommon, and this is described as the first such published report. The patient was treated with surgical excision and chemotherapy and remained disease-free two years after completing therapy. The case highlights malignant transformation in pediatric germ cell tumors outside the usual gonadal or sacrococcygeal sites.

pmid-18818939.summary_ja: 45歳の経産婦で、左卵巣の類皮嚢腫に加え、大量腹水と腹膜播種を認めた。減量手術を施行し、病理組織学的検討で、浸潤性漿液性嚢胞腺癌と類皮嚢腫が混在せず隣接する衝突腫瘍と診断された。卵巣の衝突腫瘍は極めて稀である。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫様の病変が上皮性卵巣悪性腫瘍と併存しうることを示す症例である。
pmid-18818939.summary_en: A 45-year-old parous woman presented with a left dermoid cyst showing unusual imaging, massive ascites and peritoneal carcinomatosis. She underwent cytoreductive surgery, and histopathology revealed a collision tumor composed of an invasive serous cystadenocarcinoma adjacent to a dermoid cyst, without histologic admixture between the components. Collision tumors involving the ovary are extremely rare. The case illustrates that a mature cystic teratoma-type lesion can coexist with an epithelial ovarian malignancy and may be overlooked when imaging suggests a benign cyst.

pmid-18821067.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)108例を再発リスクに応じて層別化した。高リスク71例は精巣摘除術後にBEP療法2コースを受け、低リスク37例は観察のみとした。高リスク群の4例が再発し、3例は化学療法、1例は後腹膜リンパ节郭清(RPLND)で治療された。低リスク群に再発はなかった。高リスク患者への補助化学療法2コースを推奨している。
pmid-18821067.summary_en: This study evaluated a risk-adapted strategy for 108 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumour. Seventy-one were classed as high risk and received two cycles of adjuvant BEP chemotherapy after orchiectomy, while 37 low-risk patients were observed. Four high-risk patients relapsed, three with viable cancer treated by chemotherapy and one with mature teratoma treated by retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. No low-risk patient relapsed over a median follow-up of 26 months. The authors recommend two adjuvant cycles for high-risk patients, which compares favourably with surveillance or RPLND.

pmid-18839394.summary_ja: 成人の精巣と胚細胞腫瘍におけるCXCL12とCXCR4の発現を検討した研究である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍ではCXCR4が一貫して発現し、その分布がCXCL12発現部位と一致して再発パターンを説明しうる。病期I非セミノーマでのCXCL12発現は臓器内限局病変および再発リスク低下と関連し、再発予測因子となる可能性が示された。
pmid-18839394.summary_en: This study examined CXCL12 and its receptor CXCR4 in adult human testes and in germ cell tumours of adults and adolescents. CXCR4 was consistently expressed in testicular germ cell tumours and extragonadal primary tumours, and its distribution matched sites of CXCL12 expression, which may explain relapse patterns. CXCL12 stimulated invasive migration of a testicular tumour cell line in a CXCR4-dependent manner. CXCL12 expression in stage I non-seminomas was associated with organ-confined disease and lower relapse risk, suggesting it may be a predictor of relapse and help avoid unnecessary treatment.

pmid-18848787.summary_ja: 1965年から2005年に治療された病期II精巣セミノーマ106例を後方視的に検討した研究である。大多数は放射線療法単独で治療され、5年疾患特異的生存率は96%であった。再発は15例で、化学療法で治療された。病期IIAでは放射線療法が依然有効であり、病期IICでは化学療法が第一選択とされた。
pmid-18848787.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 106 patients with Stage II testicular seminoma treated from 1965 to 2005, with a median follow-up of 21 years. Most patients received adjuvant radiotherapy alone, while others received chemotherapy, combined treatment, or chemotherapy alone. Five-year disease-specific survival was 96%, but relapse-free survival varied by substage. Fifteen patients relapsed and were managed with chemotherapy, and ten died of disease. Radiotherapy remained effective for Stage IIA, while chemotherapy was preferred for Stage IIC.

pmid-18855944.summary_ja: 診断後平均11.4年の精巣がん長期生存者1336例を対象とした横断的質問紙研究である。過去1週間に24%が「かなり」、7%が「非常に強い」再発への恐怖を報告した。恐怖の強さは精神的苦痛、疲労、神経症傾向と関連し、生活の質の低下とも関連した。治療様式ではなく、神経毒性や身体症状が関連していた。
pmid-18855944.summary_en: This cross-sectional survey of 1336 long-term testicular cancer survivors, assessed about 11 years after diagnosis, examined fear of recurrence. Twenty-four percent reported quite a bit and 7% very much fear during the past week. Higher fear was associated with greater mental distress, fatigue, neuroticism, and lower quality of life and self-esteem. Neurotoxic side effects and somatic symptoms were linked to fear, while treatment modality was not. Current mental disorders were also associated with fear.

pmid-18926622.summary_ja: 2施設で化学療法後の残存腫瘤に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍152例を後方視的に検討した研究である。両側完全郭清と修正テンプレート郭清を比較した。修正郭清は直径5cm以下の第一次リンパ流領域の腫瘤に用いられた。再発は全体で5.2%で、修正郭清後の照射野内再発は1例であった。
pmid-18926622.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 152 patients with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumours who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for residual masses at two centres. Bilateral full-template and modified-template dissections were compared. Modified resection was used for masses within the primary landing zone that were 5 cm or smaller. Recurrence occurred in 5.2% overall, including one in-field relapse after modified dissection. Modified resection preserved antegrade ejaculation more often and did not appear to compromise oncologic outcome.

pmid-18937314.summary_ja: MAKEI研究グループによる頭頸部胚細胞腫瘍32例の解析。大半は出生前後に診断され、奇形腫が中心で一部に卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を認めた。気道閉塞を呈する巨大腫瘍が多く、周産期の気道管理が重要であった。再発は不完全切除例で多く、完全切除の重要性が示された。専門施設での多職種治療により、転帰は概ね良好であった。
pmid-18937314.summary_en: This MAKEI study group report analyzes 32 prospectively followed patients with germ cell tumors of the head and neck, most diagnosed around birth. Most were teratomas, with yolk sac tumor components in some. Tumors often caused airway obstruction and required early airway management. Relapse was more frequent after incomplete resection (5 of 10) than complete resection (1 of 16). Eight patients received chemotherapy, and one patient with yolk sac tumor died after multiple relapses. The authors conclude that multidisciplinary care at specialized centers, with prenatal ultrasound detection and planned delivery, yields favorable outcomes.

pmid-18950959.summary_ja: 妊娠19週の30歳女性の成熟卵巣奇形腫内に、異所性の下垂体組織と、リンパ球性下垂体炎に類似した炎症を認めた症例報告。炎症は下垂体組織に限局していた。著者らは、これが妊娠に伴うリンパ球性下垂体炎の前兆病変（sentinel lesion）である可能性を提唱している。
pmid-18950959.summary_en: This case report describes lymphocytic hypophysitis arising within a mature left ovarian teratoma in a 30-year-old woman at 19 weeks of gestation. The cyst wall contained a miniature anterior pituitary with normal hormone-producing cell types, pregnancy-related lactotroph hyperplasia, and prominent T- and B-cell inflammation with parenchymal destruction. No inflammation was seen elsewhere. The authors suggest this ectopic pituitary inflammation may be a preclinical sentinel lesion for classic lymphocytic hypophysitis, which occurs in pregnancy. It is the second reported organ-specific inflammatory process within an ovarian teratoma after lymphocytic thyroiditis.

pmid-18975137.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患95例と妊娠・非妊娠対照の血清中可溶性HER2およびTGF-β1をELISAで比較した研究。s-HER2に群間差はなかったが、TGF-β1はGTD患者で有意に高値であった（P<0.001）。TGF-β1は潜在的な予後マーカーとなりうるが、更なる大規模な検討が必要とされる。
pmid-18975137.summary_en: This study measured serum soluble HER2 and TGF-β1 by ELISA in 95 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease (55 complete moles, 32 persistent moles, 8 choriocarcinomas), 30 pregnant controls, and 22 non-pregnant controls. Serum s-HER2 did not differ between groups. TGF-β1 was significantly higher in GTD patients than in both control groups (P<0.001). The authors propose that serum TGF-β1 may serve as a potential prognostic marker in GTD, while noting that larger studies with more frequent sampling are needed to confirm this.

pmid-18987551.summary_ja: 縦隔の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する24歳男性が、化学療法中に血球貪食症候群を発症しました。重度の血小板減少のため脾摘が行われ、悪性組織球症に合致する所見が得られました。免疫染色ではCD68、CD163などが陽性でした。治療抵抗性で、診断から5か月後に死亡しています。
pmid-18987551.summary_en: A 24-year-old man with an anterior mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor developed hemophagocytic syndrome involving bone marrow and liver during chemotherapy. Severe thrombocytopenia and bleeding led to splenectomy, which showed erythrophagocytosis and atypical histiocytes consistent with malignant histiocytosis. Immunophenotyping showed CD68, CD163, CD4, CD45 and S-100 positivity. Cytogenetics were negative for i(12p). Despite therapy, the patient was refractory and died five months after diagnosis.

pmid-19002497.summary_ja: ドイツの全国規模の症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者8,498例とBMIを比較しました。全体では差はありませんでしたが、18〜29歳の若年男性では過体重と肥満が患者に有意に多く見られました。既報19編の結果は一致していません。非セミノーマとセミノーマで発症経路が異なる可能性も示唆されています。
pmid-19002497.summary_en: This nationwide German case-control study compared body mass index in 8,498 testicular germ cell cancer patients with 2,070 age-matched population controls. Overall BMI distribution did not differ, but in men aged 18–29 years, overweight and obese categories were significantly more frequent among patients. A literature review of 19 prior studies gave mixed results. The authors suggest nutritional factors may contribute to pathogenesis and that differing BMI associations may reflect divergent pathways for nonseminoma and seminoma.

pmid-19007977.summary_ja: 婦人科悪性腫瘍と妊娠性絨毛性疾患における腫瘍マーカーとしてのhCGを総説した論文です。過グリコシル化hCGは侵入奇胎と侵入性絨毛癌の指標となります。遊離βサブユニットやβコアフラグメントは多くの卵巣・子宮内膜・子宮頸部悪性腫瘍で産生されます。妊娠がなく明らかな悪性腫瘍もない低値陽性の診断にも言及しています。
pmid-19007977.summary_en: This comprehensive review examines human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) as a tumor marker in gynecologic malignancies and gestational trophoblastic disease. It distinguishes regular hCG from hyperglycosylated hCG, an absolute marker of invasive mole and invasive choriocarcinoma, and from the free beta-subunit and beta-core fragment, produced by many ovarian, endometrial and cervical cancers. The authors also address diagnostic confusion from persistent low-positive hCG without pregnancy or obvious malignancy, offering guidance for diagnosis and management.

pmid-19010497.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者74例と健常者35例の血清中遊離DNAをリアルタイムPCRで測定した研究です。遊離DNA量とDNAの完全性は、感度87%、特異度97%で癌患者と健常者を区別しました。従来の腫瘍マーカーが正常な患者でも有用でした。臨床病期III期で上昇が多く、従来のマーカーが上昇しない症例での補助的な指標として期待されます。
pmid-19010497.summary_en: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) was measured in serum from 74 patients with testicular germ cell cancer (39 seminoma, 35 nonseminoma) and 35 healthy controls, using real-time PCR for actin-beta fragments of 106, 193 and 384 bp, with DNA integrity expressed as the large-to-short ratio. cfDNA levels and integrity distinguished cancer from controls with 87% sensitivity and 97% specificity, and remained useful in patients with normal serum tumor markers. Levels were higher in stage 3 disease, suggesting value where conventional markers are not elevated.

pmid-19022490.summary_ja: 本研究は1995年から2005年に非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた341例を後方視的に検討しました。神経温存例136例のうち79%で順行性射精が保たれました。右側精巣腫瘍と5cm以上の残存腫瘤は逆行性射精と関連し、5年再発フリー生存率は98%でした。
pmid-19022490.summary_en: This institutional retrospective review examined 341 patients who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors between 1995 and 2005, including 136 nerve-sparing procedures. Antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 79% of evaluable patients. Right-sided primary testicular tumors and residual masses of 5 cm or larger were associated with retrograde ejaculation on multivariate analysis. Five-year relapse-free survival was 98%, suggesting nerve-sparing dissection offers functional and oncologic benefit in selected patients.

pmid-19023884.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト精巣セミノーマにおいて中心体キナーゼNek2が正常精巣や他の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に比べて高発現することを示しました。キナーゼ活性も上昇しており、腫瘍細胞ではNek2が主に核内に局在していました。Nek2の過剰発現は中心体の制御異常を介して腫瘍化に寄与する可能性があります。
pmid-19023884.summary_en: This study shows that the centrosomal kinase Nek2 is upregulated in human testicular seminomas compared with normal testes and other testicular germ cell tumor types. Kinase activity was also increased in seminoma samples. Immunohistochemistry revealed predominantly nuclear Nek2 in neoplastic cells, a feature confirmed in the Tcam-2 seminoma line. Nuclear Nek2 also marked undifferentiated mouse germ cells expressing OCT4 and PLZF. The authors propose that Nek2 overexpression may contribute to centrosome deregulation and neoplastic transformation in seminoma.

pmid-19023889.summary_ja: 8歳女児の卵巣奇形腫（悪性胚細胞成分の卵黄嚢腫瘍を伴う）の細胞遺伝学的所見を報告。GTGバンディングで3q27領域の異常を認め、同領域には複数のがんでLOHが報告されていることから、腫瘍抑制遺伝子の存在が示唆されている。単一症例の報告である。
pmid-19023889.summary_en: This case report describes cytogenetic findings in an 8-year-old girl with an ovarian teratoma containing a malignant germ cell (yolk sac) component. GTG-banding revealed a karyotype with a t(3;20)(q27;q13.3) clone and a del(3)(q27) clone alongside normal cells. Prior studies found frequent loss of heterozygosity at 3q27-q28 across several cancers, and the authors suggest this region harbors tumor suppressor genes. Because the findings come from a single patient, they should be regarded as hypothesis-generating.

pmid-19035442.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者738例と対照904例の家族歴を用いて、血縁者の悪性腫瘍リスクを検討。症例の第一度近親者では全悪性腫瘍リスクが上昇（RR 1.17）し、特に母方親族で消化管がんや男性生殖器がんが増加していた。精巣腫瘍患者の家族には、がんの集積がある可能性が示唆される。
pmid-19035442.summary_en: Using family history data from 738 TGCT cases and 904 controls in the STEED study, this paper examines cancer risk among first- and second-degree relatives. First-degree relatives of cases had an elevated overall cancer risk compared with controls (RR 1.17). The increase was driven largely by maternal relatives, with significantly higher risks of digestive tract cancer and male genital organ cancer. Paternal relatives showed reduced lung cancer risk. The findings suggest cancer aggregates within families of men with testicular germ cell tumors, though causal mechanisms remain unclear.

pmid-19037650.summary_ja: 32歳未経妊女性の卵巣腫瘍に多数の嚢胞内遊離小球を認めた症例報告。血清扁平上皮癌抗原の上昇を認め、腹腔鏡補助下左卵管卵巣摘出術が施行された。病理診断は著明な落屑性角化を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、画像所見が腹腔鏡下治療の方針決定に寄与した。
pmid-19037650.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old nulliparous woman with a large ovarian cystic mass containing multiple intracystic floating spherules. Serum squamous cell carcinoma antigen was elevated. She underwent laparoscopic-assisted left salpingo-oophorectomy, and histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma with marked desquamative keratin formations. The authors emphasize that careful imaging evaluation identified this rare pattern, enabling successful laparoscopic management of the mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-19041365.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の2つのゲノム解析研究を比較し、両者に共通する17遺伝子を同定。そのうちTPD52に注目し、免疫組織化学で検討した。TPD52は正常胚細胞や精細管内胚細胞腫瘍ではほぼ陰性で、セミノーマや胎児性癌の約3分の2で陽性だった。精巣腫瘍の発生への関与が示唆される。
pmid-19041365.summary_en: This study integrates two genome-wide studies of testicular germ cell tumors to identify 17 genes common to both datasets, including TPD52, JUB, NRXN3, C11orf70, and CADM1. Immunohistochemistry on a tissue microarray showed TPD52 protein absent in normal germ cells and most intratubular germ cell neoplasias. TPD52 was expressed in about two-thirds of seminomas and embryonal carcinomas, with intermediate frequencies in non-seminomas. The results suggest TPD52 overexpression is a candidate contributor to testicular germ cell tumorigenesis.

pmid-19046898.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の臨床病期I精巣セミノーマに対する管理法（放射線療法、サーベイランス、カルボプラチン化学療法）を概説したレビュー。標準治療は放射線療法だが、晩期合併症が課題。サーベイランスの再発率は15〜20%と高い。いずれも高い治癒率を示し、毒性と患者の希望を考慮して選択すべきとされる。
pmid-19046898.summary_en: This review examines management options for clinical stage I testicular seminoma after orchiectomy, including adjuvant radiotherapy, surveillance, and single-agent carboplatin chemotherapy. Adjuvant irradiation of infradiaphragmatic nodes remains standard, with relapse rates of 3-4%, but late complications such as cardiotoxicity and second malignancies are concerns. Surveillance has higher relapse rates of 15-20%. Carboplatin offers survival comparable to radiotherapy, but long-term relapse and toxicity data are incomplete. The authors conclude that all three approaches achieve high cure rates and that toxicity and patient preference should guide decisions.

pmid-19050878.summary_ja: 精巣がんの異種移植モデル(胎児性癌)において、シスプラチン投与後の早期治療効果をFDG PETで評価した前臨床研究である。FDG取り込みは2日目に一過性に上昇したが、これは細胞周期停止とアポトーシスによるもので、治療抵抗性を示すものではなかった。臨床では、PET上の早期の一過性の集積上昇を治療失敗と誤認しないよう留意すべきことを示唆している。
pmid-19050878.summary_en: This study used small-animal FDG PET to track early chemotherapy response in nude rats bearing human embryonal carcinoma xenografts treated with cisplatin. FDG uptake peaked on day 2 and fell by day 7, even though tumour volume remained stable. The early rise reflected transient cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis rather than refractory disease, suggesting that an early PET flare should not be read as treatment failure in testicular cancer.

pmid-19056194.summary_ja: 非胚細胞性悪性成分を伴う奇形腫(TMT)の男性14例を後方視的に検討し、CT・MRI所見の特徴を記述した研究である。肉腫が最も多く、大半の症例でリンパ節転移または遠隔転移がみられた。悪性転化を示唆する画像所見として、不均一に造影される軟部腫瘤、骨化性腫瘤、腹膜結節などが挙げられた。TMTは通常の胚細胞腫瘍に比べ予後が不良であり、早期の生検が重要と結論づけている。
pmid-19056194.summary_en: This retrospective study of 14 men with germ cell tumours containing non-germ cell malignant components (teratoma with malignant transformation, TMT) describes CT and MRI findings. Sarcomas predominated, and most patients had nodal or distant metastases. Imaging clues included heterogeneously enhancing soft-tissue masses, ossified masses, and peritoneal nodules. Nine patients relapsed, and only four were alive at follow-up, indicating a poorer prognosis than for pure germ cell tumours.

pmid-19066212.summary_ja: 陰嚢超音波検査で発見された24歳男性の触知不能な精巣腫瘍の症例報告である。根治的精巣摘除術により、セミノーマと胎児性癌の混合腫瘍と診断された。術後1か月でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇し、CTで多発転移が確認された。全身化学療法によりAFPは正常化し転移は消失し、18か月のフォローアップで再発はなかった。
pmid-19066212.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man whose non-palpable testicular tumour was detected by scrotal ultrasound. Radical orchiectomy revealed a mixed seminoma and embryonal carcinoma. Serum AFP rose after surgery, and CT showed multiple metastases one month later. Three courses of chemotherapy normalised AFP and cleared the metastases, with no recurrence at 18 months. The authors discuss the diagnostic implications of non-palpable testicular tumours.

pmid-19084853.summary_ja: MEDLINEの文献をもとに、停留精巣と精巣がんに関する5つの通説を検証しました。停留精巣では精巣がんのリスクが約2.75～8倍となり、12歳以降の固定術や未施行で危険性が高まります。持続性停留精巣ではセミノーマが多く、矯正例では非セミノーマが多いとしています。
pmid-19084853.summary_en: This review examines five common assumptions about cryptorchidism and testicular cancer using a MEDLINE literature search. Cryptorchidism raises testicular cancer risk by about 2.75 to 8 times, and orchiopexy after age 12 or no orchiopexy increases risk compared with prepubertal orchiopexy. Persistently cryptorchid testes are more likely to develop seminoma, while corrected cases more often become nonseminomatous. The authors suggest orchiectomy may be considered in selected patients aged 12 to 50 years.

pmid-19091344.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の精巣がん監視で用いられるCT検査による生涯の発がんリスクを推定しました。標準化されたファントムを用いたモンテカルロ法で臓器被曝量を算出しています。5年間の監視で、18歳では約52人に1人、40歳では約63人に1人の生涯リスクとなり、胸部CTを加えるとさらに上昇します。
pmid-19091344.summary_en: This study estimated the lifetime cancer risk from radiation exposure during CT surveillance after stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis. Using Monte Carlo simulation in a standardized phantom male, organ doses were calculated and risks were estimated. Following a 5-year National Comprehensive Cancer Network protocol, lifetime risk ranged from 1 in 52 at age 18 to 1 in 63 at age 40, rising with chest CT. Surveillance carried a relative secondary malignancy risk of about 15.2 compared with a single scan after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-19099312.summary_ja: 帝王切開時に偶然発見された、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の粘液性腺癌の症例報告。被膜浸潤を伴いIC期と診断され、補助化学療法を受けた。24か月以上無再発である。妊娠中の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化としては英文文献で3例目とされる。
pmid-19099312.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old pregnant woman in whom a mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from an ovarian mature cystic teratoma was found incidentally during cesarean section. Oophorectomy revealed capsule invasion. The patient was staged as IC and received adjuvant chemotherapy, and she remained disease-free for over 24 months. The authors report this as the third case of malignant transformation of a mature cystic teratoma during pregnancy in the English literature.

pmid-19099349.summary_ja: hCGの3種の分子（通常型hCG、過剰糖鎖型hCG、遊離βサブユニット）と、その測定法の特徴を解説した総説。絨毛癌や精巣胚細胞腫瘍などで産生される変異体の多くは、市販の多くの検査で検出されない。妊娠性絨毛性疾患や胚細胞腫瘍の管理における検査の重要性も述べられている。
pmid-19099349.summary_en: This review examines human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and its molecular variants: regular hCG, hyperglycosylated hCG, and the free beta-subunit. Each variant is produced by different cell types and in different malignancies, including choriocarcinoma and testicular germ cell tumors. The authors note that most commercial assays detect only regular hCG, which may cause test errors in malignancy. They also discuss clinical uses in early pregnancy and in managing gestational trophoblastic disease and germ cell tumors.

pmid-19100602.summary_ja: 以前の超音波検査で精巣微小石灰化を指摘されていた16歳男児が、転移性混合型胚細胞腫瘍を発症した症例報告。半年ごとの受診の合間に自己触診で発見され、肺病変とβ-hCG高値を認めた。小児の精巣微小石灰化では、診察、自己触診の指導、超音波検査を含む年1回の監視を推奨している。
pmid-19100602.summary_en: This report describes a 16-year-old boy who developed metastatic mixed germ cell testicular tumor after testicular microlithiasis had been detected on earlier ultrasonography. The tumor appeared between semiannual visits and was found by self-examination, with lung lesions and elevated beta-hCG at presentation. The authors present this as the first pediatric report of this association. They recommend annual surveillance for boys with testicular microlithiasis, including physical examination, repeated self-examination instruction, and ultrasonography.

pmid-19122459.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫（SCT）を有する胎児23例の後方視的検討。出生前診断、経過観察、分娩、出生後早期の転帰を報告した。腫瘍サイズが産科的リスクと分娩様式を規定し、週150cm³を超える急速な増大は周産期死亡の上昇と関連した。周産期死亡率は約43%であった。
pmid-19122459.summary_en: This retrospective review of 23 fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) reports prenatal diagnosis, surveillance, delivery and early neonatal outcomes. Cardiac output failure requires serial evaluation. Tumor size determines obstetric risk and delivery mode, and growth exceeding about 150 cm3 per week was associated with higher perinatal mortality. Maternal complications were mainly polyhydramnios and preterm labor. Perinatal mortality was approximately 43%, and maternal-fetal surgery was infrequent.

pmid-19122465.summary_ja: 精巣・卵巣などの性腺胚細胞腫瘍について、薬剤耐性と現行治療に焦点を当てた選択的総説。診断時に約40%が転移を有するが、シスプラチンを基盤とした多剤化学療法で高い治癒率が得られ、耐性は稀である。化学療法感受性の理論的背景と今後の治療展望を整理した。
pmid-19122465.summary_en: This selective review addresses germ cell tumors of the gonads, the most common malignancy in men under 50. About 40% are metastatic at diagnosis, but cisplatin-based polychemotherapy cures most patients, and resistance is rare. The authors summarize theoretical explanations for this chemosensitivity, including molecular features of malignant germ cell tumor cells and patient immunological and nonimmunological responses. They also discuss emerging therapeutic prospects.

pmid-19129708.summary_ja: 胎児水腫と重症心不全を伴う巨大充実性仙尾部奇形腫の妊娠24週症例。超音波ドップラー検査で同定した大血管に経皮的レーザー焼灼を施行したが、重度貧血を合併し2日後に胎児死亡した。外科的胎児治療は遅すぎる可能性があり、28週未満では貧血と心不全に対する胎児治療が選択肢になりうると考察した。
pmid-19129708.summary_en: The authors report a giant solid sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) with fetal hydrops and severe heart failure at 24 weeks of gestation. 2D and 3D Doppler ultrasonography showed great vessels arising from the medial sacral artery, which were ablated percutaneously by laser. Severe fetal anemia (hemoglobin 4.3 g/dl) was found during the procedure. The fetus died two days later, and pathology showed tumor necrosis and hemorrhage. The authors suggest that fetal surgery may be too late in such cases, and that treating anemia and heart failure may be preferable before 28 weeks.

pmid-19136758.summary_ja: 生後1か月の男児が、気道と心臓を圧迫する心膜内奇形腫で緊急受診した。麻酔および外科的管理により腫瘤を切除し、術後経過は順調であった。病理組織学的に稀な心膜内奇形腫と確認され、術後1年以上のフォローアップが行われた。縦隔外の胚細胞腫瘍として、乳児では稀な症例である。
pmid-19136758.summary_en: A one-month-old boy presented emergently with an intrapericardial teratoma compressing the airway and heart, causing respiratory and cardiac compromise. Prompt anaesthetic and surgical management allowed successful resection and an uneventful recovery. Histopathology confirmed a rarely occurring intrapericardial teratoma, which poses diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. Clinical follow-up exceeded one year after surgery. Such extragonadal germ cell tumors are uncommon in infants.

pmid-19136795.summary_ja: 70歳の閉経後女性が腹水と両側胸水、CA-125上昇を呈し、卵巣悪性腫瘍が疑われた。手術で両側性の良性非機能性卵巣甲状腺腫（奇形腫の特殊型）と診断され、偽Meigs症候群を伴っていた。腫瘤切除により腹水・胸水は速やかに消失し、CA-125も低下した。両側発生の稀少性と悪性腫瘍との鑑別の難しさを示す症例である。
pmid-19136795.summary_en: A 70-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with ascites, bilateral pleural effusion and elevated CA-125, initially suspicious for ovarian malignancy. Surgery revealed bilateral benign non-functional struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma, with Pseudo-Meigs' syndrome. Excision resolved the ascites and pleural effusion and lowered CA-125. The report highlights the rarity of bilateral involvement and the diagnostic pitfall of mimicking malignancy.

pmid-19142973.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫は新生児の良性腫瘍で、出生直後の手術適応となる。著者らは3例の仙尾部奇形腫から、nanog・Oct4・stellaを発現しαフェトプロテイン(AFP)やCEAが陰性の幹細胞株を3株樹立した。これらは神経、骨、軟骨へ分化し、ヌードマウスで奇形腫を形成した。腫瘍は原始線条の遺残に由来すると考えられ、ヒト胚性幹細胞に代わる細胞源となり得る。
pmid-19142973.summary_en: Sacrococcygeal teratomas are benign newborn tumours requiring surgery directly after birth. The authors isolated three stem cell lines from three SCTs, expressing nanog, Oct4 and stella while lacking alpha-fetoprotein and CEA. The cells differentiated into neuronal, osteogenic and chondrogenic lineages and formed teratomas in nude mice. They suggest SCTs derive from primitive streak remnants and that these cells may offer an ethical alternative to human embryonic stem cells.

pmid-19145040.summary_ja: 21歳男性が、下大静脈を閉塞する後腹膜腫瘍により肺塞栓症を発症した。血栓溶解療法とヘパリン投与で症状は一時改善したが、手術前日に留置した一時的IVCフィルター後8時間で致死的な大量肺塞栓が生じた。剖検で腫瘍は転移性絨毛癌と判明し、予防的フィルターが逆に再発を誘発した可能性が示唆された。
pmid-19145040.summary_en: A 21-year-old man developed pulmonary embolism from a retroperitoneal tumor obstructing the inferior vena cava. Thrombolysis and heparin partially improved his symptoms before urgent resection. Despite a temporary IVC filter placed the day before surgery, fatal massive PE occurred eight hours later. Autopsy identified the tumor as metastatic choriocarcinoma, suggesting that the prophylactic filter may paradoxically have precipitated the recurrent embolism.

pmid-19145204.summary_ja: 中間型栄養膜腫瘍（ITT）は絨毛癌と治療方針が異なるが、頸部癌と混同されやすい。15例のITT、11例の絨毛癌、10例の頸部癌を免疫組織化学的に解析した。CD10、HLA-G、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の組み合わせがITTの同定に有用で、CK5/6は頸部癌との鑑別に役立つ。一方、ITTと絨毛癌は免疫表現型が類似し、免疫組織化学のみでは区別できなかった。
pmid-19145204.summary_en: Intermediate trophoblastic tumors (ITTs) require different therapy from choriocarcinoma, yet they are easily confused with cervical carcinoma. The authors immunophenotyped 15 ITTs, 11 choriocarcinomas and 10 cervical carcinomas. CD10, HLA-G and hCG together aid ITT identification, and CK5/6 helps separate ITT from cervical carcinoma. However, ITT and choriocarcinoma share similar immunophenotypes and cannot be distinguished by immunohistochemistry alone.

pmid-19149985.summary_ja: 55歳女性が急性腹膜炎で受診し、緊急開腹術で膿性腹水と左卵巣の穿孔を伴う8×6cmの厚壁嚢腫が確認された。腹腔洗浄と左卵巣摘出術が行われ、術後経過は良好だった。病理組織学的に卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫と確認された。卵巣奇形腫の破裂が外科的急腹症として発症しうることを示す症例である。
pmid-19149985.summary_en: A 55-year-old woman presented with acute peritonitis caused by a perforated left ovarian cyst. Emergency laparotomy showed purulent peritoneal fluid, and an 8 by 6 cm thick-walled cyst with a minute perforation was found in the left ovary. Peritoneal lavage and left oophorectomy were performed, with smooth recovery. Histopathology confirmed a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary. The report illustrates that a ruptured ovarian teratoma can present as a surgical abdominal emergency.

pmid-19150559.summary_ja: 精巣摘除標本145例を後方視的に検討し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍における多巣性の頻度を評価した。多巣性は全体の33%に認められ、腫瘍径が小さい例やセミノーマ組織型で多かった。腫瘍径2cm以下の症例では63%に多巣性がみられた。臓器温存手術の適応となりうる症例にも、潜在的な浸潤病変が存在する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-19150559.summary_en: This retrospective review of 145 consecutive orchiectomy specimens examined multifocality in testicular germ cell tumors, defined by distinct foci, microinvasion, extratumoral vascular invasion, or rete testis invasion. Multifocality was found in 33% of patients, most often with small tumors and seminomatous histology. It was present in 63% of men with tumors 2 cm or less. The authors note that substantial occult invasive disease may exist in candidates for organ-sparing surgery, though sampling error is a limitation of their design.

pmid-19152879.summary_ja: 20歳未経妊女性が卵巣悪性奇形腫（未熟奇形腫）に対し片側卵管卵巣摘出術と化学療法を受けた。数年後に growing teratoma syndrome を発症し、妊孕性温存手術と化学療法で治療された。自己胚移植を伴う体外受精の後、無病の状態で健康な児を出産した。悪性胚細胞腫瘍の稀な転移性合併症の治療後も妊娠は可能であると結論された。
pmid-19152879.summary_en: A 20-year-old nulliparous woman with ovarian malignant teratoma (immature) was treated with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and chemotherapy. Years later she developed growing teratoma syndrome, managed with fertility-preserving surgery and chemotherapy. After IVF with autologous embryo transfer, she was disease-free and gave birth to a healthy child. The authors conclude that successful pregnancy is achievable after effective treatment of ovarian growing teratoma syndrome, a rare metastatic complication of malignant germ cell tumor.
