Two-year disease-free survival was 86% for retroperitoneal-only disease, but fell to 41% when more than four disease sites were present. Recurrences occurred in 23 patients, most often in the lung, mediastinum, and retroperitoneum. The five-year recurrence rate was 25%. The authors conclude that disease extent at presentation strongly influences outcome.

pmid-19373141.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性の転移性非セミノーマ性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の2例に対し、ゲムシタビンとビノレルビン（GV）によるサルベージ化学療法を行った症例報告。1例は良好な部分寛解を得て5か月間の無増悪期間を示し、もう1例は4コース後も安定し生存中である。前治療の多い症例に対し、GVは有効な化学療法レジメンとなりうると考察している。
pmid-19373141.summary_en: This report describes two patients with cisplatin-refractory, metastatic, nonseminomatous, extragonadal germ cell tumors treated with gemcitabine plus vinorelbine (GV). One patient achieved a good partial remission with five months of progression-free survival, while the other remained alive with stable disease after four treatment cycles. Patients who fail first-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy generally have poor outcomes. High-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support, paclitaxel, gemcitabine, and oxaliplatin have been reported as salvage options. The authors suggest GV may be an effective regimen for heavily treated, cisplatin-refractory patients.

pmid-19373472.summary_ja: 精巣がんなどの胚細胞腫瘍で、化学療法後に後腹膜以外に残存する腫瘤の管理を文献レビューにより検討した論文である。転移患者の最大35%で化学療法後に後腹膜外の画像上の腫瘤が認められ、後腹膜残存病変の約半数には奇形腫や生存腫瘍が含まれることを踏まえ、外科的切除の現在の役割を概説している。
pmid-19373472.summary_en: This literature review addresses germ cell tumor patients who still have residual masses outside the retroperitoneum after chemotherapy. Up to 35% of metastatic patients show extra-retroperitoneal masses on imaging after chemotherapy, and about half of retroperitoneal residuals contain teratoma or viable tumor. Based on a Medline search, the authors review the current role of surgical resection for these post-chemotherapy extra-retroperitoneal residual metastases.

pmid-19373473.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発(治療後2年以上経過してからの再発)について、発生率、初回治療の影響、治療成績をまとめた文献レビューである。5,880例のプール解析では非セミノーマの3.2%、セミノーマの1.4%に晩期再発が認められ、主な再発部位は後腹膜であった。単一部位の奇形腫は手術のみで治癒することが多く、生存腫瘍や悪性転化を伴う場合は集学的治療が必要としている。
pmid-19373473.summary_en: This review summarizes late relapse of malignant germ cell tumors, defined as recurrence two or more years after successful treatment. Pooled data from 5,880 patients showed late relapse in 3.2% of non-seminoma and 1.4% of seminoma cases, mainly in the retroperitoneum. Single-site teratoma is usually cured by surgery alone, whereas viable tumor or teratoma with malignant transformation requires multimodal therapy. Surgery is central, and treatment should occur in experienced centers.

pmid-19373474.summary_ja: 片側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往がある患者に対し、反対側精巣の生検を行うべきかを論じた総説である。こうした患者の約半数が反対側に二次性腫瘍を発症するとされ、その前駆病変として上皮内癌(CIS)、すなわち精細管内胚細胞腫瘍が想定されている。生検の賛否、手技と合併症、CISの進行を防ぐ介入法を検討している。
pmid-19373474.summary_en: This review examines whether the contralateral testicle should be biopsied in men with a prior unilateral testicular germ cell tumor. About half of these patients go on to develop a second tumor in the other testicle, thought to arise from carcinoma in situ (intratubular germ cell neoplasia). The authors present arguments for and against biopsy, describe biopsy techniques and complications, and discuss interventions that may prevent progression of carcinoma in situ.

pmid-19373916.summary_ja: 68歳女性の肺原発病変と脳転移の症例報告である。当初は肺腺癌の脳転移と診断されたが、後にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の著明な上昇を契機に後方視的に再検討し、免疫組織化学を併用して絨毛癌と卵黄嚢成分を含む原発性肺混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍が細胞診で誤診され得ることを示す症例である。
pmid-19373916.summary_en: This case report describes a 68-year-old woman with a left lower lobe lung mass and brain lesions. Initial fine-needle aspiration and craniotomy suggested lung adenocarcinoma metastatic to the brain. Later, markedly elevated AFP prompted a retrospective review with immunohistochemistry, leading to a diagnosis of primary pulmonary mixed germ cell tumor containing choriocarcinoma and yolk sac elements, with brain metastases. The case shows how extragonadal germ cell tumors can be misdiagnosed on cytology.

pmid-19386953.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの治療後、経過観察中に縦隔リンパ節腫脹を生じた男性2名を報告している。当初は転移性セミノーマと推定されたが、縦隔鏡検査と生検によりいずれもサルコイドーシスと診断され、不必要な抗がん治療は回避された。病期Iセミノーマでの補助傍大動脈放射線療法後の再発は稀であり、縦隔再発は認められるものの多くない。サルコイド様反応は再発を模倣しうるため、精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の縦隔病変の治療前には組織学的確認が必要であると著者らは強調している。
pmid-19386953.summary_en: The authors describe two men treated for testicular seminoma who developed mediastinal lymphadenopathy during follow-up, initially presumed to be metastatic seminoma. Mediastinoscopy and biopsy showed sarcoidosis in both cases, so unnecessary anticancer therapy was avoided. Relapse after adjuvant para-aortic radiation therapy in Stage I seminoma is rare, and mediastinal relapse is recognized but uncommon. The report highlights the need for histological confirmation before treating mediastinal lesions in patients with testicular germ cell tumors, since sarcoid-like reactions can mimic relapse.

pmid-19389346.summary_ja: Dnd1変異マウスにおいて、BAX依存性アポトーシスが初期の原始胚細胞の消失と精巣奇形腫の形成にどう影響するかを検討した研究。Bax欠損により胚細胞が部分的に救済され、混合遺伝的背景の雄では高頻度に奇形腫が形成された。胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝的モデルとして意義がある。
pmid-19389346.summary_en: The study examines how BAX-mediated apoptosis affects early primordial germ cell loss and testicular teratoma formation in Dnd1 Ter/Ter mice. Crossing with Bax-null mice partially rescued germ cells, and on a mixed genetic background these rescued males developed fully formed teratomas at a high frequency. XX germ cells in a testicular environment also formed neoplastic clusters like XY cells. The authors conclude that BAX-dependent apoptosis contributes to early germ cell loss and protects against testicular teratoma formation, providing a genetic model for germ cell tumorigenesis.

pmid-19390421.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍110例を対象に、新規幹細胞マーカーSALL4の免疫染色による診断的有用性を検討した研究。SALL4はセミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍などで高率に陽性を示し、卵黄嚢腫瘍ではαフェトプロテイン(AFP)やグリピカン3より感度が高かった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の感度の高い指標と結論づけている。
pmid-19390421.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study evaluates SALL4 as a diagnostic marker in 110 primary testicular germ cell tumors, including seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, teratomas and choriocarcinomas, and in a broad panel of non-germ cell tumors. SALL4 showed strong staining in intratubular neoplasia, seminoma, embryonal carcinoma and all yolk sac tumors, where OCT4 was often negative in yolk sac tumors. It was rarely positive in non-testicular tumors and was more sensitive than AFP and glypican-3 for yolk sac tumor. The authors conclude SALL4 is a sensitive and relatively specific marker for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-19395465.summary_ja: 縦隔原発セミノーマに対し、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン療法を完了した後に悪性転化を伴う再発を生じた症例報告。化学療法後の残存腫瘤は3cm未満で、PET上の集積亢進もなかった。代謝活性が低くても再発・悪性転化の可能性があり、長期の慎重な経過観察の必要性を示す。
pmid-19395465.summary_en: This case report describes relapse with malignant transformation in a patient who had completed bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy for primary mediastinal seminoma. The residual mass after chemotherapy was under 3 cm and showed no increased fluorodeoxyglucose uptake on positron emission tomography. Despite these favorable post-treatment findings, the tumor later recurred with malignant transformation. The case highlights that residual masses with limited metabolic activity do not exclude relapse and that malignant transformation can occur after successful chemotherapy, supporting careful long-term surveillance.

pmid-19395912.summary_ja: 原発性肺絨毛癌は極めてまれで診断が難しい疾患である。本報告では、血胸で発症し当初異所性妊娠と誤診された症例を提示する。手術に続き併用化学療法を行い、良好な治療成績を得た。絨毛癌は生殖管外からも発生しうるため、正確な診断と迅速な治療には慎重な評価が重要であると強調している。
pmid-19395912.summary_en: Primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma is an extremely rare, hard-to-diagnose entity. The authors describe a patient whose hemothorax was initially misdiagnosed as an ectopic pregnancy. Treatment consisted of surgery followed by combination chemotherapy, with a successful outcome. The report emphasizes that choriocarcinoma can arise outside the genital tract and that thorough evaluation is needed for accurate diagnosis and prompt treatment.

pmid-19396011.summary_ja: HIV感染を伴う妊娠性絨毛性疾患の女性78例を後方視的に検討した。HIV感染者の死亡率は33%、非感染者は13%であった。CD4数200 cells/μL未満では8例中7例が死亡し、200超では死亡がなかった。化学療法を受けた患者の死因は、広範囲病変、多臓器不全、化学療法毒性などであった。低CD4数を新たな予後不良因子として提唱している。
pmid-19396011.summary_en: This retrospective study of 78 women with gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) examined mortality in relation to HIV infection. HIV seroprevalence was 31%, and 15 patients died. HIV-infected women had higher mortality (33%) than uninfected women (13%). Among eight patients with CD4 counts below 200 cells/microL, seven died, while no deaths occurred above that threshold. Causes of death in chemotherapy recipients included widespread disease, multiorgan failure, and toxicity. The authors propose low CD4 count as a poor prognostic factor.

pmid-19396148.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍50例を対象に、幹細胞マーカーOCT3/4、SOX2、GDF3の免疫組織化学的発現を、形態学的に分類が困難な領域に焦点を当てて検討した。OCT3/4はセミノーマ、胎児性癌、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍に陽性であった。SOX2は胎児性癌と奇形腫の原始神経外胚葉成分に発現し、セミノーマや精細管内胚細胞腫瘍では発現しなかった。GDF3は卵黄嚢腫瘍で陽性であった。SOX2はセミノーマと胎児性癌の鑑別に役立つ可能性があり、分類困難な領域における胎児性癌の診断では高異型度の核所見が重要な基準となる。
pmid-19396148.summary_en: This study of 50 mixed testicular germ cell tumors examined stem cell markers OCT3/4, SOX2, and GDF3 by immunohistochemistry, focusing on morphologically difficult-to-classify areas. OCT3/4 stained seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and intratubular neoplasia. SOX2 was expressed in embryonal carcinoma and primitive neuroectodermal components of teratoma but not in seminoma or intratubular neoplasia. GDF3 was positive in yolk sac tumor. SOX2 may help distinguish seminoma from embryonal carcinoma, and high-grade nuclear features are key for diagnosing embryonal carcinoma in unclassified areas.

pmid-19398953.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣腫瘍発生における重要な因子としてDDX1を同定した。マウスおよびヒトのTGCT細胞株において、DDX1のノックダウンにより、cyclin-D2、CD9、GDF3、NANOGなど12p局在の幹細胞遺伝子の発現が低下した。DDX1はcyclin-D2のプロモーター領域を直接活性化した。DDX1をノックダウンしたTGCT細胞は、ヌードマウスで充実性腫瘍を形成できなかった。DDX1 mRNAはセミノーマと非セミノーマの両方の腫瘍検体で検出され、ヒト疾患における役割が示唆された。
pmid-19398953.summary_en: This study identifies DDX1 as a critical factor in testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) tumorigenesis. In mouse and human TGCT cell lines, DDX1 knockdown reduced expression of 12p-localized stem cell genes including cyclin-D2, CD9, GDF3, and NANOG. DDX1 directly activated a cyclin-D2 promoter region. DDX1-depleted TGCT cells failed to form solid tumors in nude mice. DDX1 mRNA was detected in both seminoma and nonseminoma tumor samples, suggesting a role in human disease.

pmid-19404923.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の患者163例で術前の血清腫瘍マーカーを後方視的に評価した研究。CA 19-9上昇は31.9%、CA 125上昇は13.5%に認められた。CA 19-9上昇例は腫瘍径が大きく、卵巣捻転率も高かった。CA 19-9は卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の診断に有用な指標となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-19404923.summary_en: This retrospective study of 163 women undergoing surgery for ovarian mature cystic teratoma assessed preoperative CA 19-9 and CA 125. Elevated CA 19-9 occurred in 31.9% and CA 125 in 13.5%. Elevated CA 19-9 correlated with larger tumor diameter and higher ovarian torsion rates (12.9% overall). The authors suggest CA 19-9 may be a useful diagnostic aid for ovarian MCT.

pmid-19415016.summary_ja: 鼠径ヘルニアの修復術中に発見された精巣傍のステージ1神経芽腫の8か月男児の症例。当初は精巣腫瘍としてセミノーマと病理診断され、根治的精巣摘除術後にシスプラチン併用化学療法が行われた。その後の再検討で神経芽腫と判明し、36か月間無腫瘍生存中である。ヘルニアや解剖学的変形がある場合、精巣傍腫瘍が精巣腫瘍と誤診されうることを示す。
pmid-19415016.summary_en: An 8-month-old boy with a stage 1 neuroblastoma of the paratesticular region underwent radical orchiectomy during hernia repair. Pathology initially suggested seminoma, and he received cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Follow-up showed a normal testis, and rereview confirmed neuroblastoma. He has been tumor free for 36 months. The case highlights diagnostic pitfalls when hernia, distorted anatomy, or inguinal testis cause paratesticular tumors to be mistaken for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-19415017.summary_ja: 生後6週の乳児で出生前に発見された副腎部の囊胞性腫瘤の症例。MRIで左副腎部の大きな腫瘤が確認され、副腎摘除術により成熟奇形腫と診断された。出生前の副腎部腫瘤は神経芽腫などが多いが、奇形腫も鑑別診断に含めるべきと報告している。
pmid-19415017.summary_en: This case report describes a prenatally detected suprarenal cystic mass in a 6-week-old infant that enlarged on postnatal ultrasonography. MRI showed a large left adrenal mass, and adrenalectomy with total resection revealed a mature teratoma. The authors note that prenatal suprarenal masses are usually neuroblastoma or adrenal hemorrhage, but teratoma should be included in the differential diagnosis. They conclude that total excision is indicated for histologic diagnosis.

pmid-19416404.summary_ja: 2歳男児の陰茎体部に原発した性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例。当初は外傷による血腫と考えられ緊急手術が行われた。全身に他の病変はなく原発性と診断し、シスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシンによる補助化学療法を4コース実施して完全奏効を得た。完全切除は不能だった。
pmid-19416404.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old boy with a yolk sac tumor arising in the penile shaft, initially mistaken for penile trauma and treated with emergency hematoma evacuation. Histopathology confirmed yolk sac tumor with no lesions elsewhere, establishing a primary extragonadal origin. The patient received four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin as adjuvant chemotherapy. Complete resection was not possible, but a complete response was achieved, and careful monitoring is planned.

pmid-19416574.summary_ja: 妊娠25週で胎児の巨大頸部奇形腫と診断された症例。超音波検査とMRIで気道閉塞が疑われ、EXIT(ex utero intrapartum treatment)により気道確保を試みたが、児は救命できなかった。巨大奇形腫は正常組織を大きく歪めるため、出生前診断されていても気道確保は困難であると報告している。
pmid-19416574.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman carrying a fetus with a giant cervical teratoma diagnosed at 25 weeks' gestation. Ultrasound and MRI suggested fetal airway obstruction. Delivery was attempted by the ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure to secure the airway, but despite extensive multidisciplinary planning, the baby did not survive. The authors conclude that securing the airway can be challenging because massive teratomas distort normal anatomy, even when prenatally diagnosed.

pmid-19417025.summary_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍の同所性マウスモデルで、スニチニブとシスプラチンの単剤および併用効果を検討した前臨床研究。スニチニブは腫瘍増殖を抑制し生存期間を延長し、シスプラチンとの併用でさらに効果が増強された。シスプラチン耐性の絨毛癌モデルでも効果が認められ、難治例に対する新たな選択肢となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-19417025.summary_en: This preclinical study evaluated sunitinib, cisplatin, or their combination in orthotopic mouse models of human testicular germ cell tumors, including a yolk sac tumor, two choriocarcinomas, and a cisplatin-resistant choriocarcinoma variant. Sunitinib inhibited tumor growth, prolonged survival, induced apoptosis and reduced tumor vasculature, and combination with cisplatin enhanced these effects. Growth inhibition also occurred in the cisplatin-resistant model. The authors suggest sunitinib may be an alternative for cisplatin-refractory patients.

pmid-19417664.summary_ja: 乳幼児・小児の奇形腫の診断、治療、転帰に関する総説。好発部位は仙尾部、性腺、縦隔、後腹膜などで、部位により臨床像が異なる。診断時年齢が独立した予後因子であることが示され、画像診断の進歩で早期診断が可能になっている。根治的治療は完全な外科的切除で、早期診断とフォローアップが重要と結論している。
pmid-19417664.summary_en: This review summarizes the diagnosis, management and outcome of teratomas in infants and children. Teratomas most commonly arise in sacrococcygeal, gonadal, mediastinal, retroperitoneal, cervicofacial and intracranial sites, with clinical behavior varying by location and size. Recent large case series identify age at diagnosis as an independent prognostic factor, and advances in imaging enable earlier diagnosis. The authors conclude that complete surgical resection is the definitive therapy, and that early diagnosis and meticulous follow-up are critical.

pmid-19420812.summary_ja: 日本で行われた全国調査で、若年女性の非ヘルペス性脳炎90例が解析されました。関連腫瘍は39％に認められ、報告された患者は全例が卵巣腫瘍を有し、奇形腫が最多でした。抗NMDA受容体抗体は多くの症例で検出されました。卵巣奇形腫を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎の重要性を示す研究です。
pmid-19420812.summary_en: A nationwide Japanese survey of acute juvenile female non-herpetic encephalitis identified 90 patients, with an annual incidence of 0.33 per million population. Most patients were female, and fever, psychosis, and consciousness disturbance were common, with respiratory failure requiring ventilation in 71%. Anti-NMDA receptor antibodies were detected in most tested patients. Associated tumors were found in 39%; all reported patients had ovarian tumors, and teratoma was the most frequent type. The findings link this encephalitis to ovarian teratoma, indicating that tumor screening and germ cell tumor evaluation are important in affected young women.

pmid-19420871.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍の治療として放射線療法を受けた女性が、22年後にS状結腸癌を発症した症例報告です。組織学的に慢性放射線大腸炎を伴っていました。放射線照射が二次癌を誘発した可能性が示唆され、小児胚細胞腫瘍の治療後に長期的な二次癌のリスクがあることを示しています。
pmid-19420871.summary_en: A 34-year-old woman presented with ileus and was found to have sigmoid colon adenocarcinoma. At age 12 she had undergone chemotherapy and surgical resection for a yolk sac tumor, and at age 13 surgery and radiation therapy for a local recurrence. The colon cancer arose 22 years after irradiation and showed chronic radiation colitis on histology. The authors suggest that radiation exposure may have induced the secondary colon cancer, highlighting the long-term risk of secondary malignancy after treatment for pediatric germ cell tumors.

pmid-19424465.summary_ja: 1984〜2004年にノバスコシア州で転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対し白金系化学療法を受けた129例を後方視的に解析しました。国際胚細胞腫瘍コンセンサス分類（IGCCC）の各群の分布と転帰は原報と類似していました。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、予後良好群の5年無増悪生存率が90％でした。IGCCCは集団ベースのコホートにも適用可能と結論づけています。
pmid-19424465.summary_en: This retrospective Nova Scotia population-based study applied the International Germ Cell Consensus Classification (IGCCC) to 129 patients with metastatic germ cell tumors treated with platinum-based chemotherapy between 1984 and 2004. Category distribution and outcomes were similar to the original IGCCC report. Among nonseminomas, five-year progression-free survival was 90%, 69%, and 55% in good, intermediate, and poor risk groups; for seminomas, the good and intermediate groups had 95% and 50%. The authors conclude the classification is applicable to population-based cohorts and has clear prognostic ability.

pmid-19425373.summary_ja: 1998年から2008年の間に、良性縦隔成熟奇形腫の患者6例が胸腔鏡下手術を受けた。切除前に嚢胞成分を20Frチューブで摘出し、胸腔鏡視野を広げた。著者らは、膵組織と密な癒着を伴う奇形腫の完全切除に有用であるとしている。平均腫瘍径は9.0cm、平均手術時間は143分、平均出血量は103mLであった。平均3.4年の経過観察中、合併症や再発はみられなかった。著者らは、良性成熟奇形腫に対する胸腔鏡手術は実施可能なアプローチであると結論づけている。
pmid-19425373.summary_en: Six patients with benign mediastinal mature teratomas underwent video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery between 1998 and 2008. Before resection, cystic components were extracted through a 20 Fr tube to widen the thoracoscopic field, which the authors say facilitates complete removal given the teratoma's pancreatic tissue and dense adhesions. Mean tumor diameter was 9.0 cm, mean operation time 143 minutes, and mean blood loss 103 mL. No complications or recurrences occurred over a mean follow-up of 3.4 years. The authors conclude thoracoscopic surgery is a feasible approach for benign mature teratoma.

pmid-19432296.summary_ja: 本研究は、1999年から2008年に根治的精巣摘除術後に術後補助カルボプラチン単剤療法を受けた臨床病期Aの精巣セミノーマ患者124例の治療成績を報告している。カルボプラチンは良好に耐容され、中等度の悪心以外に血液毒性で治療を要する重篤なものはみられなかった。平均37.5か月の経過観察中、3例（2.41%）に再発がみられ、対側精巣や他臓器の腫瘍は認められなかった。著者らは、カルボプラチン単剤療法を病期Aセミノーマに対する簡便で有効な標準治療として提案している。
pmid-19432296.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 124 patients with clinical stage A testicular seminoma who received adjuvant carboplatin monotherapy after radical orchiectomy between 1999 and 2008. Carboplatin was well tolerated, with only moderate nausea and no serious hematologic toxicity requiring treatment. During a mean follow-up of 37.5 months, three relapses (2.41%) occurred, with no contralateral testicular or other-organ tumors. The authors propose carboplatin monotherapy as a simple and effective standard for stage A seminoma.

pmid-19437039.summary_ja: 本研究は、2施設で進行純粋セミノーマ患者52例を後方視的に評価し、強化したシスプラチン併用化学療法（BEPまたはIBEP）の治療成績を報告している。治療関連毒性は中等度で、発熱性好中球減少症は13.5%にみられた。38.5%が完全奏効し、残存腫瘤はその後、手術、FDG-PET、または経過観察で管理された。3例の再発が救援化学療法などで治療された。著者らは、強化化学療法は放射線療法や標準BEP療法に対する明確な優越性を示さなかったと結論づけている。低容量病変は、放射線療法の代わりにBEP4サイクルで治癒しうる。
pmid-19437039.summary_en: Fifty-two patients with advanced pure seminoma treated at two institutions were retrospectively evaluated after intensified cisplatin-based chemotherapy (BEP or IBEP). Treatment toxicity was moderate, with febrile neutropenia in 13.5%. Complete response was achieved in 38.5%, and residual masses were managed with surgery, FDG-PET, or surveillance. Three recurrences were salvaged. The authors conclude intensified chemotherapy showed no clear superiority over radiotherapy or standard BEP, though low-volume disease can be cured with four BEP cycles instead of radiotherapy.

pmid-19437360.summary_ja: 17歳男性の精巣混合型悪性胚細胞腫瘍で、広範なリンパ節転移の内部に急速増大する奇形腫が出現した症例を報告する。腫瘍マーカーは正常化していた。抗血管新生作用を持つ4剤併用療法と低用量周期的化学療法により病勢は安定し、その後転移巣の広範な外科的切除を施行した。切除不能な増大性奇形腫に対する治療戦略として提示されている。
pmid-19437360.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old male with a testicular mixed malignant germ cell tumor and widespread lymph node metastases who developed a rapidly growing teratoma within the metastases while tumor markers normalized. Considered incurable, he received a four-agent antiangiogenic-containing regimen with low-dose cyclic chemotherapy, achieving sustained stabilization. Extensive surgical resection of the metastases followed. The authors highlight this approach for unresectable growing teratoma and call for further research.

pmid-19440001.summary_ja: 片側精巣がんと生検で確認された対側精巣上皮内腫瘍(TIN)を有する11例に化学療法を施行し、平均8.8か月後に再生検を行った。7例(64%)でTINが残存し、化学療法不応と判断された。不応例は局所放射線療法により救済され、以後再発は認めなかった。化学療法によるTIN抑制は一時的と考えられ、治療後約2年での再生検が推奨される。
pmid-19440001.summary_en: Eleven patients with unilateral testicular cancer and biopsy-proven contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN) received carboplatin or PEB chemotherapy, then rebiopsy after a mean of 8.8 months. Seven of eleven (64%) had persistent TIN and thus failed chemotherapy, with failure seen after two or three PEB cycles and after carboplatin. Rescue local radiotherapy, with or without partial orchidectomy, cleared the lesions without subsequent relapse. Chemotherapy appeared only to suppress TIN temporarily, so rebiopsy about two years after treatment is advised.

pmid-19447423.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者73例と健常者35例を対象に、血清遊離DNAにおける6遺伝子のプロモーター高メチル化を測定した。多遺伝子パネルは感度67%、特異度97%で、従来の腫瘍マーカー（αフェトプロテイン(AFP)など）より高い診断能を示した。腫瘍マーカーが正常な症例でも感度71%を示し、早期および再発の検出に役立つ可能性が示唆された。
pmid-19447423.summary_en: This case-control study of 73 men with testicular germ cell cancer and 35 healthy controls measured promoter hypermethylation of six genes in cell-free serum DNA using methylation-sensitive real-time PCR. Hypermethylation was far more frequent in patients. A multi-gene panel gave an AUC of 0.834, with 67% sensitivity and 97% specificity, outperforming conventional tumor markers (AUC 0.791). In patients with normal conventional markers, sensitivity was 71%. The authors propose cfDNA methylation as an additional diagnostic and recurrence-detection tool.

pmid-19453084.summary_ja: 4歳半の女児で、不完全切除された巨大な未熟腹部奇形腫と粟粒状の腹膜神経膠腫症を認めた。化学療法によりAFPは正常化し腫瘍は縮小したが、合併症で治療が中断された。その間に腫瘍が増大し腹水が増えた一方、AFPは正常範囲にとどまった。再手術で成熟奇形腫へ組織学的に変化し、腹膜病変は結節状に増大していた。インターフェロンで消退し、3年後にはガンマナイフで残存病変を治療した。
pmid-19453084.summary_en: A 4.5-year-old girl had an incompletely resected huge immature abdominal teratoma with miliary gliomatosis peritonei and elevated AFP. Two chemotherapy courses normalized AFP and shrank the tumor, but later complications interrupted treatment. During that period the tumor enlarged and ascites increased, while AFP stayed normal. Second-look surgery showed histological change to mature teratoma and nodular gliomatosis peritonei. Interferon led to regression of the growing mature teratoma and peritoneal disease, and gamma-knife surgery treated a residual mass three years later.

pmid-19453548.summary_ja: 2009年時点での精巣セミノーマ病期Iの治療選択を総説した。治療は後腹膜放射線療法、サーベイランス、カルボプラチンによる補助化学療法があり、放射線療法は成績良好だが性腺毒性や二次がん、心血管疾患のリスクがある。サーベイランスは治癒率をほぼ100%に保ちつつ治療負担を減らすため増えている。カルボプラチンは長期成績が不明で臨床試験に限るべきとされ、治癒を保ちつつ治療負担を最小化することが重要と述べている。
pmid-19453548.summary_en: This review addresses management of stage I testicular seminoma as of 2009. Seminoma is the most common histology of primary testicular germ cell tumors. Options are adjuvant retroperitoneal radiotherapy, surveillance, or adjuvant carboplatin chemotherapy. Radiotherapy gives excellent long-term results but carries risks of gonadal toxicity, second malignancies, and cardiovascular disease. Surveillance is increasingly used and keeps cure rates near 100%. Carboplatin outcomes remain unclear, so it should be used only in studies. The authors stress maintaining full cure while minimizing treatment burden.

pmid-19459873.summary_ja: 生後8か月の女児が左眼窩腫瘤で受診し、MRIで境界明瞭なほぼ嚢胞性の病変と示された。術者は病変内液を吸引して減圧し、その後全切除生検を行った。病理では、主に角化重層扁平上皮に覆われた嚢胞性の成熟奇形腫で、毛包、脂肪組織、グリア成分、脈絡叢様構造、軟骨を含み、3胚葉すべてが認められた。56か月時点で視力は6/9であった。本症例は、眼球を温存するためには剥離前の減圧が重要であることを示している。
pmid-19459873.summary_en: An 8-month-old girl presented with a left orbital mass that MRI showed to be a well-circumscribed, mostly cystic lesion. Surgeons aspirated intralesional fluid to decompress it and then performed total excisional biopsy. Pathology showed a cystic mature teratoma lined mainly with keratinized squamous epithelium, containing hair follicles, adipose tissue, glial elements, choroid plexus-like structures, and cartilage, with all three germ layers represented. At 56 months, visual acuity was 6/9. The case highlights decompression before dissection to preserve the eye.

pmid-19461507.summary_ja: 本病理学的研究は、ヒストロジーおよびケラチン、OCT4、PLAP、AFP、CD117、CD30、S100の免疫染色を用いて、ほぼまたは完全に壊死した精巣腫瘍11例を検討した。8例はセミノーマ4例、胎児性癌3例、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例に分類され、3例は分類不能であった。セミノーマには粗大な精細管内石灰化がなくOCT4とCD117が陽性で、胎児性癌には石灰化があり、ケラチン、OCT4、CD30が陽性であった。セミノーマと非セミノーマで治療が異なるため、著者らはこれらの所見が臨床的に重要であると考えている。
pmid-19461507.summary_en: This pathology study examined 11 almost or totally necrotic testicular tumors using histology and immunostains for keratin, OCT4, PLAP, AFP, CD117, CD30, and S100. Eight tumors were classified as 4 seminomas, 3 embryonal carcinomas, and 1 yolk sac tumor, and 3 remained unclassifiable. Seminomas lacked coarse intratubular calcifications and were OCT4- and CD117-positive, whereas embryonal carcinomas had calcifications and were keratin-, OCT4-, and CD30-positive. Because treatment differs between seminoma and nonseminoma, the authors consider these features clinically important.

pmid-19463624.summary_ja: 18歳男性の肺原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例。左胸郭の大部分を占める巨大な胸腔内腫瘤を認め、CTガイド下生検は2回とも診断に至らなかった。左上葉切除により術後に診断され、化学療法中にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は10,512 IU/mLから漸減した。術後10か月で無病生存。AFPの高値と胸腔内胚細胞腫瘍の診断の難しさを示した報告である。
pmid-19463624.summary_en: An 18-year-old boy presented with a huge intrathoracic mass occupying most of the left hemithorax. Two CT-guided needle biopsies were nondiagnostic, so the diagnosis of primary pulmonary yolk sac tumor was made postoperatively after left upper lobectomy with complete resection. Serum AFP was markedly elevated at 10,512 IU/mL and declined gradually during chemotherapy. At 10 months after surgery the patient remains alive and disease free. The report highlights AFP as a characteristic marker and the diagnostic difficulty of intrathoracic germ cell tumors.

pmid-19475354.summary_ja: 生後17日の女児が口咽頭からの突出性腫瘤、発作性の呼吸困難、哺乳困難で受診した。誤嚥性肺炎を合併していた。真性奇形腫と診断され、多職種チームによる連携した治療で良好な経過を得た。新生児の口咽頭奇形腫は極めて稀である。頭頸部の新生児奇形腫では気道評価と多職種による管理が重要であることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-19475354.summary_en: A 17-day-old female neonate presented with a protruding oropharyngeal mass, episodic respiratory distress, and feeding difficulty. The mass was complicated by aspiration pneumonia. The lesion was diagnosed as a true teratoma and managed successfully with a coordinated team approach. The authors emphasize that oropharyngeal teratoma in newborns is extremely rare. The case illustrates the need for airway assessment and multidisciplinary care in neonatal teratomas arising in the head and neck region.

pmid-19480263.summary_ja: 54歳女性が腹部膨満と不正子宮出血で受診し、8〜9cmの骨盤内腫瘤が見つかった。病理で卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じた原発性カルチノイド腫瘍と診断された。全子宮摘出術と両側卵管卵巣摘出術を行い、3か月ごとのコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による追跡が予定された。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は1〜3%とされ、低悪性度カルチノイドは稀である。早期の片側性病変では手術のみで良好な成績が期待できる。
pmid-19480263.summary_en: A 54-year-old woman presented with abdominal swelling and abnormal uterine bleeding, and an 8-9 cm pelvic mass was found. Histology showed a primary carcinoid tumor arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. She underwent total abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and was scheduled for surveillance CT at three-month intervals. The authors note that malignant transformation occurs in about 1-3% of mature cystic teratomas and that carcinoids of low malignant potential in this setting are rare. Surgery alone is considered sufficient for early-stage, unilateral disease.

pmid-19480264.summary_ja: 75歳女性が腹痛と腹膜刺激症状で受診した。開腹で右卵巣の大きな嚢腫が被膜破裂し、腹腔内に脂肪物質と腹膜炎を認めた。全子宮摘出術、両側卵管卵巣摘出術、部分大網切除を施行した。病理組織学的検査ではなく病理組織学により、卵巣類皮嚢腫内に高分化型の類表皮癌を認め、悪性転化と確認された。患者は追加治療を拒否したが、7年目のフォローアップで再発はない。類皮嚢腫破裂による化学性腹膜炎は稀で、悪性転化を示唆しうると報告している。
pmid-19480264.summary_en: A 75-year-old Brazilian woman presented with abdominal pain and peritoneal irritation. Laparotomy revealed a large right ovarian cyst with capsular rupture, fatty material in the peritoneal cavity, and peritonitis. She underwent total abdominal hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and partial omentectomy. Histopathology confirmed a dermoid cyst with a well-differentiated area of epidermoid carcinoma, indicating malignant transformation. The patient declined further treatment and remains in her seventh year of follow-up without recurrence. The authors highlight that chemical peritonitis from dermoid rupture is rare and may signal malignant transformation.

pmid-19481788.summary_ja: 正常初期胎盤と妊娠性絨毛性疾患の組織で、ラミニン受容体1(LR1)の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。全胞状奇胎と部分奇胎の脱落膜細胞では、正常胎盤より有意に強い染色性がみられた。奇胎、侵入奇胎、妊娠性絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の間で染色強度に差はなかった。LR1の発現は持続性の胞状奇胎後絨毛性腫瘍の発生と相関せず、病態への関与は示唆されるが予測因子とはならないと結論している。
pmid-19481788.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined laminin receptor 1 (LR1) expression in normal first-trimester placentas and in gestational trophoblastic diseases, including partial and complete moles, invasive moles, gestational choriocarcinomas, and a placental-site trophoblastic tumor. Decidual cells in complete and partial moles showed significantly stronger LR1 staining than normal placenta. Staining intensity did not differ among molar and neoplastic lesions. LR1 expression did not correlate with the development of persistent postmolar gestational trophoblastic tumors. The authors suggest LR1 may contribute to pathogenesis but is not a predictor of persistence, and recommend multicentric studies of invasive moles.

pmid-19483461.summary_ja: 30歳男性の巨大な腹部腫瘤の症例。当初は虫垂由来の腫瘤が疑われたが、陰嚢内に精巣がない所見から停留精巣由来の悪性腫瘍と診断された。開腹で腫瘍を摘出後、化学療法を3サイクル施行した。後腹膜リンパ節腫大は消失し、腫瘍マーカーも正常値まで低下した。
pmid-19483461.summary_en: A 30-year-old man presented with a large abdominal mass initially suspected to be an appendiceal lump. Examination revealed an empty scrotum without testes, which led to the diagnosis of malignancy arising in undescended testes. After laparotomy and mass excision, he received three cycles of chemotherapy. Follow-up CT showed complete disappearance of retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy, and serum tumor markers returned to normal levels.

pmid-19483624.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の境界悪性粘液性腫瘍を伴う腹膜偽粘液腫の2症例を報告。卵巣病変は虫垂由来の転移性腫瘍と形態・免疫組織化学的に類似していた。腹膜偽粘液腫の大半は虫垂の粘液性腫瘍に由来するが、奇形腫内の粘液性腫瘍が起源となる例はまれであると指摘している。
pmid-19483624.summary_en: Two cases of pseudomyxoma peritonei (PMP) associated with borderline mucinous tumors arising in ovarian mature cystic teratomas are reported. Both ovarian lesions were morphologically and immunohistochemically similar to secondary tumors of appendiceal origin, and the PMP was histologically similar to peritoneal adenomucinosis. The authors note that PMP almost always arises from appendiceal neoplasms, but a mucinous neoplasm within a mature cystic teratoma can rarely be its source.

pmid-19483625.summary_ja: 65歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に横紋筋肉腫様の悪性転化と対側の漿液性癌を認めた症例を報告。純粋な横紋筋肉腫が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた例は本例が初とされる。奇形腫の悪性転化は約2%と稀で、大半は扁平上皮癌であり、肉腫はきわめて稀である。文献的考察も行っている。
pmid-19483625.summary_en: A 65-year-old woman with a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary showed rhabdomyosarcomatous transformation together with contralateral serous carcinoma. The authors describe the clinicopathologic and immunohistochemical findings and report that this is the first case of a pure rhabdomyosarcoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma. Malignant transformation is rare, occurring in about 2% of cases, most often as squamous cell carcinoma, while sarcomas are very rare. The literature is reviewed.

pmid-19483626.summary_ja: 骨盤痛を4か月訴えた29歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に、低悪性度の乏突起膠腫を認めた症例。GFAPおよびニューロフィラメントが陽性で、Ki-67標識率は約3%であった。10q・19q13領域でヘテロ接合性の消失が認められた。卵巣発生例としては文献上2例目で、遺伝子異常が特定された初の症例とされる。
pmid-19483626.summary_en: A 29-year-old woman with four months of pelvic pain was found to have an ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Within its solid component, a low-grade oligodendroglioma was identified, positive for GFAP and neurofilament protein, with a Ki-67 index of about 3%. RT-PCR showed loss of heterozygosity on chromosomes 10q and 19q13. The authors note this is the second case reported at this site and the first associated with a characterized genetic alteration.

pmid-19483629.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍31例と非胚細胞腫瘍57例で、SOX2・NANOG・OCT3/4・D2-40の免疫染色パターンを検討した。組織型ごとに特徴的な発現プロファイルがあり、SOX2とD2-40はディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）と胎児性癌の鑑別に、NANOGは胚細胞腫瘍と非胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別に有用であった。分類困難例や類似腫瘍の除外に役立つと結論づけている。
pmid-19483629.summary_en: This study assessed SOX2, NANOG, OCT3/4 and D2-40 immunostaining in 31 ovarian germ cell tumors and 57 nongerm cell tumors. Each histologic subtype had a distinct profile: dysgerminomas were NANOG, OCT3/4 and D2-40 positive, embryonal carcinomas were SOX2, NANOG and OCT3/4 positive, and immature teratomas were largely SOX2 positive only. SOX2 and D2-40 distinguished dysgerminoma from embryonal carcinoma, while NANOG separated germ cell tumors from nongerm cell tumors.

pmid-19483681.summary_ja: 英国のTGCT症例730例と対照1,435例を対象にゲノムワイド関連解析を行い、約30万個のSNPを遺伝子型判定した。さらに症例571例と対照1,806例で再現解析を実施した。染色体5、6、12に強い感受性遺伝子座が同定された。染色体12のシグナル(オッズ比2.55)は、KITのリガンドをコードするKITLGに起因すると考えられ、KITLGは胚細胞の生物学およびTGCTの発症への関与が以前から示唆されている。
pmid-19483681.summary_en: A genome-wide association study genotyped about 300,000 SNPs in 730 UK testicular germ cell tumor cases and 1,435 controls, with replication in 571 cases and 1,806 controls. Strong susceptibility loci were identified on chromosomes 5, 6 and 12. The chromosome 12 signal, with an odds ratio of 2.55, is attributed to KITLG, which encodes the KIT ligand and has previously been implicated in germ cell biology and tumor pathogenesis.

pmid-19483682.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍277例と対照919例のゲノムワイドスキャンにより、12p22のKITLG内の7つのマーカーがゲノムワイド有意水準に達した。再現解析では、主要アレルのコピー数あたり約3倍のリスク増加が認められた。5q31.3のSPRY4近傍の変異も関連を示し、セミノーマと非セミノーマの両方で関連が確認された。
pmid-19483682.summary_en: A genome-wide scan of 277 testicular germ cell tumor cases and 919 controls found seven markers within KITLG at 12p22 reaching genome-wide significance. In independent replication, risk increased roughly threefold per copy of the major allele at two KITLG variants. Variants near SPRY4 at 5q31.3 were also associated, with about 40% increased risk per allele. Both seminoma and nonseminoma subtypes showed these associations.

pmid-19484739.summary_ja: 三次元パワードプラ超音波検査が、前方型の仙骨髄膜瘤に類似した1型の嚢胞性仙尾部奇形腫の正確な出生前診断に有用であった症例報告。仙尾部奇形腫は会陰や臀部へ突出する仙骨部腫瘤として描出されるのが典型だが、後方の嚢胞性腫瘤では誤診されることがあると指摘している。
pmid-19484739.summary_en: A case report describes the use of three-dimensional power Doppler ultrasonography to correctly diagnose a prenatal type 1 cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma that mimicked an anterior sacral meningomyelocele. Sacrococcygeal teratomas usually appear as sacral masses protruding through the perineum or buttocks, but posterior cystic masses may be misdiagnosed. The authors conclude that 3D power Doppler imaging helped distinguish the two lesions.

pmid-19486584.summary_ja: 22歳男性の縦隔に生じた巨大な感染性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例です。三尖弁逆流と重度の肺高血圧を伴い、開胸時に約1リットルの膿を吸引して腫瘍を摘出しました。病理組織学により良性嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されました。まれな合併症を伴う縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の管理を示した症例報告です。
pmid-19486584.summary_en: This report describes a 22-year-old man with a large infected cystic mediastinal mass associated with tricuspid regurgitation and severe pulmonary hypertension. At thoracotomy, about one litre of pus was aspirated and the tumour was excised. Histopathology showed a benign cystic teratoma. The authors highlight the management of this rare complication of a huge mediastinal benign cystic teratoma. The case shows the clinical importance of recognizing infection in mediastinal germ cell tumours.

pmid-19487841.summary_ja: 治癒しない肺動脈塞栓症の精査としてF-18 FDG PET/CTを施行し、肺動脈内の絨毛癌を診断した症例報告です。PET/CTが腫瘍栓や肺動脈の原発性腫瘍の早期診断に有用であることを示しています。肺動脈内に生じる絨毛癌はまれであり、肺の高代謝病変の鑑別に含めるべきと論じています。
pmid-19487841.summary_en: This case report describes a patient whose unresolved pulmonary embolism was investigated with F-18 FDG PET/CT, revealing a tumour within the pulmonary artery that proved to be choriocarcinoma. The authors show that PET/CT can help detect tumour thrombus or primary neoplasms of the pulmonary artery when an embolus does not resolve. They also note that choriocarcinoma arising within the pulmonary artery is rare and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of hypermetabolic pulmonary lesions.

pmid-19492242.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞における多剤耐性とJWAの役割を、エトポシド耐性株JAR/VP16と親株JARで比較した基礎研究です。耐性株ではJWA発現が低下し、JWAのノックダウンはエトポシド誘導性アポトーシスを減弱させました。JWAはJNK経路を介してP糖タンパク質を抑制することも示されています。絨毛癌の化学療法反応に関与する可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-19492242.summary_en: The authors examine how JWA influences multidrug resistance in choriocarcinoma cells, comparing etoposide-resistant JAR/VP16 cells with parental JAR cells. JWA expression was reduced in resistant cells, and its knockdown attenuated etoposide-induced apoptosis, caspase-9 activity and JNK phosphorylation. JWA also downregulated P-glycoprotein through the JNK pathway. The findings suggest JWA may contribute to chemotherapy response in choriocarcinoma. This is a laboratory study using cell lines.

pmid-19493258.summary_ja: インディアナ大学の精巣がんデータベースを後方視的に検討し、精巣摘除標本で純粋セミノーマかつαフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇を示した40例の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を解析しました。活動性腫瘍は37.5%に認められ、壊死のみの可能性は低いと結論づけています。AFP値は後腹膜の残存腫瘍を予測する因子ではありませんでした。
pmid-19493258.summary_en: A retrospective review of the Indiana University testis cancer database identified 40 patients with pure seminoma at orchidectomy and elevated serum AFP who underwent post-chemotherapy RPLND. Necrosis was found in 32.5%, teratoma in 30%, and active cancer in 37.5%, including yolk sac and embryonal subtypes. Teratoma-only findings were more common with AFP below 1000 µg/mL than with higher levels, though AFP did not predict persistent cancer. The authors conclude that necrosis alone is unlikely in these patients, and persistent cancer is more prevalent than in the general post-chemotherapy RPLND population.

pmid-19493328.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒトのセミノーマ、胎児性癌、およびそれに隣接する精細管内胚細胞腫瘍におけるエストロゲン受容体βサブタイプを検討した。パラフィン包埋組織を用いた免疫組織化学およびウェスタンブロットにより、全検体の腫瘍性胚細胞でERβ1とERβ2の発現が認められ、ERαは検出されなかった。隣接する前駆病変でも同様の染色が認められた。ウェスタンブロットでは59kDaのERβ1と53kDaのERβ2のバンドが検出された。これらの結果は、ERβが初期および後期の精巣胚細胞腫瘍においてエストロゲン作用を媒介しうることを示唆し、従来想定されていた抗増殖作用の仮説は支持されなかった。
pmid-19493328.summary_en: This study examined estrogen receptor beta isoforms in human seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and adjacent intratubular germ cell neoplasia. Using immunohistochemistry and Western blot on paraffin-embedded tumor tissue, the authors found consistent ERβ1 and ERβ2 expression in neoplastic germ cells across all specimens, while ERα was undetectable. Similar staining appeared in precursor lesions adjacent to tumors. Western blotting showed 59 kDa ERβ1 and 53 kDa ERβ2 bands. The findings suggest that ERβ may mediate estrogen effects in both early and late testicular germ cell neoplasia and do not support a previously hypothesized antiproliferative role.

pmid-19497179.summary_ja: 両側性に順次発生した精巣腫瘍の2症例に対し、凍結切片検査を併用した精巣温存手術を施行した。両症例とも以前にセミノーマで精巣摘除術を受けていた。病理では未熟奇形腫とライディッヒ細胞腫が確認された。両者とも局所再発なく、性機能が温存された。慎重に選択すれば安全で実施可能と結論づけている。
pmid-19497179.summary_en: This report describes testis-sparing surgery (TSS) performed on two patients with sequential bilateral testicular tumors. Both had previously undergone inguinal orchiectomy for seminoma and later developed contralateral secondary tumors during follow-up. Frozen section analysis of peritumoral tissue guided surgery. Pathology revealed immature teratoma in one case and Leydig cell tumor in the other. Both patients remained disease-free without local recurrence, avoided erectile dysfunction, and did not require androgen replacement therapy after 6 and 44 months of follow-up. The authors conclude TSS with frozen section guidance may be safe and feasible in carefully selected patients.

pmid-19501893.summary_ja: SEERデータベースの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍882例を対象に、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の周術期死亡率を検討した。全体の死亡率は0.8%であった。年齢および病期の上昇とともに死亡率は増加し、転移性疾患では6.0%であった。高リスク症例は専門施設で行うべきとされている。
pmid-19501893.summary_en: This population-based study used SEER data from 882 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors who underwent retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy between 1988 and 1997. The authors examined whether perioperative mortality rates from a high-volume center were generalizable. Overall perioperative mortality was 0.8%. Mortality increased with age and with clinical stage, reaching 6.0% in patients with distant metastatic disease. The authors conclude RPLND carries low mortality in localized and regional disease, but high-risk patients with metastases should ideally be treated at centers of excellence.

pmid-19505997.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるKLF4(多能性転写因子)を検討した。179例の精巣試料のマイクロアレイデータ解析では、正常精巣と比べセミノーマでKLF4 mRNAが高発現していた。免疫組織化学により、未分類精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCNU)およびセミノーマで強いKLF4発現が確認された一方、正常精原細胞と胎児精巣では異なるパターンが認められた。正常精原細胞はKLF4を発現しないため、著者らはKLF4がIGCNUの発生・腫瘍形成能の維持に寄与し、セミノーマの悪性度にも関与しうると提案している。
pmid-19505997.summary_en: This study investigated KLF4, a pluripotency transcription factor, in human testicular germ cell tumors. Analysis of microarray data from 179 testicular samples showed higher KLF4 mRNA in seminoma than in normal testis. Immunohistochemistry confirmed strong KLF4 expression in intratubular germ cell neoplasia unclassified (IGCNU) and seminoma, while normal spermatogonia and fetal testes showed different patterns. Since normal spermatogonia do not express KLF4, the authors propose that KLF4 may help maintain the developmental and tumorigenic potential of IGCNU and contribute to seminoma malignancy.

pmid-19506817.summary_ja: ドイツ精巣がん研究グループの675例を解析し、病期Iセミノーマの放射線療法後のフォローアップの有効性を検討した。再発の多くは症状や診察で判明し、腹部骨盤画像検査の検出率が最も高かった。腹部エコーが最も費用対効果に優れ、CTが費用の約6割を占めた。3年以降の技術的検査や胸部スクリーニングの有用性は乏しいと結論づけられた。
pmid-19506817.summary_en: This German Testicular Cancer Study Group analysis followed 675 patients with stage I seminoma after paraaortic radiotherapy, with a median follow-up of 61 months. Of 26 relapses, 14 were detected through symptoms or physical examination. Abdominopelvic imaging detected relapse most effectively, while thoracic imaging and marker analysis were inefficient. Abdominal sonography was the most cost-efficient test, and CT accounted for about 60% of costs. No predictive risk factors were identified. The authors concluded that technical follow-up beyond year three and routine chest screening offer little value.

pmid-19513074.summary_ja: 蛍光タンパク質で標識したマウスES細胞を精細管へ移植し、精巣の胚細胞腫瘍モデルを作成した研究である。移植細胞は胚細胞へ分化せず、浸潤性の胎児性癌細胞として振る舞い奇形癌を形成した。腫瘍の血管網は極めて不規則で、一部の新生血管は移植細胞に由来していた。浸潤と進展の機序を生体内で研究できる新たなモデルとなる。
pmid-19513074.summary_en: The authors transplanted green fluorescent protein-labelled embryonic stem cells into mouse seminiferous tubules as a model of testicular germinal tumours. The transplanted cells did not differentiate into germ cells but behaved as invasive embryonal carcinoma cells, forming teratocarcinomas. The vasculature of these tumours was highly disorganised, and some neoplastic capillaries were derived from the transplanted cells. The model recapitulates early teratocarcinoma development and may enable in vivo study of the invasion and progression of experimental germinal tumours.

pmid-19517114.summary_ja: 本総説は、臨床病期Iセミノーマに対する積極的監視を、補助療法を受けない心理的負担に耐えられる患者にとって最適な選択肢と位置づけている。監視群では少数が再発するが多くは救済可能で、補助療法と同等の成績が得られる一方、補助療法は多くの患者に不要な短期・長期の有害事象をもたらすと論じている。
pmid-19517114.summary_en: This review argues that active surveillance is the preferred approach for compliant patients with clinical stage I seminoma who can tolerate the psychological burden of forgoing adjuvant treatment. Although a small proportion of patients on surveillance relapse, most are salvaged with outcomes equivalent to those receiving adjuvant therapy, whereas adjuvant treatment exposes most men to unnecessary short- and long-term toxicity. The authors review controversies in managing clinical stage I seminoma and outline the evidence supporting surveillance.

pmid-19517692.summary_ja: 1994年から2007年にシェフィールドで化学療法を受けた350例を後方視的研究として検討し、中止時にβ-hCGが持続的に上昇していた17例を解析した。16例は追加治療なしにβ-hCGが検出されなくなり、突然再上昇した1例のみ根治的化学療法を要した。40 IU/L以下の持続的低値上昇には保存的で慎重な経過観察が妥当と結論づけている。
pmid-19517692.summary_en: This retrospective study of 350 patients treated with chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia in Sheffield between 1994 and 2007 examined 17 patients whose serum beta-hCG remained elevated when chemotherapy was stopped. Sixteen became undetectable without further treatment, and only one required curative chemotherapy after a sudden rise. The authors conclude that a conservative, watchful approach is reasonable for persistent low-level beta-hCG elevation up to 40 IU/L after chemotherapy.

pmid-19521124.summary_ja: 74歳女性が下腹部痛と右側腹部の腫瘤で受診し、超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影で右卵巣の不均一な腫瘍が認められた。子宮全摘および両側付属器切除術が施行され、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じた高分化型皮脂腺癌と組織学的に診断された。極めてまれな悪性転化であり、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の他の悪性腫瘍との鑑別診断が重要であると述べている。
pmid-19521124.summary_en: A 74-year-old woman presented with lower abdominal pain and a right abdominal mass. Ultrasound and CT showed a heterogeneous right ovarian tumor, which was treated with total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Histology revealed a well-differentiated sebaceous carcinoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma, a very rare malignant transformation. The authors emphasize that differential diagnosis from other malignancies in mature cystic teratomas is important for treatment and prognosis.

pmid-19522374.summary_ja: 1993年から2002年にスロバキアで診断された1,805例(精巣がん1,832件)を後方視的研究として解析した全国規模の研究である。年齢調整罹患率は10万人あたり6.2、死亡率は0.5であった。両側発生は3%で、大半は異時性に生じ、鼠径ヘルニアが最も多いリスク因子であった。5年生存率は96.2%であった。
pmid-19522374.summary_en: This national retrospective study analyzed 1,805 patients with 1,832 testicular cancers diagnosed in Slovakia from 1993 to 2002. Age-adjusted incidence was 6.2 per 100,000 and mortality 0.5 per 100,000. Bilateral disease occurred in 3%, mostly metachronously, with inguinal hernia as the most frequent risk factor. Five-year survival was 96.2%, and the authors call for further epidemiologic studies to identify risk factors.

pmid-19523243.summary_ja: 馬蹄腎の50歳女性が、多房性嚢胞性腎病変に対して腎部分切除術を受けた。病理学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の中に中分化型腺癌とカルチノイド腫瘍が併存しており、このような組み合わせの報告は初めてである。補助療法は受けず、術後6か月時点で無病生存している。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は見落としを防ぐため十分な切片作成が必要と強調している。
pmid-19523243.summary_en: A 50-year-old woman with horseshoe kidney underwent partial nephrectomy for a multiseptated cystic renal lesion. Pathology revealed a mature cystic teratoma containing coexisting moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma and carcinoid tumor, the first such combination reported. Immunohistochemistry supported the component classifications. The patient received no adjuvant therapy and remained free of disease six months after surgery. The authors stress thorough sectioning of mature cystic teratomas to avoid missing additional neoplasms.

pmid-19524139.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるエストロゲン受容体(ERα・ERβ)と共役因子SNURF/RNF4の発現を検討した。全組織型でこれらが発現しており、ジャーミノーマ由来のNCC-IT細胞ではエストラジオールがそれらのmRNA発現を増加させ、抗エストロゲン剤で抑制された。増殖への影響は認められず、エストロゲンシグナルが関与する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-19524139.summary_en: This study examined estrogen receptors ERalpha and ERbeta and the co-regulator SNURF/RNF4 in malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. All subtypes expressed these proteins. In the human germinoma-derived NCC-IT cell line, estradiol upregulated ERalpha, ERbeta and SNURF mRNA, an effect blocked by the antiestrogen ICI 182,780, but neither estradiol nor the antiestrogen affected cell proliferation. The authors suggest estrogen signaling plays a role in these tumors.

pmid-19524711.summary_ja: 2か月齢男児の腹腔内精巣に発生した成熟奇形腫の症例報告。左側の大きな腹部腫瘤と触知しない左精巣が主訴であった。超音波検査とCTで石灰化を伴う嚢胞性腫瘍が確認され、腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲内であった。外科的切除で完全摘出され、3年間のフォローアップで再発はなかった。小児の腹腔内精巣腫瘍30例の文献的検討も行われ、思春期前例の組織像の特徴が示された。
pmid-19524711.summary_en: This case report describes a mature teratoma arising from an intraabdominal testis in a 2-month-old boy who presented with a large abdominal mass and a nonpalpable left testis. Ultrasound and computed tomography showed a cystic lesion with focal calcification, while tumor markers were normal. Surgical resection completely removed the tumor, and no recurrence was seen after three years of follow-up. The authors also reviewed 30 pediatric intraabdominal testicular tumors, finding that histology in prepubertal cases differs from that of childhood descended-testis tumors and postpubertal intraabdominal tumors.

pmid-19525149.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍により思春期早発症を呈した7歳男児の症例。超音波検査で左精巣に0.9cmの不均一な腫瘤を認め、精巣摘除術で未分類の混合性胚細胞・性索間質腫瘍と診断された。腫瘍性セルトリ細胞とセミノーマ様の胚細胞からなり、胚細胞はc-kitと胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼを発現し増殖活性が高く、DNA異数性を示した。術後にテストステロンは思春期前の値に低下し、思春期の進行は停止した。
pmid-19525149.summary_en: This report describes a 7-year-old boy with precocious puberty caused by a testicular tumor. Ultrasonography revealed a 0.9-cm heterogeneous left testicular mass, and orchiectomy showed an unclassified mixed germ cell sex cord-stromal tumor with neoplastic Sertoli cells and seminoma-like germ cells. The germ cells expressed c-kit and placental alkaline phosphatase, had a high proliferative rate, and were aneuploid. After orchiectomy, testosterone fell to prepubertal levels and puberty halted. The authors present this as a novel cause of precocious puberty.

pmid-19527404.summary_ja: 10歳女児の純粋な非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌の症例報告。診断が難しい極めて稀な悪性腫瘍である。保存的手術とシスプラチンを基にした化学療法に良好に反応した。臨床像、鑑別診断、治療経過を記述し、英語文献で報告された約38例の非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌をまとめて検討している。若年患者では妊孕性温存手術と白金製剤併用の化学療法が有用である可能性を示唆する。
pmid-19527404.summary_en: This case report describes a 10-year-old girl with pure nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma, a very rare and diagnostically challenging malignancy. She responded well to conservative surgery followed by cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The authors describe clinical features, differential diagnosis, and management, and review approximately 38 authenticated nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma cases reported in the English literature. The case adds to limited pediatric evidence and suggests that fertility-sparing surgery with platinum-based chemotherapy may be useful in selected young patients.

pmid-19530557.summary_ja: 分娩後の絨毛癌が左第3指に皮膚転移したまれな症例報告。妊娠性絨毛性疾患は一般に化学療法によく反応し治癒率は約90%とされるが、正期産後の絨毛癌は予後不良で死亡率は33〜40%と報告される。単剤化学療法で治療不応となる危険因子も複数指摘されている。皮膚転移は稀な病像であり、臨床家が認識すべき所見として提示されている。
pmid-19530557.summary_en: This case report describes cutaneous metastasis of postpartum choriocarcinoma involving the left third digit. The authors note that gestational trophoblastic disease generally responds well to chemotherapy, with cure rates around 90%, but that choriocarcinoma following term pregnancy is rare and carries a poor prognosis, with mortality reported between 33 and 40 percent. Several factors identify patients at high risk of treatment failure with single-agent chemotherapy. The report highlights skin involvement as an unusual presentation of metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-19531589.summary_ja: 2人の姉妹にみられたXY性転換と純粋性腺形成不全の家族例で、新規のSRYフレームシフト変異(c.71delA)を報告。父親は尿道下裂、停留精巣、精巣セミノーマ、乏精子症を有し、精巣発生異常症候群と診断された。変異は血液と腫瘍でモザイク型として検出された。体細胞および生殖細胞のモザイク現象が浸透度の差を説明しうると考察され、SRY変異と精巣発生異常症候群の関連を初めて示したとされる。
pmid-19531589.summary_en: This report describes a family with a novel frameshift SRY mutation, c.71delA, found in two sisters with XY sex reversal and pure gonadal dysgenesis but absent in their phenotypically normal brother. The father had hypospadias, cryptorchidism, testicular seminoma, and oligoasthenozoospermia, a combination termed testicular dysgenesis syndrome. He carried the mutation in mosaic form in blood and tumor. The authors propose that somatic and germline mosaicism may explain variable penetrance, and this is the first report linking an SRY mutation to testicular dysgenesis syndrome.

pmid-19537902.summary_ja: チェンマイ大学病院で1998年から2008年に単純経腹子宮摘出術を受けた妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の女性18例の後方視的検討。適応は子宮内限局の疑わしい病変や化学療法抵抗性病変、腹腔内出血など。最終組織診断は絨毛癌9例、侵入奇胎6例、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍1例であった。2例で大量出血があり、1例が死亡した。薬剤抵抗性、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、出血性合併症に対し、子宮摘出術は依然として重要な治療選択肢と結論づけている。
pmid-19537902.summary_en: This retrospective review from Chiang Mai University Hospital examines 18 women with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia who underwent simple transabdominal hysterectomy between 1998 and 2008. Indications included uterine-confined suspicious or chemoresistant lesions, hemoperitonium, and other gynecologic diagnoses. Final histology showed choriocarcinoma in nine, invasive mole in six, and placental site trophoblastic tumor in one. Two patients had massive blood loss and one died. Hysterectomy remains an important option for drug-insensitive disease, PSTT, and hemorrhagic complications.

pmid-19538751.summary_ja: 82歳女性が閉経後出血で受診。子宮の良性奇形腫を切除後、再発した悪性奇形腫を子宮全摘で切除した。術後6か月で大動脈傍リンパ節再発をきたし、タキサン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行。子宮奇形腫の病因・診断・治療を既報のレビューとともに考察した。
pmid-19538751.summary_en: An 82-year-old woman presented with postmenopausal bleeding. A benign uterine teratoma was resected, but a recurrent malignant teratoma of the uterine corpus was later removed at hysterectomy. Six months later she relapsed with para-aortic lymphadenopathy and was treated with taxane, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy, followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The authors discuss the aetiology, diagnosis and management of uterine teratomas and review prior case reports.

pmid-19539195.summary_ja: 12歳女児の右卵巣に、ライディッヒ細胞の集簇を含む大型の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を認めた。腫瘍がテストステロンを産生し、声の低音化と陰核肥大による男性化をきたした。思春期例での報告は見当たらず、良性奇形腫でもホルモン産生の可能性を考慮すべきとした。
pmid-19539195.summary_en: A 12-year-old girl had a large right ovarian mature cystic teratoma that produced testosterone from a nest of Leydig cells within the mass. She presented with a deepening voice and clitoromegaly. The authors note that virilization from a testosterone-producing ovarian dermoid has not previously been reported in adolescents. They conclude that benign cystic teratomas can rarely produce active hormones, which should be considered when performing cystectomy.

pmid-19542726.summary_ja: 後腹膜腫瘍は穿刺吸引や部分切除で肉腫や悪性神経鞘腫と誤診された。最終的に胎児性癌を伴う未熟奇形腫と判明。部分切除後に腫瘍が巨大化し切除不能となったが、化学療法で縮小し切除に成功した。術後10年間、転移・再発はない。
pmid-19542726.summary_en: A retroperitoneal tumor was initially diagnosed as sarcoma by fine needle aspiration and then as suspected malignant schwannoma on partial resection. Final operative pathology revealed immature teratoma with embryonal carcinoma. The tumor grew too large for resection after partial excision, but effective chemotherapy shrank it enough for successful surgery. The patient has remained free of metastasis and recurrence for 10 years after operation.

pmid-19543494.summary_ja: 早期胃癌として発見された胃卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例。胃卵黄嚢腫瘍は極めてまれで、多くは診断時にすでに広範な転移を有し予後不良である。治療は化学療法、放射線療法、手術を組み合わせた積極的治療が必要とされる。本例は胃切除とリンパ節郭清により治癒し、文献的考察を加えた。
pmid-19543494.summary_en: The authors describe a gastric yolk sac tumor that presented as early gastric cancer. Such tumors are extremely rare and usually metastatic at diagnosis, with poor prognosis, and are typically treated with aggressive chemotherapy, radiotherapy and surgery. In this patient, gastrectomy with lymphadenectomy alone resulted in cure. The report also reviews the relevant literature.

pmid-19549888.summary_ja: 本研究は、64の非血縁家系に属する精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者95例でPDE11Aを塩基配列決定した。非同義置換8種が同定され、PDE11A変異は対照群より有意に高頻度で（P=0.0002）、家系の19%に存在した。機能解析では、これらの変異によりホスホジエステラーゼ活性が低下し、保因者の腫瘍検体ではPDE11Aタンパク質の発現が低下または消失していた。著者らは、PDE11Aの不活化変異が家族性および両側性精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを修飾する可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-19549888.summary_en: This study sequenced PDE11A in 95 testicular germ cell tumor patients from 64 unrelated families. Eight nonsynonymous variants were found, and PDE11A variants were significantly more frequent in TGCT patients than in controls (P=0.0002), present in 19% of families. Functional assays showed that these variants reduced phosphodiesterase activity, and PDE11A protein expression was decreased or absent in tumor samples from carriers. The authors conclude that PDE11A-inactivating variants may modify susceptibility to familial and bilateral TGCT.

pmid-19552948.summary_ja: 英国で1976～2006年に登録された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍62例の後方視的研究。10年全生存率は70%、無再発生存率は73%であった。病期Iは手術のみで良好、病期II～IVは手術と化学療法の併用が必要。前回妊娠からの期間が唯一の独立予後因子で、48か月が生死の分かれ目となった。
pmid-19552948.summary_en: This UK retrospective study of 62 women with placental-site trophoblastic tumours (1976-2006) evaluated long-term outcomes of surgery, chemotherapy, or both. Ten-year overall survival was 70% and recurrence-free survival 73%. Stage I patients had 90% survival without benefit from postoperative chemotherapy, whereas stage II-IV disease required combined treatment. Time since antecedent pregnancy was the only independent predictor, with a 48-month cutoff distinguishing survival from death.

pmid-19556820.summary_ja: 閉経後16年、最終妊娠後25年の65歳女性に生じた子宮原発純粋絨毛癌の症例報告。不正出血と腹痛で発症し、EMA-COを開始したがエトポシドによる重篤な過敏反応のため、メトトレキサートとホリン酸に変更した。4サイクル後にβ-hCGは正常化し、20か月無再発を維持している。
pmid-19556820.summary_en: A 65-year-old woman developed pure uterine choriocarcinoma 16 years after menopause and 25 years after her last pregnancy, presenting with uterine bleeding and abdominal pain. Histopathology showed syncytiotrophoblastic and cytotrophoblastic cells with necrosis. Chemotherapy with EMA-CO was started but changed to methotrexate and folinic acid after a severe hypersensitivity reaction to etoposide. After four cycles, beta-hCG normalized, and the patient remained disease free at 20 months.

pmid-19560191.summary_ja: 本SEERベースのコホート研究は、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の女性患者1110例を対象に、アフリカ系アメリカ人と白人の生存率を比較した。ディスジャーミノーマは白人に多く、悪性奇形腫はアフリカ系アメリカ人に多くみられた。両群とも大部分の腫瘍は病期I期であった。完全な外科的病期分類はアフリカ系アメリカ人で実施率が低かった。5年生存率は白人92%、アフリカ系アメリカ人86%であったが、組織型、病期、外科的病期分類を調整すると人種は生存の独立した予測因子ではなかった。
pmid-19560191.summary_en: This SEER-based cohort study of 1110 women with ovarian germ cell tumors compared survival between African American and white patients. Dysgerminoma was more common among white patients, while malignant teratoma was more frequent among African American patients. Most tumors were stage I in both groups. Complete surgical staging was performed less often in African American patients. Five-year survival was 92% for white and 86% for African American patients, but race was not an independent predictor of survival after adjusting for histology, stage, and surgical staging.

pmid-19561445.summary_ja: 本研究では、肉腫成分を伴う精巣胚細胞腫瘍33例を解析した。最も多い肉腫成分は横紋筋肉腫であった。肉腫成分は原発腫瘍、転移巣、またはその両方に認められた。肉腫成分が原発腫瘍に限局する患者は、同等の病期で肉腫成分を伴わない患者より高い死亡率を示さなかった。一方、転移巣に肉腫成分を有する患者は死亡リスクが増加しており、転移性の肉腫変化は予後が不良であることが示唆される。
pmid-19561445.summary_en: This study analyzed 33 testicular germ cell tumors containing a sarcomatous component, most commonly rhabdomyosarcoma. Sarcomatous elements were found in primary tumors, metastases, or both. Patients with sarcomatous components confined to the primary tumor did not appear to have higher mortality than comparable stage patients without such components. However, patients with sarcomatous components in metastases had an increased risk of death, suggesting that metastatic sarcomatous change carries a worse prognosis.

pmid-19563411.summary_ja: 14歳女児の卵巣悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。卵黄嚢腫瘍を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の壁に、長さ9cmの肉眼的に明瞭な腸管ループが付着していた。顕微鏡検査で小腸壁の整った構造が確認された。悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍内にこれほど完全に発達した腸管ループが形成された例は初めての報告とされる。
pmid-19563411.summary_en: This case report describes a 14-year-old girl with a malignant mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary, including a yolk sac tumor and mature cystic teratomas. A grossly visible, 9 cm intestinal loop with mesentery was found attached to the cyst wall of the left ovary. Microscopy showed a well-organized small intestinal wall. The authors state this is the first reported case of such a completely developed intestinal loop within a malignant mixed germ cell tumor.

pmid-19564760.summary_ja: 正常分娩6週後に発症した38歳女性の腰椎転移性絨毛癌の症例報告である。血清hCGが高値で、初回のメトトレキサート療法への反応は不良だった。脊椎一括切除術後にhCGが急上昇し、局所再発、硬膜外転移、肺転移をきたして死亡した。外科的切除の前に多剤併用化学療法と放射線療法を行うべきだと結論している。
pmid-19564760.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old woman who developed lumbar spine metastasis of choriocarcinoma six weeks after a normal delivery, with markedly elevated serum hCG. Initial methotrexate-based chemotherapy responded poorly, and en bloc spondylectomy was performed. Postoperatively, hCG levels rose sharply, with local recurrence, epidural metastasis, and lung metastases, and the patient died of the disease. The authors recommend multiagent chemotherapy with radiotherapy before surgical resection of such lesions.

pmid-19567677.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NCCITでは幹細胞遺伝子Nanogが過剰発現していた。siRNAやHDAC阻害剤アピシジンでNanogを抑制すると、幹細胞様の遺伝子発現が逆転し、細胞周期停止と三胚葉への分化が誘導された。胎児性癌細胞は胚性幹細胞よりアピシジンへの感受性が高く、未分化腫瘍の治療標的としてNanogが有望と示唆されている。
pmid-19567677.summary_en: This study examined the embryonic stem cell gene signature in human embryonal carcinoma NCCIT cells, focusing on overexpressed Nanog. Nanog knockdown by siRNA or the HDAC inhibitor apicidin reversed the stem-like expression profile, induced cell cycle arrest, reduced colony formation, and promoted differentiation into all three germ layers, effects reversed by Nanog re-expression. Apicidin was more effective against embryonal carcinoma cell lines than embryonic stem cells. The authors suggest Nanog targeting may improve therapy for poorly differentiated tumors.

pmid-19576697.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（NSGCT）の一次化学療法をレビューした論文です。シスプラチン導入により治癒可能となり、予後と治療反応性に基づくリスク分類（予後良好・中間・予後不良）が治療選択の指針とされています。標準治療の毒性と、有効性を保ちつつ毒性を減らす取り組みを、現在の標準治療の基盤となった臨床試験を中心に解説しています。
pmid-19576697.summary_en: This review examines first-line chemotherapy for non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCTs), which account for much of testicular cancer in young men. Since cisplatin-based treatment made these tumors curable, risk stratification into good-, intermediate- and poor-risk groups has guided therapy. The authors describe the toxic effects of standard regimens and efforts to reduce toxicity while preserving efficacy. They focus on the clinical trials that form the basis of current standard treatment.

pmid-19576813.summary_ja: 9歳の思春期前の女児が急性の腹痛で受診し、嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫と診断された症例報告です。腹腔鏡下嚢胞摘出術で卵巣組織をできる限り温存しました。術中に腫瘍表面の欠損と腹水中の角化扁平上皮が確認され、自然破裂と判断されました。病理学的には隣接する胃粘膜由来の蛋白分解酵素による壁の自己融解が示唆されました。早期診断と低侵襲手術が妊孕性温存に重要であると報告しています。
pmid-19576813.summary_en: This case report describes a 9-year-old premenarchal girl who presented with acute abdominal pain and was diagnosed radiologically with a cystic ovarian teratoma. Laparoscopic cystectomy was performed while preserving as much ovarian tissue as possible. Intraoperative observation of a defect on the tumor surface and keratinized squamous cells in the ascites indicated intraperitoneal rupture. Histology suggested autolysis of the wall by proteolytic enzymes from adjacent gastric mucosa. The authors report it as the youngest premenarchal case of spontaneous rupture and emphasize early diagnosis and minimally invasive surgery for fertility preservation.

pmid-19576814.summary_ja: 無症状の13歳の初経前女児で、超音波検査にて両側骨盤内に複雑な腫瘤が見つかった症例報告です。CTと再検査の超音波検査で、小嚢胞を多数含む充実性腫瘤が成熟奇形腫と区別できないと判断されました。片側卵巣摘出と対側嚢胞摘出が行われ、病理で巨大卵巣浮腫と対側成熟奇形腫が確認されました。この稀な病態の認識が過剰治療の回避に役立つとし、この年齢層では卵巣摘出の代替として術中生検が推奨されています。
pmid-19576814.summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old premenarchal girl who was asymptomatic but had complex bilateral pelvic masses on ultrasound. CT and repeat ultrasound showed a solid mass containing subcentimeter cysts, inseparable from a mature teratoma. Surgery consisted of unilateral oophorectomy and contralateral cystectomy. Pathology confirmed massive ovarian edema together with contralateral mature teratoma. The authors note that recognizing this rare condition helps avoid overtreatment, and they recommend intraoperative biopsy as an alternative to oophorectomy in this age group.

pmid-19576821.summary_ja: 出生後15日目の女児新生児で、仙尾部奇形腫の切除後に性器脱を発症した症例報告です。著者らは、仙尾部奇形腫の手術が新生児の性器脱の有意な素因になりうると提案しています。また、新生児期後半に陰唇間腫瘤がみられた場合には、新生児腟脱を鑑別診断に含めるべきだとしています。仙尾部奇形腫の治療に携わる医師が認識すべき術後合併症です。
pmid-19576821.summary_en: This report describes a 15-day-old female neonate who developed genital prolapse after resection of a sacrococcygeal teratoma. The authors propose that sacrococcygeal teratoma surgery may be a significant predisposing factor for genital prolapse in neonates. They also suggest that neonatal vaginal prolapse should be included in the differential diagnosis of an interlabial mass in the late neonatal period. The case highlights a postoperative complication that clinicians managing sacrococcygeal teratoma should recognize.

pmid-19577382.summary_ja: 50代の女性2例で、大細胞神経内分泌癌、粘液性腺癌および奇形腫が混在する卵巣腫瘍の症例報告です。両者とも増大する腹部腫瘤で受診し、1年以内に転移性疾患で死亡しました。サイトケラチン7と20の染色から、上皮性の複合腫瘍は既存の奇形腫に由来すると示唆されました。著者らは卵巣大細胞神経内分泌癌の起源に関する仮説を考察し、このまれな組み合わせに関する文献をレビューしています。
pmid-19577382.summary_en: This report describes two women in their fifties with ovarian tumors containing a mixture of large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma, mucinous adenocarcinoma and teratoma. Both presented with a growing abdominal mass and died of metastatic disease within a year. Histology showed large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma admixed with the other two components. Cytokeratin 7 and 20 staining suggested that the composite epithelial tumors originated from a pre-existing teratoma. The authors discuss hypotheses about the origin of ovarian large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma and review the literature on this rare combination.

pmid-19578052.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍40例と転移性胚細胞腫瘍8例で、免疫組織化学によりCDX2の発現を検討した研究です。混合型の精巣腫瘍20例では卵黄嚢腫瘍成分が形態とグリピカン3染色で同定されました。このうち8例（1+）でCDX2が陽性で、卵黄嚢腫瘍を伴う転移性混合型では6例中4例が陽性でした。著者らは、CDX2陽性の胚細胞腫瘍では、原発不明腺癌の鑑別診断に卵黄嚢腫瘍を含めるべきだと結論づけています。
pmid-19578052.summary_en: This study examined CDX2 expression by immunohistochemistry in 40 testicular germ cell tumors and 8 metastatic germ cell tumors. Yolk sac tumor components were identified in 20 mixed tumors using morphology and glypican 3 staining. CDX2 was positive in 8 of these 20 testicular cases, and in 4 of 6 metastatic mixed tumors with yolk sac tumor, all at low to moderate intensity. Other primitive components were negative. The authors conclude that yolk sac tumor should be considered in the differential diagnosis of adenocarcinoma of unknown origin when CDX2 is positive.

pmid-19588824.summary_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する22歳の女性の症例である。上大静脈症候群、広範な遠隔転移、および著明に上昇したAFP(57,530 ng/ml)を呈した。BEP化学療法の後に幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法を行い、病期の縮小が得られた。その後、SVC内への血管内進展を含む縦隔残存腫瘍を、血管再建を伴い完全切除した。本症例は、複数の転移があっても、化学療法に基づく病期の縮小により完全切除が可能になり得ることを示している。
pmid-19588824.summary_en: A 22-year-old woman with a mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor presented with superior vena cava syndrome, extensive distant metastases, and markedly elevated AFP (57,530 ng/ml). BEP chemotherapy followed by high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplantation achieved down-staging. Residual mediastinal tumor, including intravascular extension into the SVC, was then completely resected with vascular reconstruction. The case shows that chemotherapy-based down-staging can enable complete resection even with multiple metastases.

pmid-19588873.summary_ja: 生後5か月男児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍症例。左陰嚢腫脹で受診し、AFPは6,862.9 ng/mlと高値、CTでは転移を認めなかった。左高位精巣摘除術のみで治療され、術後53か月再発なく生存している。乳児期精巣腫瘍の稀な症例報告である（hCG-βは正常）。
pmid-19588873.summary_en: A 5-month-old boy presented with left scrotal swelling, with serum AFP markedly elevated to 6,862.9 ng/ml and hCG-beta below detection. CT showed no metastasis. High orchiectomy confirmed a yolk sac tumor, and surgery alone was performed. Pathological examination confirmed the diagnosis. The patient remained alive without evidence of recurrence 53 months after surgery. The report documents a rare infantile testicular yolk sac tumor managed by orchiectomy alone.

pmid-19588874.summary_ja: 進行精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の24歳男性。初回治療後6年で肺再発し化学療法で寛解したが、上大静脈から右心房に進展した腫瘍栓が出現した。体外循環下の緊急切除に成功し、奇形腫の悪性転化（腺癌）と診断された。補助化学療法後、再発なく138か月後に脳梗塞で死亡した。
pmid-19588874.summary_en: A 24-year-old man with advanced testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumor underwent orchiectomy, chemotherapy and RPLND. Six years later, lung relapse responded to chemotherapy, but a superior vena caval tumor thrombus extending into the right atrium raised AFP. Emergency resection under extracorporeal circulation was successful, and pathology showed teratoma with malignant transformation to adenocarcinoma. Adjuvant chemotherapy normalized hCG-beta, and the patient died of cerebral infarction without recurrence at 138 months.

pmid-19589582.summary_ja: 精巣がん生存者83例を対象に、男性ホルモン欠乏症状と性機能、血清テストステロン、治療との関連を検討した。約半数に臨床症状があり、勃起障害や性欲低下などの性機能障害と関連した。症状は年齢と相関したが、血清テストステロン値や治療法とは相関しなかった。
pmid-19589582.summary_en: This study assessed 83 testicular cancer survivors using the IIEF-15 and the Aging Males Symptoms scale, along with age, follow-up, treatment, and serum testosterone. Nearly half reported androgen deficiency symptoms, and these patients had older age and lower erectile, orgasmic, desire, and satisfaction scores. Symptoms correlated with erectile dysfunction and age, but not with serum testosterone or treatment modality. The findings suggest that sexual health concerns in survivors relate more to age than to therapy.

pmid-19589709.summary_ja: 2001〜2006年にトロントの小児病院で卵巣類皮嚢腫の切除を受けた41例（小児・思春期）を後方視的に解析した。腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術が56%で、在院日数が短かった。嚢腫内容物の漏出による合併症はアプローチにかかわらず認めなかった。腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術は安全で有効と結論づけられた。
pmid-19589709.summary_en: This retrospective review of 41 children and adolescents who underwent ovarian dermoid cyst excision at a Toronto hospital from 2001 to 2006 compared laparoscopic and laparotomy approaches. Laparoscopic cystectomy was most common at 56% and was associated with a shorter hospital stay, although cyst rupture occurred in all laparoscopic cases. Spillage caused no complications regardless of approach, and one bladder injury with necrotizing fasciitis occurred. The authors conclude that laparoscopic cystectomy is safe and effective.

pmid-19590726.summary_ja: 成人の仙骨前部後腹膜奇形腫から発生した粘液性腺癌に対し、化学放射線療法を施行した症例報告である。後腹膜奇形腫の悪性転化は扁平上皮癌が多く、粘液性腺癌はきわめてまれである。奇形腫由来粘液性腺癌の術後治療は確立されておらず、本報告は術前後の管理と文献的考察を示す。
pmid-19590726.summary_en: This case report describes a presacral retroperitoneal mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from a teratoma in an adult, treated with chemoradiation. Malignant transformation of retroperitoneal teratoma is rare and most often squamous cell carcinoma, while mucinous transformation is rarer still. The report summarizes perioperative and postoperative management and reviews the literature, noting that postoperative treatment has not been established.

pmid-19596913.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍(主にセミノーマ)、肺がん、脳腫瘍でFEN1タンパク質の発現をウエスタンブロットで調べました。精巣腫瘍25例中19例で高発現が見られ、脳腫瘍でも多くで正常組織より高発現でした。FEN1をsiRNAで抑制するとグリオーマ細胞の薬剤感受性が高まりました。FEN1発現が治療反応性に影響する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-19596913.summary_en: This study measured flap endonuclease 1 (FEN1) protein by Western blot in tumor tissues of the testis, lung, and brain. FEN1 was overexpressed in 19 of 25 testicular tumors (mostly seminomas), all lung cancer samples, and most glioblastomas and astrocytomas compared with normal tissue. In glioma cells, FEN1 knockdown increased sensitivity to temozolomide, methyl methanesulfonate, and cisplatin. The authors conclude that FEN1 overexpression is common across these tumors and may influence therapeutic response.

pmid-19597926.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の悪性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍10例に対し、シスプラチン併用化学療法の導入後に外科的切除を行いました。部分奏効8例、無効2例で、全例が治療をよく耐えました。60か月時点の全生存期間(全生存率)は67%でした。切除標本に生存腫瘍細胞が残る症例は予後不良でした。
pmid-19597926.summary_en: Ten patients with malignant nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the mediastinum received cisplatin-based induction chemotherapy followed by surgical resection. Eight showed a partial response and two showed no response, and all tolerated treatment well. Pathology revealed yolk sac tumor in one patient and malignant teratoma with yolk sac tumor in another. Overall survival at 60 months was 67%. Patients whose resected specimens contained viable tumor cells had poorer survival than those without viable cells.

pmid-19597932.summary_ja: 生後4か月の男児が、縦隔前部の巨大な嚢胞性奇形腫による重度の呼吸窮迫を呈しました。経皮的穿刺吸引を2回行い、そのたびに症状が軽減しました。その後、全切除術を実施しました。穿刺は換気の改善とともに、手術時の嚢胞の容易な切除にも役立ちました。
pmid-19597932.summary_en: A 4-month-old boy presented with severe respiratory distress from a giant anterior mediastinal cystic teratoma that caused pectus carinatum. Percutaneous cyst aspiration was performed twice, and each time symptoms and ventilation improved. Total surgical excision was then completed, and aspiration facilitated easy removal of the cyst. The authors emphasize that surgical excision is both diagnostic and therapeutic for benign teratoma, and that aspiration can serve as a useful bridge to safe surgery in infants with airway obstruction.

pmid-19604622.summary_ja: 低酸素が多能性とがん進行に与える影響を、胚性幹細胞、成体幹細胞、がん幹細胞の観点から総説しています。HIF-1αやNotchシグナルが未分化性の維持や浸潤に関与する点を示しています。胎児性癌細胞と胚性幹細胞の比較は、低酸素による浸潤能と治療抵抗性の解明に役立つ可能性があります。
pmid-19604622.summary_en: This review examines how hypoxia shapes pluripotency and tumor progression in embryonic stem cells, adult stem cells, and cancer stem cells. It highlights shared responses involving HIF-1alpha and Notch signaling that maintain the undifferentiated state and promote proliferation, neovascularization, extracellular matrix degradation, and motility. The authors argue that comparing embryonic stem cells with embryonal carcinoma cells may clarify hypoxia-driven invasiveness and resistance to anticancer treatment, supporting new therapeutic strategies.

pmid-19609532.summary_ja: トロント・プリンセス・マーガレット病院で1981〜2005年にCS I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍371例を積極的監視した登録コホートの解析。リンパ管・血管侵襲と純粋胎児性癌が再発の予測因子であった。5年DSS・OSは98%以上で、リスクに応じない監視が推奨されると結論づけている。
pmid-19609532.summary_en: This study of 371 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors managed with active surveillance at Princess Margaret Hospital (1981-2005) examines relapse patterns and risk predictors. Lymphovascular invasion and pure embryonal carcinoma predicted relapse. About half of high-risk patients relapsed, while 5-year disease-specific and overall survival exceeded 98%. The authors conclude that non-risk-adapted surveillance is the preferred strategy for all stage I patients, including those at high risk.

pmid-19609727.summary_ja: 家族内に2例以上の精巣胚細胞腫瘍がある家系の診断年齢を、各国の人口ベースのがん登録症例と比較した研究。北米・英国・オーストラリア/ニュージーランドでは約2〜3年若年で診断されていた。組織型別でも差が認められ、遺伝的素因を示唆すると考察されている。
pmid-19609727.summary_en: This study compared age at diagnosis in familial testicular germ cell tumor cases from North America, the UK, Australia/New Zealand, Norway and Hungary with population registry cases. Familial cases were on average 2-3 years younger in several regions, with differences seen for both seminoma and non-seminoma histologies in some countries. The authors suggest that the earlier onset may reflect an underlying genetic susceptibility.

pmid-19620939.summary_ja: 組織学的に一見良好な甲状腺型癌を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫10例の検討。8例は乳頭状甲状腺癌であった。初回良性診断後に再発した2例は3〜4年後に播種性病変を示し、放射性ヨウ素療法後も病変を有して生存している。妊娠中のホルモン環境が進行に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-19620939.summary_en: This study reviews 10 cases of struma ovarii with thyroid-type carcinoma, mostly papillary thyroid carcinoma, that were histologically bland. Two patients relapsed after an initial benign diagnosis, with disseminated disease 3-4 years later, and both were alive after radioactive iodine therapy. The authors note that hormonal changes in pregnancy may promote progression and that cystectomy alone warrants close follow-up.

pmid-19620940.summary_ja: 47歳女性の同一卵巣内に、卵巣甲状腺腫と漿液性嚢胞線維腫が併存した症例報告。卵巣甲状腺腫は成熟奇形腫の特殊型である。胚細胞腫瘍と卵巣上皮性腫瘍の併存は、文献上ほとんど報告がない稀な組み合わせである。
pmid-19620940.summary_en: This case report describes a 47-year-old woman with struma ovarii coexisting with a serous cystadenofibroma in the same ovary. Struma ovarii is a specialized form of mature teratoma. The authors note that coexistence with ovarian epithelial tumors has been reported only once before, highlighting the rarity of this combination of a germ cell tumor and an ovarian epithelial neoplasm.

pmid-19620945.summary_ja: 正期産胎盤に生じた絨毛血管腫の中に悪性の栄養膜成分を認めた症例で、絨毛血管癌と診断された。多形性細胞と壊死、高い核分裂像を示し、サイトケラチンとβ-hCGが陽性であった。基底膜浸潤はなく、母体と新生児のフォローアップで転移は認められなかった。妊娠性腫瘍として絨毛癌に近縁と位置づけ、既報3例もレビューしている。
pmid-19620945.summary_en: Describes a term placenta with a chorangioma harboring a focal malignant trophoblastic component, diagnosed as chorangiocarcinoma. Pleomorphic cells with necrosis and high mitoses were positive for cytokeratin and beta-hCG, without basement membrane invasion. No metastasis was found on follow-up of the mother and newborn. The authors argue it belongs to gestational neoplasia, closely related to choriocarcinoma, and review the three prior reported cases.

pmid-19622952.summary_ja: 部分奇胎または仙尾部奇形腫に伴う早発型重症子癇前症の2例で、可溶性VEGFR-1とsEndoglinの増加を報告した。卵巣過剰刺激症候群の1例では遊離VEGFが増加していた。妊娠合併症の病態に血管新生因子のバランス異常が関与すると論じ、妊娠性絨毛性疾患や仙尾部奇形腫との関連を考察している。
pmid-19622952.summary_en: Reports two patients with early-onset severe preeclampsia associated with a partial hydatidiform mole or sacrococcygeal teratoma, both with elevated soluble VEGFR-1 and soluble endoglin. A third patient with severe ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome showed excess free VEGF. The authors propose that angiogenic imbalances contribute to the pathophysiology of these pregnancy complications, linking them to gestational trophoblastic disease and sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-19622962.summary_ja: 62歳の閉経後女性で、呼吸困難と閉経後の性器出血を契機に転移性絨毛癌と診断された症例報告である。超音波での子宮内膜肥厚、子宮内膜生検、β-hCG上昇により確定した。多剤併用化学療法を開始したが、致死的な中毒性表皮壊死融解症を発症した。閉経後にも絨毛癌が起こりうること、治療毒性が死亡につながりうることを示している。
pmid-19622962.summary_en: Describes a 62-year-old postmenopausal woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma presenting with dyspnea and postmenopausal vaginal spotting. Endometrial thickening on ultrasound, endometrial biopsy, and elevated beta-hCG confirmed the diagnosis. Multiagent chemotherapy was started, but the patient developed fatal toxic epidermal necrolysis. The case highlights that choriocarcinoma can occur remotely from pregnancy and that treatment toxicity can be lethal.

pmid-19622963.summary_ja: 最終妊娠から12年後に、婦人科症状を欠く47歳女性が肺転移で発見された症例報告である。病理学的にStage 3の転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断された。PETで肺病変は集積を示さず、腫瘍の増殖が緩徐なためと考察している。妊娠性絨毛性疾患が先行妊娠から長期間を経て発症し得ること、PETで見逃され得ることを示した。
pmid-19622963.summary_en: Reports a 47-year-old woman, 12 years after her last pregnancy, with diffuse pulmonary metastases and no gynecologic symptoms, diagnosed with stage 3 metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor. The pulmonary lesions were nonhypermetabolic on PET, which the authors attribute to the tumor's slow growth. The case shows that this gestational trophoblastic disease can present remotely from antecedent pregnancy and may be missed on PET imaging.

pmid-19623033.summary_ja: ウイルス性または推定ウイルス性精巣炎の10症例を検討した。精細管内セミノーマや精細管内胚細胞性腫瘍、リンパ腫などの模倣疾患として提出されていた。組織像では構造が保たれ、精細管内外にリンパ組織球性浸潤がみられ、CD68、CD3、CD20の免疫染色がこれを裏付けた。画像検査は多くの症例で腫瘍を疑わせるものであった。5例のフォローアップでは再発は認められず、診断上の落とし穴であることが強調されている。
pmid-19623033.summary_en: Reviews 10 consultation cases of viral or presumed viral orchitis submitted with diagnoses of intratubular seminoma, intratubular germ cell neoplasia, or other mimics such as lymphoma. Histology showed preserved architecture with lymphohistiocytic infiltrates within and between seminiferous tubules, supported by CD68, CD3, and CD20 immunostaining. Radiologic studies were suspicious for neoplasm in most cases. Follow-up of five patients showed no recurrence, emphasizing the diagnostic pitfall.

pmid-19625848.summary_ja: 巨大な先天性頸部成熟奇形腫の乳児例で、腫瘍を完全切除し治癒したことを報告する症例報告である。気道圧迫による周産期死亡率が高いため、即時切除が必要とされる。多職種チームによる手術アプローチを示した。出生前診断後の意思決定に役立つ構造化された枠組みも提示しており、まれな疾患として治療経験の共有に意義がある。
pmid-19625848.summary_en: Reports successful total surgical excision of a huge congenital cervical mature teratoma in an infant. Such tumors are rare and carry high perinatal mortality from airway compression, so immediate excision is generally required. The authors describe their multidisciplinary surgical approach and offer a structured framework for decision-making once prenatal diagnosis is made, resulting in cure.

pmid-19626681.summary_ja: 思春期後の精巣胚細胞腫瘍でAurora Bキナーゼを免疫組織化学的に検討した。セミノーマや胎児性癌、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍で発現がみられ、奇形腫や卵黄嚢腫瘍では発現がなかった。ウェスタンブロットでも確認された。阻害薬によりマウス精原細胞株GC-1の増殖が抑制され、治療標的としての可能性が示唆されている。
