pmid-19626681.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry of Aurora B kinase in post-pubertal testicular germ cell tumours, including seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac components, teratomas, and a choriocarcinoma. Aurora B was expressed in intratubular germ cell neoplasia, seminomas, and embryonal carcinomas, but not in teratomas or yolk sac tumors. Western blot confirmed these findings. A pharmacological inhibitor reduced growth of murine spermatogonial GC-1 cells, suggesting Aurora B as a therapeutic target.

pmid-19631510.summary_ja: 乳児の下口唇に奇形腫と腹側毛細血管奇形を合併した、極めて稀な症例です。頭頸部奇形腫は出生数の数万分の一の頻度で、多くは新生児期から乳児期に頸部や鼻咽頭に生じるとされています。表在性の顔面構造からの発生は稀であり、文献レビューとともに報告されています。
pmid-19631510.summary_en: This report describes an infant with a teratoma of the lower lip accompanied by a ventral capillary malformation, an exceptionally unusual location. The authors review head and neck teratomas, which are rare, occur in about 1 in 20,000 to 40,000 live births, and mostly present in the neonatal and infantile period, typically involving the neck and nasopharynx. Teratomas rarely arise from superficial facial structures, which makes this case notable. The paper combines a case description with a literature review to support clinical awareness of this rare presentation.

pmid-19633644.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清標本で、分化した横紋筋様結節を認めた7例を検討しています。原始的な細胞や核分裂は認めず、多くで奇形腫成分を伴いました。臨床経過は奇形腫に近く、横紋筋肉腫とは区別すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-19633644.summary_en: This clinicopathological study examines seven patients whose post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection specimens for metastatic testicular germ cell tumors contained differentiated rhabdomyomatous nodules. The lesions lacked primitive cells and mitoses, and most patients also had teratomatous elements. Follow-up showed that several patients developed recurrent teratoma, and one had progressive tumor with elevated AFP. The authors conclude that these rhabdomyomatous tumors behave like teratoma rather than rhabdomyosarcoma, most likely reflecting selective persistence of differentiated cells after chemotherapy.

pmid-19636015.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者132名と対照137名を比較し、身体的な晩期影響と医療資源の利用を検討しました。生存者では高血圧やしびれ、耳鳴りなどが多く見られました。医療資源の利用は同程度でしたが、保険加入を拒否された割合は高値でした。全体として対照群と同等に健康的な生活を送っていると結論づけています。
pmid-19636015.summary_en: This Gynecologic Oncology Group study compared chronic physical symptoms and health care utilization between long-term ovarian germ cell tumor survivors and matched controls. Of 132 survivors and 137 controls, survivors more often reported hypertension, numbness, tinnitus, chemotherapy-triggered nausea, and Raynaud's symptoms. Patients who received vincristine, dactinomycin, and cyclophosphamide with cisplatin reported more functional complaints. Health care utilization was similar, although survivors were more often denied health insurance. Overall, survivors reported a healthy life comparable to controls, with a few persistent treatment-related sequelae.

pmid-19636565.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜再発に対する再手術的リンパ節郭清を、文献に基づいて総説しています。再発は左傍大動脈部と左腎門部に多く、生残する胚細胞腫瘍や奇形腫が含まれうるため切除が必要です。予後は腫瘍マーカー、組織像、切除の完全性に左右されます。専門施設での施行が推奨されています。
pmid-19636565.summary_en: This review examines reoperative retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for recurrence after nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. Based on a literature search, the authors discuss indications, preoperative evaluation, the distribution of retroperitoneal recurrences, and technical considerations. Recurrence most often involves the left para-aortic and left renal hilar regions and may contain viable germ cell tumor or teratoma requiring excision. Outcomes depend on tumor markers, histology, and completeness of resection. Overall survival appears lower than after initial dissection, so the authors recommend limiting these procedures to specialized centers.

pmid-19639438.summary_ja: 16歳女性が再発性の心タンポナーデで発症した心膜内奇形腫の症例です。反復的な心膜穿刺を受けた後、膿性心膜炎と多漿膜炎を来しました。画像検査では腫瘍を指摘できませんでした。縦隔奇形腫は心膜内に破綻することが多く、早期の外科的切除が重要であると述べています。
pmid-19639438.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with an intrapericardial teratoma presenting as recurrent cardiac tamponade. She underwent repeated pericardiocentesis and developed pyopericardium and polyserositis, and the tumor was not detected by imaging. The authors note that most mediastinal teratomas rupture into the pericardium, causing effusion or tamponade, which underscores the need for early surgical excision even for extrapericardial locations. Only eight cases beyond infancy have been reported, making this presentation rare.

pmid-19640867.summary_ja: 17歳の美容師女性が、肺内良性奇形腫による喀血と喀毛（トリコプチシス）を呈した症例です。外科的管理を行い、画像所見と臨床像を整理しています。痰に毛髪を認めることは本疾患の特徴的な手がかりとなり得ると述べています。
pmid-19640867.summary_en: This report describes a 17-year-old hairdresser with a benign intrapulmonary teratoma presenting with haemoptysis and trichoptysis, the coughing up of hair. The authors describe her surgical management and review the clinical and radiological features of this rare tumour, with particular attention to the trichoptysis symptom. Intrapulmonary teratomas are uncommon, and the presence of hair in sputum may be a distinctive clue to the diagnosis. The paper is a case-based review of a rare presentation of teratoma in the lung.

pmid-19642602.summary_ja: 胎児期に発見された仙尾部奇形腫の2症例を、対照的な経過とともに報告する。1例目は妊娠中期初頭に超音波で診断され、経過観察中に胎児の状態が悪化したため、両親は妊娠中絶を選択した。2例目は発見が遅く、児は生きて生まれ、直ちに手術を受けて1歳時点で良好であった。著者らは、最も多い胎児腫瘍である仙尾部奇形腫の多職種管理において、二次元および三次元超音波検査が有用であることを強調している。
pmid-19642602.summary_en: Two cases of sacrococcygeal teratoma detected antenatally, showing contrasting courses. In the first, the tumor was diagnosed by ultrasound in the early second trimester, the fetus deteriorated during follow-up, and the parents chose termination. In the second, diagnosis came later; the infant was born alive, operated on immediately, and was doing well at age one. The authors highlight the value of two-dimensional and three-dimensional ultrasonography for multidisciplinary management of sacrococcygeal teratoma, the most common fetal tumor.

pmid-19642973.summary_ja: ディスジャーミノーマを発症した若年女性において、父由来の先天性均衡型転座t(8;22)を同定した。切断点は腫瘍抑制遺伝子TRC8/RNF139のイントロン1内に位置し、腫瘍ではTRC8の発現が著明に低下していた。トランスリン(TSN)の発現も正常卵巣と比べて低下していた。パリンドローム介在性の転座とマイクロRNA(miRNA)を介する発現抑制が、腫瘍発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-19642973.summary_en: This report describes a young girl with dysgerminoma who carried a paternally inherited constitutional balanced translocation t(8;22). The breakpoints disrupted intron 1 of the TRC8/RNF139 tumor suppressor gene and an AT-rich low-copy repeat on 22q11.21. TRC8 was strongly underexpressed in the tumor, and translin, a TRC8 regulator, was also reduced relative to normal ovary. The authors propose that palindrome-mediated translocation and subsequent loss of TRC8 expression, possibly via miRNA, contribute to dysgerminoma development.

pmid-19647298.summary_ja: 40歳男性が腹痛と右陰嚢腫脹で受診し、右精巣腫瘍と後腹膜の大きな腫瘤が確認された。根治的精巣摘除術の病理診断は混合型胚細胞腫瘍であった。化学療法1コース後に後腹膜腫瘤が増大し、生検で奇形腫と判明した。患者は手術を拒否し、フォローアップを受けなかった。その後リンパ節腫大が進行し、化学療法を4コース受けたが、計画されていた緩和的手術の前に死亡した。growing teratoma syndromeの経過を示す症例である。
pmid-19647298.summary_en: A 40-year-old man presented with abdominal pain and right scrotal swelling and was found to have a right testicular tumor and a large retroperitoneal mass. After right radical orchiectomy, pathology showed mixed germ cell tumor. Following one cycle of chemotherapy, the retroperitoneal mass enlarged, and biopsy showed teratoma. He declined surgery and missed follow-up. He later developed progressive lymphadenopathy, received four cycles of chemotherapy, and died of massive lymphadenopathy before planned palliative surgery. This illustrates growing teratoma syndrome.

pmid-19647314.summary_ja: 絨毛癌12例をマイクロサテライト解析で調べ、4例は非妊娠性、8例は妊娠性と判定された。妊娠性例の原因妊娠は雄核発生完全胞状奇胎が6例、正常妊娠が2例であった。先行妊娠が原因とは限らず、遺伝学的解析による同定が有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-19647314.summary_en: This molecular genetic study examined 12 patients with choriocarcinoma, using microsatellite genotyping of tumor tissue and the patients' and partners' DNA. Four cases showed only maternal genetic contribution, indicating non-gestational origin. The other eight were gestational, with causative pregnancies identified as androgenetic complete hydatidiform mole in six and normal pregnancy in two. The authors conclude that microsatellite analysis can distinguish gestational from non-gestational choriocarcinoma and identify the causative pregnancy. They also note that a preceding pregnancy is not always the causative one, so genetic rather than clinical assessment should guide this determination.

pmid-19652754.summary_ja: 成人女性に生じた仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。仙尾部奇形腫は成人では極めてまれであり、本例は報告施設で治療された。多くが乳児に発生する疾患であるため、成人例として臨床的に注目すべき症例である。
pmid-19652754.summary_en: This case report describes an adult female with a sacrococcygeal teratoma. Sacrococcygeal teratomas are extremely rare in adults, and the report notes that the patient was managed at the authors' hospital. Because most reported cases occur in infants, this adult presentation is clinically notable. The brief report provides a documented example of management in this unusual age group.

pmid-19653292.summary_ja: Frasier症候群の46XY表現型女性で、両側性の性腺芽細胞腫とディスジャーミノーマを発症し、その後毛様細胞性星細胞腫を生じた症例である。WT1遺伝子のイントロン9変異が背景にある。臨床、画像、遺伝子解析所見を報告し、胚細胞腫瘍との関連を示している。
pmid-19653292.summary_en: This report describes a 46,XY phenotypic female with Frasier syndrome who had bilateral gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma and later developed a pilocytic astrocytoma. Frasier syndrome is caused by a WT1 intron-9 donor splice-site mutation and carries an increased risk of gonadoblastoma. The authors present the clinical, radiological, and genetic findings, including WT1 mutation analysis. The case adds to reports linking Frasier syndrome with germ cell tumors.

pmid-19654912.summary_ja: 低用量のビスフェノールAが、ヒト精巣セミノーマ細胞株JKT-1の増殖を促進することを示した。古典的エストロゲン受容体ではなくGPCRを介し、PKAとPKGを活性化する。胎児の胚細胞増殖や精巣胚細胞腫瘍への影響を検討する新たな根拠となる。
pmid-19654912.summary_en: This study examined whether low-dose bisphenol A promotes proliferation of human testicular seminoma cells (JKT-1). At environmentally relevant concentrations, BPA activated cAMP- and cGMP-dependent protein kinase pathways and phosphorylated CREB and Rb within 15 minutes. The effect did not involve classical estrogen receptors, but was mediated through a G-protein-coupled membrane estrogen receptor. The authors propose that this nongenomic mechanism may influence fetal germ cell proliferation and testicular germ cell cancer risk.

pmid-19659679.summary_ja: 日本の単一施設で、1982〜2005年に精巣摘除術を受けた病期Iセミノーマ64例の監視療法の長期転帰を後方視的に検討した。7例が再発し、うち3例は術後4年以上で再発した。T分類が再発の危険因子であった。晩期再発にも留意すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-19659679.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective study in Japan evaluated long-term outcomes of surveillance after orchiectomy for stage I testicular seminoma in 64 patients treated between 1982 and 2005. Median follow-up was 123.8 months, and seven patients relapsed, with three relapses occurring more than four years after orchiectomy. Relapse-free rates at 5, 10, and 15 years were 92.1%, 90.0%, and 86.0%. T classification was a significant risk factor for relapse, and the authors recommend considering late relapse during surveillance.

pmid-19659708.summary_ja: 早産児に生じた急速増大性の先天性上咽頭奇形腫（エピグナトゥス）による重度の新生児気道閉塞の症例である。腫瘍は初期に小さく羊水過多もなかったため、出生前超音波検査では診断されなかった。出生後に急速に増大しうるため外科的治療が必要と強調している。
pmid-19659708.summary_en: This case report describes a preterm infant with a rapidly growing congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma (epignathus) that caused severe upper airway obstruction in the neonatal period. The tumor was not detected prenatally by ultrasonography, as the masses were initially small and there was no polyhydramnios. The authors emphasize that epignathus can enlarge rapidly after birth and should be treated surgically. The report highlights its importance as a rare cause of neonatal airway obstruction.

pmid-19661148.summary_ja: 正常ヒト精巣、精巣がん検体、ゴナドトロピン抑制を受けた男性の精巣を免疫組織化学で比較した研究です。全てのセミノーマでリン酸化SMAD2/3が核内に認められ、シグナルが活性化していることが示されました。一部のセミノーマでは特定の修飾因子の発現が高く、腫瘍ごとに信号伝達能が異なる可能性があります。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では体細胞分化の程度に応じて発現が変化しました。
pmid-19661148.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry to examine activin and TGFB signaling modulators in normal adult human testes, testicular cancer samples, and testes of men given gonadotropin suppression. Phosphorylated SMAD2/3 was present in all seminoma specimens, indicating active signaling. A subset of seminomas showed elevated beta-glycan, INHA, or MAN-1 expression, suggesting tumour-level differences in signaling capacity. Expression in nonseminomas varied with degree of somatic differentiation. Spermatogenic disruption and hormonal changes may alter these signaling pathways in the testis.

pmid-19665071.summary_ja: 日本人男性の性腺外絨毛癌2例を対象に、ヘテロ接合性消失（LOH）とTP53遺伝子変異を解析した研究です。胃原発の絨毛癌では、PTENとD12S1051にLOHが見られ、TP53のミスセンス変異（H179R）が検出されました。一方、後腹膜の絨毛癌ではPTENのLOHは認められず、PTENのLOHは性腺外絨毛癌に共通する分子事象ではないと結論づけています。
pmid-19665071.summary_en: This report analyzed loss of heterozygosity and TP53 mutations in two Japanese men with extragonadal choriocarcinoma, one arising from gastric adenocarcinoma and one retroperitoneal. PTEN and D12S1051 showed loss of heterozygosity in the gastric tumour and its adenocarcinoma component, and a TP53 point mutation appeared only in the gastric choriocarcinoma. The retroperitoneal tumour lacked PTEN loss. The authors conclude that PTEN loss is not a common event in extragonadal choriocarcinoma. Reduced PTEN expression was seen in syncytiotrophoblast-like cells compared with cytotrophoblast-like cells.

pmid-19670433.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の患者81例（うち18歳以下32例）を対象に、臨床的特徴と腫瘍との関連を検討した。18歳以下の女児の31%、14歳以下の女児の9%に卵巣奇形腫がみられ、男児には腫瘍はなかった。行動変化、発作、自律神経不安定が多くみられた。免疫療法または奇形腫摘出後の回復は、奇形腫のない患者より摘出された患者で多かった。神経学的再発は25%でみられた。
pmid-19670433.summary_en: This study of 81 patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, 32 of whom were 18 or younger, examined clinical features and tumour association. Ovarian teratomas were found in 31 percent of girls aged 18 or younger and 9 percent of girls 14 or younger, and none of the boys had tumours. Behavioral change, seizures and autonomic instability were common. Recovery after immunotherapy or tumour removal was more frequent in patients with a removed teratoma than in those without a teratoma. Neurological relapses occurred in 25 percent.

pmid-19672343.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者で、全身化学療法中に転移巣が増大する稀な病態である growing teratoma syndrome について、現在の文献を総説した論文です。血清腫瘍マーカーが正常化しているにもかかわらず、転移性腫瘤が増大する点が特徴です。診断と治療に関する関連文献をまとめています。独自データを示すものではなく、レビュー論文です。
pmid-19672343.summary_en: This review summarizes the current literature on growing teratoma syndrome (GTS), a rare complication in patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours. GTS presents as enlarging metastatic masses during appropriate systemic chemotherapy, even when serum tumour markers have normalized. The article reviews the diagnosis and management of this condition, drawing on the pertinent scientific literature. The paper is a narrative review rather than an original data report.

pmid-19679044.summary_ja: 兄弟姉妹で精巣と卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍が発生した家系を報告し、既報の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の家族例16報をまとめています。家族性のディスジャーミノーマは一般集団より若い年齢で発症していました（平均17歳と24歳）。SEERデータでは精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率は卵巣の約15倍でした。一部の家系には胚細胞腫瘍の感受性遺伝子が存在する可能性があります。
pmid-19679044.summary_en: This mini-review describes a family in which a testicular and an ovarian germ cell tumour occurred in two siblings, and summarizes 16 previously reported familial cases of ovarian germ cell tumours occurring alone or with testicular or extragonadal germ cell tumours. Familial female dysgerminoma occurred at a younger mean age than in the general population, 17 versus 24 years. In SEER data, testicular germ cell tumours were about 15 times more common than ovarian ones. The authors suggest a susceptibility gene for germ cell tumours may exist in some families.

pmid-19679975.summary_ja: 本報告は、膣出血を呈した生後9か月と17か月の乳児における原発性膣卵黄嚢腫瘍2例を報告したものである。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は著明に高値であった。1例は化学療法後に死亡し、もう1例は化学療法の後に手術を受けAFPが低下した。
pmid-19679975.summary_en: This report describes two infants, aged 9 and 17 months, with primary endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors of the vagina presenting with vaginal bleeding. Both were initially suspected to have sarcoma botryoides based on clinical and ultrasound findings. Serum AFP levels were markedly elevated, at 4325 and 9328 ng/ml. The authors note that this rare malignancy has a dismal prognosis and is often misdiagnosed on histopathology as rhabdomyosarcoma or clear cell adenocarcinoma. One patient died two months after chemotherapy, while the other received chemotherapy followed by surgery, with reduction in AFP levels.

pmid-19679980.summary_ja: 本報告は、不規則な性器出血と下腹部腫瘤を呈した19歳女性の純粋卵巣絨毛癌を報告したものである。穿刺吸引細胞診で多核巨細胞と悪性単核細胞が確認され、血清β-hCGは380,000 mIU/mlと著明に高値であった。細胞診で診断された初の純粋卵巣絨毛癌例として、血清β-hCG測定の重要性を強調している。
pmid-19679980.summary_en: This report describes a 19-year-old woman with irregular vaginal bleeding and a lower abdominal mass, diagnosed with pure ovarian choriocarcinoma. Fine needle aspiration cytology showed hypocellular smears with large multinucleated giant cells, malignant mononucleated cells, and a hemorrhagic background. Serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated at 380,000 mIU/ml. Histopathology later confirmed the diagnosis. The authors state this is the first reported case of pure ovarian choriocarcinoma diagnosed by cytology. They emphasize that distinguishing gestational from nongestational choriocarcinoma is difficult, and that suspicion should be maintained and serum beta-hCG measured to support the diagnosis.

pmid-19680671.summary_ja: 本研究は、卵巣奇形腫を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者の脳と腫瘍の免疫病理学的検討を行ったものである。死亡例2例と回復例9例の腫瘍を調べ、全ての腫瘍にNMDAR発現神経細胞と炎症性浸潤が認められた。抗体によるNMDA受容体の減少が病態の中心であり、細胞傷害性T細胞の関与より抗体反応が重要と結論づけている。
pmid-19680671.summary_en: This immunopathology study examined brain and tumor tissue from two patients who died of anti-NMDAR encephalitis and tumor tissue from nine who recovered, all with ovarian teratoma. Brain findings included microgliosis and IgG deposits, with rare inflammatory infiltrates in the hippocampus, forebrain, basal ganglia, and spinal cord, and few cytotoxicity markers. All tumors contained NMDAR-expressing neurons and inflammatory infiltrates. All NMDAR antibodies were IgG1, IgG2, or IgG3, and no complement deposition was seen. The authors conclude that antibody-mediated mechanisms, rather than cytotoxic T-cell responses, likely drive pathogenesis.

pmid-19681297.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、急性腹痛と軽度の貧血、白血球増多を呈した9歳女児の巨大卵巣奇形腫破裂による血腹症を報告したものである。緊急手術で右卵巣由来の捻転・破裂した腫瘤が確認され、病理組織学的検査で三胚葉成熟混合奇形腫と診断された。術後2か月のフォローアップでは再発の所見は認められなかった。
pmid-19681297.summary_en: This case report describes a 9-year-old girl with acute abdominal pain, mild anemia, leukocytosis, and a large left upper quadrant mass. She had undergone appendectomy 20 days earlier. Emergency surgery revealed a giant mass in the left flank, along with the right ovary from which it arose; the twisted, ruptured tumor caused hemoperitoneum. Histopathology showed a mature three-germ-layer mixed teratoma. At two months of follow-up, clinical, radiologic, and biochemical tests (alpha-FP, beta-hCG) showed no residual disease. The authors also include a literature review of the condition.

pmid-19684525.summary_ja: 本報告は、生後6か月以前に手術を受けた女児2例の急速に増大する後腹膜成熟奇形腫を報告したものである。診断から手術までの間に、腫瘍はほぼ10日ごとに倍の大きさになった。後腹膜成熟奇形腫は稀な良性腫瘍であり、早期の治療が望ましいと結論づけている。
pmid-19684525.summary_en: This report describes two girls, both operated on before six months of age, with rapidly growing mature retroperitoneal teratomas. During the interval between diagnosis and surgery, each tumor roughly doubled in size every 10 days. Mature retroperitoneal teratomas are rare benign tumors usually found in neonates and young adults. The authors conclude that treatment should be performed as soon as possible because of the potential for rapid growth. The report highlights the importance of prompt surgical management once these tumors are diagnosed, even when they appear benign.

pmid-19685552.summary_ja: 経験豊富な検査者が超音波所見のパターン認識により付加卵巣腫瘤の診断を行った多施設研究（IOTA）。1066例中84%で特定の診断が示された。類皮嚢腫（良性奇形腫）は高い感度・特異度で診断され、悪性と誤診されることはほとんどなかった。一方、卵巣甲状腺腫は感度が0%で、悪性と誤認されやすかった。
pmid-19685552.summary_en: This multicenter IOTA study evaluated experienced examiners' subjective pattern recognition on transvaginal gray-scale and Doppler ultrasound in 1066 women with adnexal masses. A specific diagnosis was proposed for 84% of tumors. Dermoid cysts (benign teratomas), hydrosalpinges and endometriomas were diagnosed with high likelihood ratios and were rarely misdiagnosed as malignant. Struma ovarii had 0% sensitivity and was often mistaken for malignancy, highlighting the diagnostic limits for this rare ovarian tumor.

pmid-19688690.summary_ja: 分泌型セリンプロテアーゼHtrA1の発現を、正常胎盤、部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌で免疫組織化学的に検討した。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の重症度が増すにつれ免疫染色性は低下し、絨毛癌細胞では陰性であった。HtrA1が胞状奇胎や絨毛癌の病態進展に関与し、正常な胎盤の発達にも重要な役割を果たす可能性が示唆された。
pmid-19688690.summary_en: This study examined HtrA1, a secreted serine protease, by immunohistochemistry in normal placenta, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinoma, and by western blotting in normal placentas. HtrA1 immunostaining decreased progressively with increasing severity of gestational trophoblastic disease: it was weak in partial and complete moles and absent in choriocarcinoma cells. The authors suggest HtrA1 may contribute to the pathogenesis and progression of hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinoma, as well as to normal placental development.

pmid-19691261.summary_ja: 臨床的に胞状奇胎と診断された11例で、除去術前にF-18 FDG PET/CTを施行した。除去後もβ-hCG値が持続的または進行性に高値であった5例では、子宮内の奇胎組織の標準化集積値（SUV）が有意に高かった。FDG集積は高リスク妊娠性絨毛性疾患や絨毛癌の予測に役立つ可能性があるが、症例数が少なく予備的な結果である。
pmid-19691261.summary_en: This study of 11 consecutive women with clinically suspected molar pregnancy assessed preevacuation F-18 FDG PET/CT. In five patients whose beta-hCG remained elevated or rose after evacuation, the standardized uptake value of molar tissue within the uterus was significantly higher than in the six patients whose levels normalized. Patients with persistently elevated hCG received methotrexate or EMA/CO chemotherapy. The authors conclude that preevacuation FDG uptake may predict high-risk gestational trophoblastic disease or choriocarcinoma, though the results are preliminary given the small sample.

pmid-19696610.summary_ja: 長期フォローアップされた悪性卵巣甲状腺腫88例を解析した。癒着、腹水（1 L以上）、卵巣漿膜の断裂が臨床的悪性挙動と関連した。甲状腺成分が6 cm以下の腫瘍では再発は稀であった。組織学的所見の予測能は限られ、乳頭状パターンや低分化癌を除き転帰を予測する所見は乏しかった。乳頭癌は濾胞性腫瘍より早く再発し、10年生存率は89%であった。
pmid-19696610.summary_en: This analysis of 88 patients with malignant struma ovarii and prolonged follow-up identified adhesions, large ascites and ovarian serosal rupture as predictors of clinically malignant behavior. Tumors with a strumal component of 6 cm or less recurred rarely, whereas larger strumal components carried substantial risk. Histologic features rarely predicted outcome, except a papillary pattern or poorly differentiated carcinoma. Papillary carcinomas recurred earlier than follicular neoplasms. Overall survival was 89% at 10 years and 84% at 25 years.

pmid-19696615.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は卵巣腫瘍で最も多い腫瘍である。その悪性転化は稀で、多くは扁平上皮癌であり、肉腫はさらに少ない。本報告は、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた血管肉腫の1例の臨床病理学的特徴を示し、既報の5例を含めて文献的考察を行っている。
pmid-19696615.summary_en: Mature cystic teratoma of the ovary is the most common ovarian tumor. Its malignant transformation is rare, usually to squamous carcinoma and less often to sarcoma. The authors report a case of angiosarcoma arising within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma and review the five previously reported cases of this entity. They describe the clinicopathologic features of this rare occurrence, providing a reference for recognizing sarcomatous transformation in ovarian teratomas.

pmid-19697634.summary_ja: 傍腫瘍性神経症候群は悪性腫瘍に伴いうるもので、辺縁系脳炎はその特徴的な型の一つである。著者らは、未熟奇形腫に伴う重度の辺縁系脳炎を発症した、それまで健康な若い女性を報告している。腫瘍の外科的切除の後、急速な神経学的改善が得られ、フォローアップ中に症状は完全に消失した。腫瘍の治癒率が高い場合でも傍腫瘍症候群は永続的障害や死亡を引き起こしうるため、早期の認識が重要であると強調している。
pmid-19697634.summary_en: Paraneoplastic neurological syndromes can accompany malignancies, and limbic encephalitis is one of their characteristic forms. The authors describe a previously healthy young woman who developed severe limbic encephalitis associated with an immature teratoma. Surgical resection of the tumor was followed by rapid neurological improvement and complete resolution of symptoms during follow-up. The report stresses that paraneoplastic syndromes can cause permanent disability or death even when the underlying tumor is highly curable, so early recognition is important.

pmid-19697729.summary_ja: 耳下腺の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は非常に稀である。本報告は、4年間徐々に増大した左耳下腺腫瘤を有する17歳女性の症例である。穿刺吸引細胞診と捺印細胞診で扁平上皮、皮脂腺様細胞、毛幹が認められた。病理組織学的に単房性で、皮膚付属器や軟骨を含み、未熟組織や悪性転化は認めなかった。耳下腺嚢胞性病変の鑑別診断に本疾患を含めるべきと述べている。
pmid-19697729.summary_en: Mature cystic teratomas of the major salivary glands are rare. The authors report a mature cystic teratoma of the left parotid gland in a 17-year-old woman with a slow-growing parotid mass. Fine needle aspiration and imprint cytology showed squamous, sebaceous, and hair-shaft-containing cells. Histology revealed a unicystic lesion lined by keratinized squamous epithelium, with skin adnexa and mature cartilage, and no immature tissue or malignant transformation. The authors suggest that this entity be included in the differential diagnosis of parotid cystic lesions.

pmid-19706907.summary_ja: マリ渡航歴のある女性で、ディスジャーミノーマに対する化学療法終了1か月後に、結節性肺住血吸虫症が診断された。初感染から約16か月後であった。血清学的検査で著明な好酸球増多が認められた。化学療法後の患者でも、原因不明の好酸球増多があれば寄生虫感染を考慮すべきと指摘している。
pmid-19706907.summary_en: The authors describe a traveler to Mali who developed nodular pulmonary schistosomiasis about 16 months after primary infection, one month after completing chemotherapy for a malignant tumor that was dysgerminoma. Marked eosinophilia on serologic testing was an important clue. The case highlights that parasitic infection should be considered in cancer patients with unexplained eosinophilia, particularly immigrants and travelers to tropical countries, including those treated with chemotherapy.

pmid-19709439.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者101例を後方視的に解析し、血清hCG値と腫瘍血管密度の関連を検討した。hCG≧25mIU/mLでは血管新生が増加し、多変量解析でも独立した関連因子であった一方、VEGF発現との関連は認められなかった。hCGはVEGFとは独立して血管新生に関与し、治療標的となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-19709439.summary_en: This retrospective study of 101 patients with germ cell testicular tumors evaluated serum hCG, AFP and LDH, microvessel density, and VEGF immunohistochemistry. High hCG (25 mIU/mL or more) was the only independent factor associated with increased vascular density on multivariate analysis, while VEGF expression showed no association. Relapse occurred in 7.5% and mortality in 11.5%. The authors suggest hCG promotes tumor angiogenesis independently of VEGF and may be a therapeutic target.

pmid-19712559.summary_ja: 反復性両性父性完全胞状奇胎の女性に対し、体外受精で得た11個の胚を全ゲノム増幅と16か所のSTR解析で評価した。全胚が両親由来の正常な遺伝形式を示し、1個の胚盤胞を移植して健康な一卵性双生児の女児が出生した。胞状奇胎の再発予防に着床前遺伝子診断を用いた初の報告である。
pmid-19712559.summary_en: The authors report a woman with recurrent diandric complete hydatidiform mole who underwent IVF with preimplantation genotyping. Eleven embryos were biopsied at the single-cell level and analyzed by whole genome amplification and 16 STR loci. All showed normal biparental inheritance, and one blastocyst was transferred, resulting in healthy monozygotic twin girls. This is the first use of preimplantation genotyping to prevent recurrent molar pregnancy, which carries a risk of persistent trophoblastic neoplasia or choriocarcinoma.

pmid-19715045.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対し精巣摘除術、リンパ節郭清、プラチナ製剤による化学療法を受けた22歳男性が、黒色便と陰嚢腫脹で受診した。十二指腸の転移病変の生検で混合型胚細胞腫瘍(未熟奇形腫成分)と診断された。イホスファミドを含むレジメンへの変更で5か月後に病変は完全消失し、プラチナ抵抗性後の二次治療としての有用性が示された。
pmid-19715045.summary_en: A 22-year-old man with prior orchiectomy, lymphadenectomy, and platinum-based chemotherapy for testicular cancer presented with melena and scrotal swelling. Endoscopy revealed duodenal polypoid masses, and biopsy showed mixed germ cell tumor with immature teratoma. After switching to an ifosfamide-based regimen, the duodenal lesions completely resolved over 5 months. The authors suggest ifosfamide is effective as second-line therapy after platinum resistance.

pmid-19718253.summary_ja: 脳室腹腔シャントを有する若年女性の腹部嚢胞性腫瘤が、当初は脳脊髄液偽嚢胞と考えられました。しかし最終的には卵巣奇形腫と判明しています。本症例は、初期の画像診断に頼らず、データ全体から診断を統合し、あらゆる鑑別診断を検討することの重要性を示しています。
pmid-19718253.summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with a ventriculoperitoneal shunt whose abdominal cystic mass was initially presumed to be a cerebrospinal fluid pseudocyst. It was ultimately identified as an ovarian neoplasm, later confirmed as an ovarian teratoma. The authors emphasize that clinicians should integrate all data sources rather than rely on initial radiographic evaluation, and should consider all differential diagnoses when evaluating cystic abdominal masses.

pmid-19722777.summary_ja: 生後2日の女児が腹部腫瘤、胆汁性嘔吐を呈し、手術により後腹膜に双生児胎児内胎児と別個の未熟奇形腫が見つかった症例報告です。病理学的に確認され、術後3か月のフォローアップで血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は正常化しました。文献レビューも含みます。
pmid-19722777.summary_en: This case report describes a two-day-old female newborn with an abdominal mass, in whom surgery revealed a retroperitoneal double fetus-in-fetu alongside a separate immature teratoma. Pathology confirmed both findings. Serum alpha-fetoprotein normalized by three months of follow-up, and the infant remained healthy after discharge. The report includes a review of the literature on this rare condition.

pmid-19724246.summary_ja: 男性不妊症が精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスク因子となりうるかをレビューした論文です。精巣形成不全症候群、12番染色体異数性、DNAミスマッチ修復、Y染色体不安定性などの関連機序を検討しています。精液の質の低下や生殖補助医療の関与にも触れ、感受性の高い男性を特定するための遺伝学的・エピジェネティックな研究の必要性を示しています。
pmid-19724246.summary_en: This review examines male infertility as a risk factor for testicular germ cell tumor. It discusses proposed links, including testicular dysgenesis syndrome, chromosome 12 aneuploidy, DNA mismatch repair defects, and Y-chromosome instability. The authors note rising tumor incidence alongside declining semen quality, and the influence of assisted reproduction. They call for genetic and epigenetic approaches to identify men susceptible to testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-19734804.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍と広範な転移を有する14歳男児が入院中に突然倒れ、蘇生に失敗しました。剖検では血栓塞栓症は認められず、骨盤・腹部腫瘤による下大静脈の高度圧迫と門脈系への短絡所見があり、静脈還流障害が死因と考えられました。
pmid-19734804.summary_en: This case describes a 14-year-old boy with a large testicular tumor and widespread metastatic disease who collapsed while showering and could not be resuscitated. Autopsy showed no thromboembolism, a recognized cause of sudden death in metastatic testicular tumors. Instead, marked compression of the inferior vena cava by the pelvicoabdominal tumor mass, along with findings suggesting systemic-portal shunting, indicated impaired venous return as the cause of death.

pmid-19735831.summary_ja: 12歳女児の未熟卵巣奇形腫の症例で、腹膜の多発性神経膠組織移植(腹膜神経膠腫症)と右胸膜腫瘤を認めた。胸膜腫瘤は腹膜病変と組織学的に区別できない成熟グリア組織であり、胸膜神経膠腫症の初めての報告である。著者らは、奇形腫からの直接的な播種やリンパ行性進展ではなく、多能性ミュラー管幹細胞の化生によって生じるという化生説を支持する根拠を示している。
pmid-19735831.summary_en: A 12-year-old girl with an immature ovarian teratoma had multiple glial peritoneal implants (gliomatosis peritonei) and an unexpected right pleural mass. Histology showed the pleural mass was normal mature glial tissue, indistinguishable from the peritoneal implants. This is the first described case of pleural gliomatosis. The authors argue that these implants arise through metaplasia of pluripotent Müllerian stem cells rather than direct extrusion or lymphatic spread from the teratoma, supporting the metaplastic theory.

pmid-19736168.summary_ja: 複雑部分発作重積状態で発症した症例で、当初は再発性てんかん発作と誤認された異常運動の後に、卵巣奇形腫を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された。発熱を伴う前駆期に続き、記憶障害、精神症状、けいれんなどが出現した。早期の腫瘍摘除により神経学的予後が良好となりうるため、てんかんや運動障害を診療する医師は、この稀だが治療可能な疾患を認識すべきと著者らは強調している。
pmid-19736168.summary_en: A patient presented with complex partial status epilepticus that was initially misread as recurrent epileptic seizures, but was ultimately diagnosed as anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma. The illness began with a febrile prodrome resembling a viral infection, followed by memory loss, psychiatric symptoms, seizures, and abnormal movements. The authors emphasize that early tumor surgery can yield good neurological outcomes, and that clinicians treating epilepsy and movement disorders should recognize this rare but treatable condition.

pmid-19736871.summary_ja: 生後18日の男児に発生した上縦隔未熟奇形腫の症例である。病理組織学的所見で腫瘍被膜外側に圧排された甲状腺濾胞の不連続な帯が認められ、異所性甲状腺組織を起源とする奇形腫が示唆された。乳児期の未熟奇形腫の良性の経過に合致し、患者は22か月後も無病である。異所性甲状腺組織も甲状腺と同様の病理変化、稀に奇形腫を生じうると結論づけている。
pmid-19736871.summary_en: A male newborn aged 18 days presented with an upper mediastinal immature teratoma. Histologic examination revealed a discontinuous rim of compressed thyroid follicles along the outer tumor capsule, suggesting the teratoma arose from ectopic thyroid tissue, a finding not previously described. Consistent with the typically benign behavior of immature teratoma in infancy, the patient remained disease-free at 22 months. The authors conclude that ectopic thyroid tissue can undergo the same pathologic changes as the thyroid gland, including rare teratoma formation.

pmid-19741569.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生存者675例と対照189例で、生殖細胞系列のGSTM1、GSTT1、GSTP1多型を解析した。特定の遺伝子型の組合せは純粋胎児性癌および純粋奇形腫のリスク低下と関連し、GSTP1のAアレルは予後良好群と関連した。GSTM1ヌル型は予後不良と、GSTP1-AGは化学療法後組織の壊死と関連した。白金製剤による化学療法の不応性は特定の遺伝子型の組合せと関連した。著者らは、GST遺伝子型が組織型および予後と関連すると結論づけている。
pmid-19741569.summary_en: This study analyzed germline GSTM1, GSTT1, and GSTP1 polymorphisms in 675 testicular germ cell tumor survivors and 189 controls. Certain genotype combinations were associated with reduced risk of pure embryonal carcinoma and pure teratoma, and the GSTP1 A-allele was linked to a good prognostic group. GSTM1 null genotype was associated with poor prognosis, and GSTP1-AG with necrosis in post-chemotherapy histology. Platinum-based chemotherapy failure was associated with a specific genotype combination. The authors conclude that GST genotypes relate to histology and prognosis.

pmid-19752518.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の胎児28例、超音波画像71枚を後方視的に検討し、充実性腫瘍体積と頭部体積の比(STV/HV)を算出した。比が1を超える例では異常所見や胎児水腫の頻度が高く、死亡率は61%であった。比が1未満の例は死亡がなかった。STV/HVは高拍出性心不全や胎児水腫による予後不良例の同定に有用で、治療方針の決定を補助しうると結論づけている。
pmid-19752518.summary_en: This retrospective study of 28 fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma reviewed 71 sonograms to calculate a solid tumor volume to head volume (STV/HV) ratio. Ratios above 1 were strongly associated with abnormal sonographic signs and hydrops, and 61% of those fetuses died, versus none with ratios below 1. The authors conclude that the STV/HV ratio can identify fetuses at high risk of poor outcome from high-output cardiac failure and hydrops, and can guide management decisions.

pmid-19755653.summary_ja: Children's Oncology Groupの症例対照研究で、小児胚細胞腫瘍278例と年齢・性別をマッチさせた対照423例について、妊娠前後の母体ビタミン摂取を検討した。全体では有意でないもののリスク低下が見られた。性腺外および性腺の腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)/セミノーマ、奇形腫で逆相関を認めたが、卵黄嚢腫瘍では認めなかった。母体補充が小児胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを下げる可能性があるが、小規模で観察研究の限界を考慮すべきとしている。
pmid-19755653.summary_en: This Children's Oncology Group case-control study of 278 pediatric germ cell tumor cases and 423 matched controls examined maternal vitamin use around pregnancy. Overall vitamin use was associated with a nonsignificant reduced GCT risk. Inverse associations appeared for extragonadal and gonadal tumors, dysgerminoma/seminoma, and teratoma, but not yolk sac tumors. No consistent pattern emerged for periconceptional or first-trimester exposure. The authors conclude that maternal supplementation may reduce pediatric GCT risk, but small sample size and observational limitations warrant caution.

pmid-19762049.summary_ja: スペインの16年間の後方視的調査で、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍として発見された退縮性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の17例を検討した。全連続胚細胞腫瘍の4%を占めた。腹部腫瘤や腰痛が主症状で、精巣は触知されなかった。超音波検査では石灰化が多く、生存腫瘍巣が41%に残存していたため、再発予防のため超音波診断と手術が重要とされる。
pmid-19762049.summary_en: This retrospective 16-year review in Spain identified 17 patients with regressed testicular germ cell tumors that presented as extragonadal metastases. Primary testicular origin accounted for 4% of consecutive germ cell tumors. Presenting features included abdominal mass and loin pain, while the testis was not palpably abnormal. Ultrasound commonly showed calcifications and hyperechoic linear images, and histology showed fibrosis and hemosiderin. Viable tumor foci were found in 41% of cases, so the authors stress ultrasound diagnosis and surgery to prevent relapse.

pmid-19763057.summary_ja: 口臭を訴えた36歳男性で、気管支鏡検査により右上葉から発生する毛髪が確認された。右上葉切除術後、病理学的に原発性肺奇形腫と診断された。まれで多くは良性の性腺外奇形腫である。気管支内の毛髪は縦隔奇形腫が原因となることが多く、この徴候に「bronchotrichosis」という新用語を提案している。
pmid-19763057.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with halitosis whose bronchoscopy revealed coarse hair arising from the right upper lobe. Right upper lobectomy confirmed a primary pulmonary teratoma, a very rare extragonadal tumor that is usually benign. The authors note that hair in the airway is typically caused by mediastinal teratoma, and they propose 'bronchotrichosis' as a new term for this sign. The case highlights the diagnostic value of recognizing this finding.

pmid-19763555.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された口腔奇形腫(エピグナトス)の症例である。胎児MRIで正中頭蓋内奇形と下垂体の重複が認められ、小さな口腔腫瘤の正確な診断につながった。頭蓋内所見が出生前診断の手がかりになることを示している。ここでの頭蓋内所見は奇形であり、原発性中枢神経系胚細胞腫瘍ではない。
pmid-19763555.summary_en: This report describes a fetus with epignathus, an oral teratoma, diagnosed in utero. Fetal MRI revealed midline intracranial malformations, including duplication of the pituitary gland. These brain findings helped clinicians correctly identify a small fetal oral mass. The case shows how associated intracranial abnormalities can guide accurate prenatal diagnosis. The teratoma is extragonadal, and the intracranial findings are malformations rather than a primary CNS germ cell tumor.

pmid-19769244.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎除去後に持続性出血を来した絨毛癌の症例。メトトレキサートによる化学療法で寛解し、その後正常な胎盤を伴う健康な新生児を正期産で出産した。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の化学療法完遂後も、正常な月経と合併症のない分娩が期待できると結論づけている。
pmid-19769244.summary_en: A woman with post-molar choriocarcinoma, who had persistent bleeding after molar evacuation, was treated with methotrexate chemotherapy. She achieved remission and later delivered a healthy term baby with a normal placenta. The authors conclude that normal menstruation and an uncomplicated term delivery can be expected after complete chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-19770094.summary_ja: 原発巣が明らかでない絨毛癌の両腎転移により、自然腎出血と反復する肉眼的血尿を呈した症例。塞栓術で出血を制御したが、化学療法中に空腸転移による消化管出血を来し外科的切除を要した。術後に院内肺炎から敗血症を併発し死亡した。
pmid-19770094.summary_en: A patient with metastatic choriocarcinoma involving both kidneys presented with spontaneous renal hemorrhage and recurrent gross hematuria, without an identifiable primary uterine tumor. Angioembolization controlled the bleeding. Jejunal metastasis later caused gastrointestinal bleeding during chemotherapy, requiring surgical resection. The patient died of postoperative sepsis after nosocomial pneumonia.

pmid-19770384.summary_ja: シスプラチン治療を受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝子発現解析により、5年全生存期間を予測する遺伝子分類器を開発した。10遺伝子モデルは検証セットで一致指数0.83を示し、臨床リスク分類とは独立した予後因子であった。予後予測と新たな治療標的への応用が期待される。
pmid-19770384.summary_en: Expression profiling of 74 nonseminomatous germ cell tumors from cisplatin-treated patients (training set) and 34 patients (validation set) identified a gene classifier predicting 5-year overall survival. A 10-gene model achieved a concordance index of 0.83 in validation and remained an independent prognostic factor beyond clinical risk stratification, suggesting potential for improved outcome prediction and therapeutic targets.

pmid-19776598.summary_ja: 18週に超音波とMRIで診断された、極めて巨大な胎児頸部咽頭奇形腫の症例報告。急速な増大と羊水過多のため28週で分娩とした。EXIT手技中に気道確保を繰り返し試みたが失敗し、新生児は早期に死亡した。巨大頸部奇形腫では多職種チームでも気道確保の成功は保証されないと結論づけている。
pmid-19776598.summary_en: A case report of an extremely large fetal cervicopharyngeal teratoma diagnosed at 18 weeks by ultrasound and MRI. Rapid growth and polyhydramnios led to delivery at 28 weeks. During an EXIT procedure, repeated attempts to secure the airway failed, and the neonate died early. The authors conclude that a team approach improves but does not guarantee airway success in giant neck teratomas.

pmid-19777758.summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術後に選択しうる治療を概説した総説。積極的監視では約80%が再発せず、再発例はすべて救済可能である。放射線療法は治癒率が高いが、長期毒性と約80%の過剰治療がある。化学療法のデータは未成熟である。監視を第一選択とし、次いで放射線療法を推奨している。
pmid-19777758.summary_en: A review of treatment options after orchiectomy for clinical stage I testicular seminoma, a highly curable malignancy regardless of the option chosen. Active surveillance yields about 80% relapse-free survival, and all relapses are salvageable. Radiotherapy has near-universal cure but long-term toxicity and about 80% overtreatment. Single-agent chemotherapy data remain immature. The authors favor surveillance, then radiotherapy, with chemotherapy as an alternative.

pmid-19777759.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの治療選択に関する論評。経済的に安定し、キャリアも安定した患者には積極的監視を推奨している。経済的、精神的、またはコンプライアンス上の理由でフォローアップを緩やかにする必要がある患者には予防的放射線療法を提案する。補助的カルボプラチンについては、生存、毒性、二次性精巣がん、費用に関する長期データが必要としている。
pmid-19777759.summary_en: A commentary on treatment choice for stage I seminoma. The authors favor active surveillance for patients with financial stability and stable careers. Prophylactic radiotherapy is suggested for those needing a less intensive follow-up schedule for financial, emotional, or compliance reasons. They note that longer follow-up data are needed for adjuvant carboplatin regarding survival, toxicity, second testicular cancers, and cost.

pmid-19779380.summary_ja: 15歳男児の松果体ジャーミノーマに対して放射線療法を行い寛解した後、約19か月後に縦隔セミノーマが発見された症例報告。血清β-hCGの上昇を契機に診断され、全身化学療法により完全寛解が得られた。頭蓋内胚腫後の異時性縦隔GCTのリスクと、β-hCGによるフォローアップの重要性を示す。
pmid-19779380.summary_en: A case report of a 15-year-old boy with pineal germinoma treated with radiation therapy, followed by a mediastinal seminoma diagnosed about 19 months after the germinoma resolved. The mediastinal seminoma was identified through rising serum beta-hCG, with no CNS recurrence. Systemic chemotherapy led to complete resolution. The case highlights the risk of metachronous extragonadal germ cell tumors after intracranial germinoma and the value of serum beta-hCG monitoring during follow-up.

pmid-19786789.summary_ja: 胎児心膜部奇形腫に対し、子宮内で心膜羊膜シャント術を施行し治療に成功した初例の報告と文献レビュー。胎児治療は水腫を伴う症例の生存率を向上させるとされ、反復心膜穿刺の代替としてシャント術の可能性が示唆されている。心膜部の奇形腫は稀な性腺外発生例である。
pmid-19786789.summary_en: Report of the first fetal pericardial teratoma treated successfully in utero by pericardioamniotic shunting, with a literature review. Fetal treatment is noted to improve survival in cases with hydrops. The authors suggest that pericardioamniotic shunting may be an alternative to serial pericardiocentesis. The report places this rare extragonadal fetal teratoma within the context of prenatal intervention options.

pmid-19786797.summary_ja: 16か月前に原因不明の脳炎を発症した15歳女児が、月経異常と男性化を呈した症例。左卵巣の大きな成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が見つかり、高アンドロゲン値を示していた。血清の抗NMDA受容体抗体が検出され、腫瘍の免疫組織化学で反応が確認された。摘出後、月経と行動の異常は改善し、テストステロン値も低下した。奇形腫関連脳炎と男性化の合併は初の報告である。
pmid-19786797.summary_en: Case report of a 15-year-old girl with menstrual irregularity and virilization, who had encephalitis of unknown cause 16 months earlier. Imaging and surgery found a large left ovarian mature cystic teratoma producing high androgen levels. Serum antibodies to the NMDA receptor were detected and immunohistochemistry showed reactivity with NMDA receptor-expressing tumor areas. After excision, menses became regular, behavioral problems resolved, and testosterone fell. The authors report the first case combining virilizing mature cystic teratoma with teratoma-associated encephalitis.

pmid-19788483.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫は卵巣で最も多い胚細胞腫瘍である。本総説は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、卵巣甲状腺腫などの単胚葉性奇形腫の画像所見を包括的に解説する。捻転、破裂、悪性転化といった合併症に加え、未熟奇形腫治療後に生じる growing teratoma syndrome も取り上げ、診断に役立つ画像所見を示している。
pmid-19788483.summary_en: This pictorial review describes the imaging spectrum of ovarian teratomas, the most common germ cell neoplasm of the ovary. It covers mature cystic teratomas, immature teratomas, and monodermal teratomas such as struma ovarii. Complications including torsion, rupture, and malignant degeneration are discussed, along with growing teratoma syndrome after treatment of immature teratoma. The authors emphasize imaging features that help radiologists recognize these tumors and their complications, aiding accurate diagnosis.

pmid-19793490.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、混乱・興奮・攻撃性から昏睡に至った女性の傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎を報告する。付属器腫瘤を認め、切除標本では成熟奇形腫に限局した未熟成分が確認された。手術後に神経症状は改善した。辺縁系脳炎の女性では悪性腫瘍の精査を行い、付属器腫瘤があれば婦人科への相談が重要であると著者らは述べている。
pmid-19793490.summary_en: This case report describes a woman presenting with confusion, agitation, and aggression that progressed to coma, caused by paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis. An adnexal mass was identified, and resection revealed a mature teratoma with focal immature components. Neurological symptoms resolved after surgery. The authors recommend thorough malignancy screening in women with limbic encephalitis and gynecologic consultation when an adnexal mass is found, noting good prognosis with prompt surgical resection.

pmid-19795008.summary_ja: 14歳女児の左上腕骨近位部に生じた原発性性腺外悪性奇形腫の症例報告である。MRIでは悪性骨腫瘍が疑われたが、病理組織学的検査で未熟骨性奇形腫と診断された。骨シンチグラフィーとPET-CTでも上腕骨近位部以外に病変はみられなかった。四肢に発生する性腺外奇形腫は極めて稀であり、原発性骨悪性腫瘍との画像鑑別の難しさを示している。
pmid-19795008.summary_en: This case report describes a 14-year-old girl with a primary extragonadal malignant teratoma of the left proximal humerus. Although MRI suggested a malignant bone tumor, pathology revealed an immature bony teratoma. Bone scintigraphy and PET-CT showed uptake limited to the proximal humerus with no other lesions. The report highlights the rarity of extragonadal teratomas arising in an extremity and the diagnostic difficulty of distinguishing them radiologically from primary bone malignancy.

pmid-19795381.summary_ja: 本研究は、セミノーマ患者と正常精巣の核マトリックスタンパク質を二次元電気泳動と質量分析で比較した。正常精巣に特異的な蛋白7種とセミノーマに特異的な4種を同定し、StARD7 と非セミノーマ組織で見られた CDK10 にも言及している。これらの核構造タンパク質は精巣がんの検出や経過観察のバイオマーカー、治療標的となる可能性があると著者らは提案している。
pmid-19795381.summary_en: This study used two-dimensional electrophoresis and mass spectrometry to compare nuclear matrix proteins from seminoma tissue with those of normal testes. Seven proteins were specific to normal testes, while four were found only in seminomas. StARD7 was identified among normal testis proteins, and CDK10 was associated with non-seminoma tissues. The authors suggest these nuclear structural proteins may serve as biomarkers for detecting and monitoring testicular cancer and as potential therapeutic targets.

pmid-19805941.summary_ja: 1990年から2008年にナイジェリアの一施設で治療された小児仙尾部奇形腫38例の後方視的検討。大部分は良性だったが、4例は受診時に悪性で化学療法を受けた。周術期の合併症などで3例が死亡した。フォローアップされた21例のうち、2例(9.5%)が初回切除後に再発し、5例(23.8%)に機能障害が認められた。受診の遅れや長期の機能的後遺症への対策が課題であり、多施設研究の必要性が示された。
pmid-19805941.summary_en: This retrospective review of 38 Nigerian children with sacrococcygeal teratoma (1990 to 2008) found most tumors were benign, although four were malignant at presentation and received chemotherapy. Three children died, mainly from perioperative complications. Among 21 patients followed for a median of six years, two (9.5%) had recurrence after primary excision and five (23.8%) had functional impairment. The authors conclude that late presentation, recurrence, malignant transformation and long-term functional sequelae remain important problems, and that multicenter studies are needed in developing countries.

pmid-19805966.summary_ja: 69歳男性が腹痛と排便習慣の変化で受診し、胃幽門前庭部に潰瘍性の腫瘍を認めた。切除標本では絨毛癌成分と腺癌成分が併存し、絨毛癌成分はβ-hCG陽性で血清β-hCG高値と一致した。肝転移も認められた。非妊娠性・性腺外の胃原発絨毛癌は極めてまれで予後不良であり、早期の正確な診断が重要であると述べている。
pmid-19805966.summary_en: A 69-year-old man presented with abdominal pain and irregular bowel habits and was found to have an ulcerated tumor in the gastric antrum. Histology showed combined choriocarcinoma and adenocarcinoma, and strong immunostaining for beta-hCG in the choriocarcinomatous component matched elevated serum beta-hCG levels. Liver metastasis was present. The authors note that non-gestational, extragonadal gastric choriocarcinoma is extremely rare, has a poor prognosis and metastasizes early, so accurate recognition is essential.

pmid-19805973.summary_ja: 閉経周辺期の女性で、同一卵巣に顆粒膜細胞腫と成熟奇形腫が同時に生じた症例を報告する。この組合せは過去に8例しか報告されていない。顆粒膜細胞腫は低悪性度の悪性腫瘍で、再発が遅れて現れることがあるため、綿密なフォローアップが必要である。本報告は、低悪性度に見える腫瘍であっても長期の監視が重要であることを強調している。
pmid-19805973.summary_en: A perimenopausal woman had granulosa cell tumor and mature teratoma occurring synchronously in the same ovary, a combination reported only eight times before. Granulosa cell tumor is a low-grade malignancy that requires close follow-up because recurrences may appear late. The report describes the case and its pathological features, emphasizing that long-term surveillance is important even when the tumor appears low grade.

pmid-19809555.summary_ja: 55歳の閉経後女性に発生した非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌で、肺転移を伴っていた。この腫瘍は卵巣腫瘍の0.6%以下とまれで予後不良であり、妊娠性の絨毛癌や他の癌腫と鑑別することが重要である。著者らは文献の簡単なレビューとともに症例を提示し、慎重な病理学的分類の価値を強調している。
pmid-19809555.summary_en: A 55-year-old postmenopausal woman had a non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma with lung metastasis. This tumor accounts for 0.6% or fewer of ovarian neoplasms and has a poor prognosis, making it important to distinguish it from gestational forms and other carcinomas. The authors present this case with a brief literature review and emphasize the value of careful pathological classification in this rare condition.

pmid-19815181.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子生物学と細胞生物学をまとめた総説。20～40歳男性で最も多い腫瘍である。セミノーマと非セミノーマはいずれも治癒率が高いが、転移性非セミノーマの最大30%は持続的寛解が得られず、転移性奇形腫はシスプラチンを基盤とする治療に抵抗性を示すことがある。分子生物学の理解を深め、治療強度を予後に応じて調整する必要性が述べられている。
pmid-19815181.summary_en: This review summarizes the molecular and cell biology of testicular germ cell tumors, the most common tumor in men aged 20 to 40. Seminomas and nonseminomas have high cure rates, but up to 30% of patients with metastatic nonseminoma do not achieve durable remission, and metastatic teratomas can resist cisplatin-based therapy. The authors argue that better understanding of molecular biology is needed to refine prognostic classification and tailor treatment intensity to disease severity.

pmid-19817556.summary_ja: hCGは単一の分子ではなく、通常型hCG、過グリコシル化hCG、遊離βサブユニットといった複数の変異体からなることを解説した総説。市販の多くの検査は通常型hCGしか検出しないため、他の変異体が優位な妊娠性絨毛性疾患や胚細胞腫瘍では誤差を生じうる。検査が測定する対象を理解することの重要性が述べられている。
pmid-19817556.summary_en: This review explains that hCG exists in several variants (regular hCG, hyperglycosylated hCG and free beta-subunit) produced by different cells and malignancies. Many commercial assays detect only regular hCG, which can cause errors in gestational trophoblastic disease and germ cell tumors where other variants predominate. The authors recommend that clinicians understand which hCG forms a test measures, since hCG testing is essential in managing gestational trophoblastic diseases and useful for testicular and other germ cell malignancies.

pmid-19823015.summary_ja: rPEGプロモーターで駆動される可溶性TRAIL遺伝子のプラスミドを構築し、胎児性癌細胞および奇形癌を担ぐマウスで評価した研究。導入された細胞はアポトーシスを起こし、デス受容体の発現が上昇した。腫瘍内注射により腫瘍増殖が抑制され生存期間が延長され、肝臓を含む組織で明らかな毒性は認められなかった。奇形癌に対する遺伝子治療への応用が期待されると結論している。
pmid-19823015.summary_en: Researchers built a plasmid expressing soluble TRAIL under the control of the rPEG promoter and tested it against embryonal carcinoma cells and teratocarcinoma-bearing mice. Transfected cells underwent apoptosis and increased death receptor expression. Intratumoral injection of the DNA-liposome complex suppressed tumor growth, prolonged survival, and caused no detectable toxicity in examined tissues including the liver. The authors conclude that this approach could enable effective gene therapy against teratocarcinoma.

pmid-19829989.summary_ja: 29歳女性が体外受精後の双胎妊娠中に腹痛、低血圧、嘔吐を呈して救急受診した。自然脾破裂を契機に妊娠性絨毛癌と診断された。体外受精後に発生した転移性絨毛癌としては初の報告の可能性があり、化学療法により治癒した。生殖補助医療と本疾患の関連を示す症例である。
pmid-19829989.summary_en: A 29-year-old woman presented with abdominal pain, hypotension, and vomiting around the sixth month of a twin pregnancy after in vitro fertilization. She was diagnosed with gestational choriocarcinoma presenting as spontaneous splenic rupture. The authors believe this is probably the first reported case of metastatic choriocarcinoma developing after in vitro fertilization. She was cured with chemotherapy. The report highlights the rare association between assisted reproduction and this highly malignant trophoblastic tumor.

pmid-19830236.summary_ja: 52歳男性が右股関節と坐骨の激痛で受診し、骨融解性の骨転移が判明した。23年前に右鼠径精巣摘除術と補助化学療法を受けた転移性精巣混合性腫瘍（絨毛癌・胎児性癌）の再発である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍として最も長い再発期間の一つであり、生涯にわたるフォローアップの必要性を強調している。
pmid-19830236.summary_en: A 52-year-old man presented with severe right hip and ischial pain due to osteolytic bone metastasis. He had undergone right inguinal orchiectomy and adjuvant chemotherapy 23 years earlier for a metastatic testicular mixed tumor of choriocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma. This relapse is among the longest intervals reported for testicular germ cell tumors. The authors stress the need for lifelong follow-up of patients with metastatic testicular cancer, even decades after apparent cure.

pmid-19830237.summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の21歳男性が、残存腫瘤に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清、腎摘除、下大静脈の部分切除を受けた。術後に持続性リンパ漏を生じ、足下垂をきたした。保存的な内科的・外科的治療で改善した。適切に管理しないと重篤な合併症となりうる。
pmid-19830237.summary_en: A 21-year-old man with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, nephrectomy, and partial inferior vena cava excision for a residual mass. He developed persistent lymphatic drainage, which caused foot drop. The complication eventually responded to conservative medical and surgical measures. The authors note that this postoperative condition usually responds well to conservative management but can cause serious morbidity if not managed appropriately.

pmid-19830238.summary_ja: 31歳男性が後腹膜腫瘤で受診し、組織学的にセミノーマの所見を示した。精巣は触診上正常に見えたが、超音波検査で陰嚢内の病変が判明し精巣摘除術を施行。精巣に胚細胞腫瘍の自然退縮所見が認められた。原発性精巣腫瘍が後腹膜リンパ節転移の出現後に退縮した、世界的にもまれな症例である。
pmid-19830238.summary_en: A 31-year-old man presented with a retroperitoneal mass with histology characteristic of seminoma, while the testes appeared normal on examination. Ultrasound identified a suspicious scrotal lesion, and orchiectomy followed. The testis showed features of spontaneous regression of germ cell tumor. This burned-out seminoma case, one of very few reported, shows primary testicular tumor regressing after retroperitoneal nodal metastasis. Such burned-out tumors are hard to recognize and are incompletely characterized clinically.

pmid-19836777.summary_ja: 1993〜2008年に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた280例のうち、臨床病期ISの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍24例が初回手術を受けた。後腹膜再発は中央値2.9年の観察期間中に認められなかった。多くの患者で化学療法を回避でき、初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清は病期ISの有効な治療選択肢と結論づけている。
pmid-19836777.summary_en: This retrospective review of 280 retroperitoneal lymph node dissections identified 24 patients with clinical stage IS nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who underwent primary RPLND. Embryonal carcinoma was present in all orchiectomy specimens, and teratoma in 63%. Positive nodes were found in 38%. Only 21% received postoperative chemotherapy, and no retroperitoneal recurrence was observed during median 2.9-year follow-up. The authors conclude primary RPLND can successfully treat stage IS disease, sparing most patients chemotherapy.

pmid-19840014.summary_ja: 低病期非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療方針を検討した総説。低リスクの臨床病期Iはサーベイランス、腫瘍マーカー上昇や3cm超のリンパ節腫大を伴う高リスク例は導入化学療法、その他は後腹膜リンパ節郭清を推奨している。神経温存の両側テンプレート郭清を支持し、腹腔鏡下の郭清は病期分類目的にとどまるとしている。
pmid-19840014.summary_en: This review addresses treatment of low-stage nonseminomatous germ cell testicular cancer (NSGCT). The authors describe surveillance for low-risk clinical stage I disease, induction chemotherapy for high-risk patients with elevated tumor markers or adenopathy over 3 cm, and RPLND for others. They note RPLND causes fewer long-term complications than chemotherapy, and that laparoscopic RPLND remains a staging procedure only. Full bilateral nerve-sparing template dissection is favored to reduce ejaculatory dysfunction, and adjuvant chemotherapy is typically reserved for pathological N2-3 disease.

pmid-19840021.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清(PC-RPLND)の役割をレビューしたものです。残存腫瘤があれば適応となりますが、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)だけでは生存腫瘍や奇形腫と壊死を確実に区別できません。完全切除が予後を規定し、適切な症例では神経温存術式により射精能と妊孕性を温存できます。手技は難度が高く、専門施設で行うべきとされます。
pmid-19840021.summary_en: This review discusses the role of postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) in advanced germ cell tumors. Improvements in radiographic staging, the use of tumor markers, and cisplatin-based chemotherapy have shaped its use. PC-RPLND is indicated for residual masses after chemotherapy, because CT alone cannot reliably distinguish viable tumor or teratoma from necrosis. Complete resection predicts outcome. In selected patients with normalized markers and necrosis, nerve-sparing techniques can preserve ejaculation and fertility. Because the procedure is technically demanding, it should be performed at experienced referral centers.

pmid-19840022.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発(治療後2年以上)をレビューしたものです。発生頻度は1~6%で、性腺外原発例でリスクが最も高く、再発部位は後腹膜が主です。初回治療時の後腹膜手術が不十分だと再発リスクが上がります。経験豊富な施設では5年がん特異的生存率が50%超となり、単発の成熟奇形腫では約100%に達します。症例は高症例数施設へ紹介すべきとされています。
pmid-19840022.summary_en: This review examines late relapses of nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, defined as recurrence at least two years after successful treatment, which occur in 1-6% of patients. Patients with extragonadal primary tumors are at greatest risk, and the retroperitoneum is the predominant relapse site. Suboptimal primary retroperitoneal surgery increases the risk. Radical surgery and improved salvage chemotherapy raise cure rates. At experienced centers, five-year cancer-specific survival exceeds 50%, approaching 100% for single-site mature teratoma. The authors recommend referring these patients to high-volume institutions.

pmid-19841564.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の異時性両側発症の2症例を報告したものです。1例は1990年に病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、腫瘍マーカー上昇による再発後にシスプラチンとエトポシドを受け、13年後に対側精巣にセミノーマを発症しました。もう1例は対側に治療後5年でセミノーマを発症しました。長期のフォローアップが重要です。
pmid-19841564.summary_en: This report describes two men who developed metachronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors. One had stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor treated in 1990, relapsed on surveillance by tumor marker elevation, and received cisplatin and etoposide. He developed contralateral seminoma 13 years later. The other had orchidectomy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor in 2003, received adjuvant BEP, and developed contralateral seminoma five years later. Long-term follow-up is essential because late contralateral tumors can appear many years after treatment.

pmid-19841567.summary_ja: 55歳男性の長期間持続する精巣腫大に対し、横紋筋肉腫様分化を伴う精母細胞性セミノーマと診断した症例を報告したものです。肉腫様変化はきわめて稀で、英語文献では13例のみの報告です。肉腫成分の存在は攻撃的な経過、転移、予後不良と関連します。著者らは、この稀な組み合わせについて文献を概説しています。
pmid-19841567.summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old man with long-standing testicular swelling, diagnosed with spermatocytic seminoma showing rhabdomyosarcomatous differentiation. Sarcomatous transformation is extremely rare, with only 13 cases reported in the English literature. A sarcomatous component is associated with aggressive behavior, metastasis, and poor prognosis. The authors review the literature on this rare combination.

pmid-19842874.summary_ja: 生後20日の男児に生じた、二分脊椎と脊髄係留を伴う腰仙部の未熟奇形腫を報告したものです。腫瘍は成熟奇形腫の成分と、未熟成分としてのウィルムス腫瘍様成分から構成されていました。脊髄披裂を伴う未熟奇形腫内のウィルムス腫瘍としては4例目とされます。腎外性ウィルムス腫瘍の発生機序と臨床的特徴も考察しています。
pmid-19842874.summary_en: This report describes a 20-day-old boy with a lumbosacral immature teratoma associated with spina bifida and tethered cord. The tumor contained mature teratomatous components and an immature Wilms tumor-like component. The authors describe it as the fourth reported case of lumbosacral Wilms tumor within immature teratoma with spinal dysraphism. They discuss possible mechanisms and clinical features of extrarenal Wilms tumor and review the literature.

pmid-19842876.summary_ja: 妊娠21週の超音波検査で診断された心膜内奇形腫の胎児例を報告したものです。大量の心嚢水貯留と胎児水腫を伴っていました。妊娠22週6日に心膜羊膜シャントを留置し排液は得られましたが、8日後に腫瘍による心臓圧迫が疑われる胎児死亡に至りました。出生前に発見された心膜内奇形腫の文献も概説しています。
pmid-19842876.summary_en: This report describes a fetus with an intrapericardial teratoma, diagnosed on antenatal ultrasound at 21 weeks of gestation, causing massive pericardial effusion and fetal hydrops. A pericardioamniotic shunt was placed at 22 weeks and 6 days and drained the effusion. However, fetal demise occurred eight days later, likely from tumor compression of the heart. The authors also review antenatal intrapericardial teratomas in the literature.

pmid-19844922.summary_ja: 本研究では、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織型ごとにセラジン-1の発現を検討した。奇形腫で最も高く、セミノーマで最も低い発現を示し、化学療法・放射線療法への感受性の違いと一致した。NT2細胞でセラジン-1はカスパーゼ-3の活性化を抑制し、シスプラチン感受性に関与することが示された。
pmid-19844922.summary_en: This study examined seladin-1 expression across testicular germ cell tumour histotypes and its role in cisplatin responsiveness. Seladin-1 expression was highest in teratoma and lowest in seminoma, paralleling their known chemo- and radiosensitivity differences. In NT2 cells, seladin-1 inhibited caspase-3 activation and promoted cell survival. Silencing it increased cisplatin sensitivity, while overexpression enhanced survival and anti-apoptotic effects. The authors conclude that seladin-1 plays an important role in TGCT biology and cisplatin responsiveness.

pmid-19853145.summary_ja: 前縦隔に発生し、嚢胞性変化が目立つ原発性腫瘍の症例報告である。最終的に嚢胞性セミノーマと診断された。嚢胞液中のCA19-9が極めて高値であった。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と類似する所見を示したため、前縦隔の嚢胞性腫瘍の鑑別には嚢胞性セミノーマと成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の両方を含めるべきと著者らは提言している。
pmid-19853145.summary_en: This case report describes a primary anterior mediastinal tumor with prominent cystic change, ultimately diagnosed as cystic seminoma. The cystic fluid showed an extremely elevated CA19-9 level. Because the cystic features closely resembled those of mature cystic teratoma, the authors caution that the differential diagnosis of cystic anterior mediastinal tumors should include both cystic seminoma and mature cystic teratoma. Recognizing this overlap is important to avoid misdiagnosis of these lesions.

pmid-19855393.summary_ja: 30例の精母細胞性セミノーマについて17遺伝子の発がん性変異を検索し、FGFR3 K650EおよびHRAS変異を同定した。FGFR3 K650Eは生殖細胞系列では致死性骨異形成症の原因ともなる。精子DNA解析では、FGFR3変異の頻度は父親の年齢とともに上昇し、変異スペクトルは膀胱がんに類似していた。多くの腫瘍でFGFR3および/またはHRASの免疫反応性が増強していた。著者らは、父親の年齢効果による変異が精巣内の共通の増殖経路を活性化し、先天性症候群と発がん素因を結びつけると提案している。
pmid-19855393.summary_en: The authors screened 30 spermatocytic seminomas for oncogenic mutations in 17 genes and identified recurrent FGFR3 K650E and HRAS mutations. FGFR3 K650E is also a germline cause of thanatophoric dysplasia. Sperm DNA analysis showed that FGFR3 mutation levels rise with paternal age, and the mutation spectrum resembled that seen in bladder cancer. Most tumors showed increased FGFR3 and/or HRAS immunoreactivity. The authors propose that paternal-age-effect mutations activate a shared proliferative pathway in the testis, linking congenital syndromes and cancer predisposition.

pmid-19856056.summary_ja: 36歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の症例報告である。第3子の分娩後14か月で不正性器出血を生じ、多発転移を認めた。EMA/CO療法を一次治療として行ったが、第6コースで薬剤耐性となり、初発症状から8か月で死亡した。核分裂像の多さと未分化な異型所見が予後不良因子であると結論づけている。
pmid-19856056.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) who developed multiple metastases 14 months after her third pregnancy. Her tumor had a high mitotic count, and surgery was judged difficult, so EMA/CO chemotherapy was given as first-line treatment. The disease became drug-resistant during the sixth cycle, and she died eight months after her first symptoms. The authors conclude that a high mitotic count and atypical undifferentiated features are significant adverse prognostic factors in PSTT with metastasis.

pmid-19860007.summary_ja: 70歳男性で、AFP産生腺癌と混在する胃絨毛癌と、独立した腺癌が亜全胃切除後に確認された症例報告である。術前の血清AFPは上昇していた。術後、hCGおよびAFP値は低下し、6サイクルの補助化学療法が行われた。術後4年の経過観察で再発や遠隔転移は認められなかった。本症例は、混合組織型の性腺外絨毛癌における腫瘍マーカーモニタリングの有用性を示している。
pmid-19860007.summary_en: This case report describes a 70-year-old man with gastric choriocarcinoma admixed with an AFP-producing adenocarcinoma, along with a separate adenocarcinoma, identified after subtotal gastrectomy. Serum AFP was elevated preoperatively. Postoperatively, hCG and AFP levels fell, and six cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy were given. No recurrence or distant metastasis was observed at four years of follow-up. The case illustrates the value of tumor marker monitoring in extragonadal choriocarcinoma with mixed histology.

pmid-19861756.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、小眼球症と眼窩嚢胞を呈した乳児の先天性眼窩奇形腫を記述する。非交通性の嚢胞は眼球から外科的に分離・切除され、病理組織学的に奇形腫と確認された。小眼球症と眼窩嚢胞を呈する乳児では、先天性嚢胞性奇形腫を鑑別診断に含めるべきであり、他の原因とは治療方針が異なると著者らは強調している。
pmid-19861756.summary_en: This case report describes a rare congenital orbital teratoma in an infant that presented as microphthalmos with an orbital cyst. The non-communicating cyst was surgically separated from the globe and excised, and histopathology confirmed a teratoma. The authors emphasize that congenital cystic teratoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of infants with microphthalmos and orbital cysts, because its management differs from that of other causes.

pmid-19863625.summary_ja: 3施設の27例を後方視的に解析し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移例を検討した。大半は非セミノーマ性で、全例に化学療法が行われ、全脳放射線療法、定位放射線治療、外科的切除が併用された。5年・10年の癌特異的生存率はいずれも35.9%であった。単発転移は多発転移より予後良好であり、著者らは脳局所治療と化学療法の併用を推奨している。
pmid-19863625.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 27 patients from three institutions reviewed testicular germ cell tumors with brain metastases. Most were non-seminomatous, and all received chemotherapy, with additional brain-directed treatment including whole-brain radiotherapy, stereotactic radiosurgery, or surgical resection. Five- and 10-year cancer-specific survival were both 35.9%. Patients with a single metastasis survived better than those with multiple lesions. The authors recommend combining local brain treatment with chemotherapy.

pmid-19874621.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞をオールトランス型レチノイン酸やPOU5F1抑制により分化誘導し、Wntシグナルの変化を解析した。未分化細胞ではカノニカルWntシグナルは低く、分化に伴い上昇した。FZD5、FZD7、WNT5Aの抑制は分化を誘導せずに増殖を抑制し、FZD7抑制は検討した全細胞株で最も強い増殖抑制を示した。FZD7は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療標的として有望と結論づけられている。
pmid-19874621.summary_en: This study examined Wnt signaling during induced differentiation of human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, using retinoic acid treatment and POU5F1 repression in NT2/D1 and other lines. Canonical Wnt activity was low in undifferentiated cells and rose with differentiation. Silencing FZD5, FZD7, or WNT5A inhibited EC cell growth without inducing differentiation, and FZD7 knockdown caused the strongest growth suppression across all lines tested. The authors propose FZD7 as a therapeutic target for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-19881142.summary_ja: 35歳男性の左腎下極腫瘤に対し腎部分切除術が施行された症例報告である。病理組織学的検査で腎臓の奇形腫と診断された。成人の原発性腎内奇形腫は極めてまれで、文献上の報告も少ないため、著者らは文献レビューとともに本症例を提示している。
pmid-19881142.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with a left lower-pole renal mass treated with partial nephrectomy. Histopathological examination showed a teratoma of the kidney. The authors note that primary intrarenal teratomas in adults are extremely rare, with only a few cases in the literature. They present this case together with a brief literature review, highlighting the diagnostic significance of recognizing such uncommon presentations.

pmid-19887767.summary_ja: 超音波検査で出生前に診断された大型の腹腔内奇形腫の症例で、嚢胞成分と充実成分が混在する不均一な腫瘤として描出された。出生後に外科的切除が行われ、良好な経過を得た。胎児期の腹腔内奇形腫はまれであり、術後予後は一般に良好と著者らは述べ、文献レビューも行っている。
pmid-19887767.summary_en: This report describes a large intra-abdominal teratoma diagnosed antenatally by ultrasound, showing a heterogeneous mass with cystic and solid components. The fetus was managed successfully, with postnatal surgical removal of the tumor. The authors also review the literature on prenatal intra-abdominal teratomas, which are rare, and note that the prognosis after surgery is generally good.

pmid-19887871.summary_ja: 19歳男性が非定型的で強い腹痛を訴え、当初は急性虫垂炎と診断された。腹腔鏡下虫垂切除で乳糜腹水がみられたが虫垂は正常であった。精査で腸間膜リンパ節腫大が見つかり、生検で混合型胚細胞腫瘍と判明し、原発は右精巣と特定された。若年男性の非定型腹痛では精巣腫瘍を鑑別に含め、精巣の診察を日常的に行うべきと著者らは強調している。
pmid-19887871.summary_en: A 19-year-old man presented with severe atypical abdominal pain initially diagnosed as appendicitis. Laparoscopic appendectomy found chylous ascites and a normal appendix. Work-up revealed mesenteric lymphadenopathy, and nodal sampling showed a mixed germ cell tumor. The primary tumor was traced to the right testis. The authors stress that testicular tumors belong in the differential diagnosis of atypical abdominal pain in young men and that a thorough testicular examination should be routine.

pmid-19887907.summary_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞(HESC)と人工多能性幹細胞(iPS細胞)の腫瘍形成能を総説している。二倍体で継代初期のHESCは遺伝子改変なしに良性奇形腫を形成する一方、培養中に遺伝的・エピジェネティックな変化を獲得した細胞は悪性の奇形癌を生じうると著者らは論じている。分子機構と予防法、培養適応細胞のマーカー同定についても考察している。
pmid-19887907.summary_en: This review examines the tumorigenicity of human embryonic stem cells (HESCs) and induced pluripotent stem cells (HiPSCs), which can form tumors in vivo. The authors argue that diploid, early-passage HESCs generate benign teratomas without genetic modification, whereas HESCs that acquired genetic or epigenetic changes during culture can produce malignant teratocarcinomas. They discuss molecular mechanisms behind this risk and suggest approaches to prevent tumor formation and to identify markers of culture-adapted cells before clinical use.

pmid-19893031.summary_ja: 正常胎盤・胞状奇胎・妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍におけるFASNの発現を調べ、FASN阻害薬C93の絨毛癌細胞への作用を検討した。絨毛癌の全例、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍の大半、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の60%でFASNが陽性であった。C93はJEG3およびJAR細胞でアポトーシスを誘導した。転移性・化学療法抵抗性の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対する標的治療として検討の価値があると結論している。
pmid-19893031.summary_en: This study examined fatty acid synthase (FASN) expression in normal and molar placentas and in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, and tested the FASN inhibitor C93 in choriocarcinoma cells. FASN was expressed in all choriocarcinomas, most epithelioid trophoblastic tumors, and 60% of placental site trophoblastic tumors. C93 induced apoptosis in JEG3 and JAR cells without affecting cell cycle progression. The authors suggest FASN inhibitors merit investigation as targeted therapy for metastatic and chemoresistant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-19896613.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の切除後に再発し、腹腔内に多発する寄生性奇形腫を認めた症例報告です。腹壁、大網、ダグラス窩に腫瘤があり、腹腔鏡下にすべて摘出されました。卵巣類皮嚢腫の自己切断と再移植が大網奇形腫の最も一般的な原因と考察されています。超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)が診断に有用でした。
pmid-19896613.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with multiple intra-abdominal parasitic dermoids who had previously undergone excision of an ovarian dermoid cyst and later presented with recurrent symptoms. Masses involved the abdominal wall, omentum, and pouch of Douglas. The authors note that autoamputation and reimplantation of ovarian dermoids is the most common cause of omental teratomas. Abdominal pain was the main symptom, and ultrasonography with Doppler and CT aided diagnosis. All masses were removed laparoscopically, and no prior literature described such extensive parasitic dermoids.

pmid-19898219.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の治療後、2年目に傍大動脈リンパ節転移を生じた39歳男性の症例です。転移巣には奇形腫成分と、妊娠性の上皮様栄養膜腫瘍に類似した絨毛型細胞の胞巣が混在していました。診断は段階的な免疫組織化学により確認されました。胚細胞腫瘍から生じる栄養膜性腫瘍の病態を理解する上で重要な症例です。
pmid-19898219.summary_en: This report describes a 39-year-old man with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor who developed a para-aortic lymph node metastasis two years after orchiectomy and chemotherapy. The metastasis contained both a teratoma component and nests of trophoblastic cells resembling gestational epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Stepwise immunohistochemistry confirmed the diagnosis. The authors argue that pathologists should recognize this trophoblastic feature when evaluating post-treatment mixed germ cell neoplasms. The case offers insight into trophoblastic neoplasms arising from germ cell tumors.

pmid-19900144.summary_ja: 初回手術で十分な病期分類がされず、補助化学療法も受けなかった20代の2例のIA期卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ患者の報告です。両者とも傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴う再発を来し、広範な手術と多剤併用化学療法が必要となりました。初回から系統的な傍大動脈リンパ節郭清を含む包括的治療を三次施設で行うことの重要性が強調されています。
pmid-19900144.summary_en: This report describes two women aged 20 and 26 with stage IA ovarian dysgerminoma who were inadequately staged at initial surgery and received no adjuvant therapy. Both later developed recurrence with para-aortic lymph node metastasis requiring extensive surgery and multiagent chemotherapy. The authors emphasize that comprehensive initial surgery, including systematic para-aortic lymphadenectomy and adjuvant chemotherapy at tertiary centers, is needed to minimize the treatment burden for patients with apparently early-stage dysgerminoma.

pmid-19900938.summary_ja: ウィットヌームでクロシドライト（青石綿）に曝露した女性と少女の間で、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の集積が見られたことを報告する仮説論文です。2,968人中、絨毛癌3例と胞状奇胎3例が確認されました。石綿は胎盤検体からも検出されており、生物学的な妥当性があると考えられています。患者の職業歴と居住歴の聴取、病理標本の石綿検査が有用と提案されています。
pmid-19900938.summary_en: This hypothesis paper describes a cluster of gestational trophoblastic disease among women and girls exposed to crocidolite (blue asbestos) at Wittenoom. Among 2,968 exposed individuals, the authors identified three choriocarcinomas and three hydatidiform moles. Four of six cases had lived with asbestos workers who brought dusty clothing home. Because asbestos fibers have been found in the ovary, peritoneum, and placental digests, the authors argue the association has biological plausibility. They suggest taking occupational and residential histories and examining pathologic specimens for asbestos in GTD patients.

pmid-19907116.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫）の治療後、血球貪食症候群を発症した20歳男性の症例です。同時期に骨転移も判明しました。血小板減少はステロイドに反応せず、腫瘍進行に対する化学療法後に改善しました。胚細胞腫瘍に伴う反応性血球貪食はこれまで3例のみの報告であり、両者の密接な関連が示唆されています。
pmid-19907116.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man with a primary non-seminomatous mediastinal germ cell tumor, containing yolk sac tumor and immature teratoma, who developed hemophagocytic syndrome three months after surgical resection. Bone metastases were also found around that time. Thrombocytopenia did not respond to corticosteroids but improved after chemotherapy for tumor progression. The authors note that only three previous cases of germ cell tumor with reactive hemophagocytosis had been reported, suggesting a close relationship between the two conditions.

pmid-19909520.summary_ja: 3歳児の肝臓に生じた大きな腫瘍の症例報告。肝芽腫と悪性奇形腫の両方の特徴を示し、化学療法後に拡大右半肝切除術と補助化学療法が行われた。初診から36か月後も健康で、残存腫瘍は認められていない。著者らは、この病態を混合性肝芽腫・奇形腫と位置づけている。
pmid-19909520.summary_en: A 3-year-old child presented with a large liver tumor showing features of both hepatoblastoma and malignant teratoma. Biopsy revealed an immature teratoid tumor without hepatoblastic differentiation, while resected tissue showed intermixed hepatoblastoma-like, neuroblastoma-like, and rhabdomyosarcomatous areas. The tumor enlarged after chemotherapy, and an extended right hemihepatectomy was performed, followed by adjuvant chemotherapy. At 36 months after diagnosis, the patient remained healthy without residual disease. The authors designate this entity as mixed hepatoblastoma and teratoma.

pmid-19918516.summary_ja: 67歳男性の左鎖骨上窩リンパ節から、転移性セミノーマと濾胞性リンパ腫が同一リンパ節に併存して認められた症例報告。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を完遂した。胚細胞腫瘍マーカーは基線で上昇しておらず、腫瘍マーカーや陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)では再発の鑑別が困難と指摘している。
pmid-19918516.summary_en: A 67-year-old man with an enlarging left supraclavicular lymph node was found on biopsy to have both metastatic seminoma and grade 1 follicular lymphoma within the same node. Staging PET/CT showed several enlarged nodes. He completed chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. Because germ cell tumor markers were not elevated at baseline, the authors note that serum tumor markers cannot reliably track response or relapse here. FDG-PET is also non-specific, since both diseases are avid. Biopsy of each enlarged node would be needed to distinguish recurrent seminoma from lymphoma.

pmid-19922278.summary_ja: 出生時から徐々に増大した仙骨部腫瘤を有する18歳女性の症例報告。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で周囲構造に浸潤しない充実性・嚢胞性腫瘤が認められ、肛門後方経路で完全切除された。先天性仙尾部奇形腫は乳幼児期に多い胚細胞腫瘍であり、成人例は稀である。
pmid-19922278.summary_en: An 18-year-old woman presented with a progressively enlarging sacral mass present since birth. MRI demonstrated a solid-cystic lesion with no involvement of surrounding structures. The tumor was completely excised via a post-anal approach. The authors describe this as an unusual adult presentation of congenital sacrococcygeal teratoma, which is the most common germ cell tumor of infancy and childhood and is typically diagnosed early in life. The report documents successful complete resection through the posterior route in an adult.

pmid-19926950.summary_ja: 右上腹部の膨満感と疼痛を主訴とした42歳男性の症例報告。直径12cmの右後腹膜腫瘤と同側腎の無形成が認められた。腫瘍切除とリンパ節郭清により、傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴うセミノーマ(pT1 pN3M0)と診断された。停留精巣と右腎無形成の合併例として、文献上3例目である。
pmid-19926950.summary_en: A 42-year-old man presented with right upper abdominal distension and pain. Imaging showed a 12 cm right retroperitoneal mass, and the ipsilateral kidney was not visualized. Tumor resection and lymphadenectomy confirmed seminoma with para-aortic lymph node involvement, classified as pT1 pN3M0. The tumor was diagnosed as arising from intra-abdominal cryptorchidism associated with right renal agenesis. The authors note this is only the third such case reported in the literature.

pmid-19926951.summary_ja: 26歳男性が左頸部リンパ節の針生検でセミノーマと診断され、後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と判定された。化学療法で完全寛解を得た後、7年後に右精巣腫大を認め、根治的精巣摘除術によりセミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍成分が確認された。術後10か月まで再発はない。
pmid-19926951.summary_en: A 26-year-old man initially diagnosed with seminoma by needle biopsy of a left cervical lymph node was found to have an aorto-caval retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor. After three courses of BEP and one of VIP, he achieved complete remission. Seven years later, right scrotal enlargement led to radical orchiectomy, which showed seminoma with yolk sac tumor components. No recurrence was seen after 10 months.

pmid-19934304.summary_ja: 進行固形腫瘍48例を対象に、フラボピリドールとFOLFOXの併用療法の第I相試験を実施した。プラチナ抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍で評価可能な9例中3例に部分奏効が得られ、10例中7例で腫瘍マーカーの低下がみられた。奏効例はp53変異陽性で、この結果から第II相試験が進行中である。
pmid-19934304.summary_en: This phase I trial combined flavopiridol with FOLFOX (oxaliplatin, fluorouracil and leucovorin) in 48 patients with advanced solid tumors. The maximum tolerated dose was defined, with dose-limiting toxicities including nausea, vomiting and neutropenia. Clinical activity was seen in platinum-refractory germ cell tumors, with partial responses in 3 of 9 evaluable patients and tumor marker declines in 7 of 10. Responders had p53-mutant tumors. A phase II trial in platinum-refractory germ cell tumors is now enrolling.

pmid-19935163.summary_ja: 筆者は妊娠の可能性がないはずの時期に陽性の妊娠検査結果を得た。この経験を起点に、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を解説する看護記事である。妊娠以外の疾患、特に各種のがんでも妊娠検査が陽性になりうることを示し、臨床所見と一致しない陽性結果はさらに精査すべきと強調している。
pmid-19935163.summary_en: Written for nurses, this article describes placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) after the author received an unexpected positive pregnancy test despite knowing she could not be pregnant. It emphasizes that positive pregnancy tests can arise from conditions other than pregnancy, including various cancers such as PSTT. The authors urge that positive tests without corresponding clinical findings be evaluated further.

pmid-19936119.summary_ja: 妊娠18週の初産婦の定期超音波検査で、胎児の口咽頭腔を満たし口外に突出する高エコー性腫瘤が見つかった。ミソプロストールで妊娠を終結し、死産児が得られた。剖検と病理検査で咽頭奇形腫と確定した。出生前超音波は稀な奇形腫の診断に有用で、早期の両親へのカウンセリングに役立つと結論している。
pmid-19936119.summary_en: A 24-year-old primipara at 18 weeks' gestation had a fetal echogenic mass filling the stomatopharyngeal cavity and protruding from the mouth, detected on routine ultrasound. Pregnancy was terminated with misoprostol, and a 250 g stillborn female fetus was delivered. Postmortem and pathologic examination confirmed a pharyngeal teratoma. The authors conclude that prenatal ultrasound can identify these rare tumors and facilitate early parental counseling, and they review the literature.

pmid-19940282.summary_ja: 1980〜1994年にノルウェーで片側の精巣がんと診断された男性1409人を対象とした全国多施設調査である。中央値10.7年の追跡で、化学療法を受けた男性の39%がレイノー様症状、29%が感覚異常を報告した。高用量化学療法は難聴と耳鳴りのリスク上昇と関連し、放射線療法は足の感覚異常と関連した。
pmid-19940282.summary_en: This national multicenter survey of 1409 assessable Norwegian men treated for unilateral testicular cancer in 1980-1994 examined long-term neurological and Raynaud-like side effects. With a median follow-up of 10.7 years, Raynaud-like phenomena were reported by 39% and paresthesias by 29% of chemotherapy-treated men, and hearing impairment by 21%. Dose-intensive chemotherapy was associated with markedly higher odds of hearing impairment and tinnitus. Radiotherapy was associated with higher odds of foot paresthesias.

pmid-19944031.summary_ja: 54歳女性が肛門からの出血で受診した。内視鏡で直腸内に毛髪様表面を持つ腫瘍を認め、画像で骨組織を含む所見があった。開腹で左卵巣が直腸前壁と癒合しており、左卵巣摘出術と腸管切開下の腫瘍摘出を行った。病理は三胚葉由来の組織から成り、直腸腫瘍の鑑別診断として卵巣奇形腫を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-19944031.summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old woman with transanal bleeding caused by a solid mature ovarian teratoma that protruded into the rectum.
